raw.title: Marketing Operations Manager
raw.excerpt: Company OverviewVoted #1 EHR by PC Mag, WRS Health delivers a fully integrated cloud based EMR and practice management solutions to its clients.
raw.description:
Company Overview

Voted #1 EHR by PC Mag, WRS Health delivers a fully integrated cloud based EMR and practice management solutions to its clients. We bring solutions to physicians by providing constant enhancement of our products and services including EHR, practice management, marketing, patient coordination and billing.

Job Overview

Voted the #1 EHR by PC Magazine, WRS Health is a physician-owned company delivering a fully integrated, AI-powered cloud EHR and practice management platform to medical practices across 25+ specialties. We support physicians with continuously improving products and services, including EHR, practice management, marketing, patient coordination, and billing.

We are seeking a Marketing Operations Strategist to develop and execute strategic marketing plans that drive brand awareness, customer acquisition, and revenue growth. You will build repeatable, measurable marketing systems that align with company goals, using HubSpot, AI-driven automation, and data science to turn marketing data into smarter decisions. This role is ideal for a results-driven, creative, and collaborative leader with a strong B2B SaaS background who enjoys managing projects, documenting processes, analyzing performance, and optimizing the website for better user experience, conversion rates, and lead generation.

Key Responsibilities

Marketing Strategy & Planning

  • Design and execute a comprehensive marketing strategy aligned with company objectives, target markets, and healthcare IT industry trends.
  • Collaborate with executive leadership to define marketing goals, KPIs, and budgets.

AI-Focused Marketing Workflows

  • Design and implement AI-powered workflows for lead scoring, content generation, audience segmentation, chatbots, and campaign personalization.
  • Evaluate and integrate AI tools (including HubSpot's AI features) into the marketing stack, with clear guidelines for quality, brand voice, and HIPAA-conscious data use.

Data Science & Marketing Analytics

  • Apply statistical analysis, predictive modeling, and attribution modeling to forecast pipeline, identify high-value segments, and measure channel effectiveness.
  • Design and analyze A/B and multivariate tests across emails, landing pages, and website experiences, turning results into actionable recommendations.

HubSpot & Marketing Automation

  • Manage HubSpot (Marketing, Sales, Service, and CMS Hubs), including automation workflows, processes, and data hygiene.
  • Analyze reports and dashboards in HubSpot to track KPIs, campaign performance, and ROI for stakeholders.

Campaign & Website Optimization

  • Build and manage the email marketing program from segmentation to execution.
  • Improve forms, email templates, landing pages, and website experiences to increase conversion rates and lead generation.

Project Management & Cross-Functional Alignment

  • Manage marketing operations projects from initiation to completion, tracking progress, risks, and bottlenecks to stay on schedule and within budget.
  • Partner with Marketing, Sales, and Customer Service teams to integrate processes and document repeatable workflows.

Qualifications

Required

  • Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Management, Data Analytics, or a related field.
  • At least 5 years of experience in marketing, marketing operations, and project management, preferably in B2B SaaS.
  • Advanced expertise in HubSpot (Marketing, Sales, Service, and CMS Hubs) and strong proficiency in marketing automation technologies.
  • Hands-on experience building AI-assisted marketing workflows (e.g., predictive lead scoring, AI content tools, chatbots, or personalization).
  • Strong analytical and statistical skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.
  • Advanced database management and data visualization skills.
  • Solid understanding of customer journey mapping and business processes.
  • Excellent project management skills, with the ability to lead multiple projects at once.
  • Strong communication skills, including knowing how to ask the right questions and turn answers into systems.

Preferred

  • HubSpot certifications (Marketing, Sales, Operations, or related).
  • Experience as a HubSpot trainer or in HubSpot customer support.
  • Working knowledge of SQL, Python, or R for marketing data analysis.
  • Experience with BI tools such as Looker Studio, Tableau, or Power BI.
  • Familiarity with marketing attribution, predictive analytics, or machine learning concepts.
  • Experience marketing to healthcare providers or in health IT, with awareness of HIPAA considerations.

A Day in the Life

Your day blends strategy, systems, and data. You might start by reviewing HubSpot dashboards to check overnight campaign results and pipeline movement, then meet with Sales to refine how AI-driven lead scores route new leads to the right reps. Later, you could be building an automated nurture workflow that personalizes content by specialty, analyzing an A/B test on a demo-request landing page, or running a quick attribution analysis to show leadership which channels are actually driving booked demos. Along the way, you're cleaning up data, documenting processes so they can be repeated, keeping marketing projects on track, and testing new AI tools to see where they can save the team time without compromising quality.

Success Metrics

  • Pipeline and revenue growth: Measurable increases in marketing-qualified leads (MQLs), demo requests, and marketing-sourced revenue.
  • Conversion improvements: Higher conversion rates across the website, landing pages, forms, and email campaigns, validated through A/B testing.
  • AI-driven efficiency: AI and automation workflows in place that reduce manual work, improve lead scoring accuracy, and speed up campaign execution.
  • Data quality and insight: Clean, reliable HubSpot data and accurate dashboards and attribution reporting that leadership uses to make decisions.
  • Operational excellence: Marketing projects delivered on time and within budget, with documented, repeatable processes adopted across Marketing, Sales, and Customer Service.

Location: Remote

Job Type: Full-time

Hours: Available during standard US business hours (9am-5pm EST or 8:30am-4:30pm EST)

This job description is intended to describe the general requirements for the position. It is not a complete statement of duties, responsibilities or requirements. Other duties not listed here may be assigned as necessary to ensure proper operations of the department.

WRS Health is an equal opportunity employer.

About the Role

Oxford Nanopore Technologies is seeking an experienced, commercially driven Account Executive based in Brazil to accelerate adoption of our next-generation sequencing technologies, including GridION and PromethION, across academic, government, biotechnology, and pharmaceutical markets in Latin America.

The ideal candidate will have a proven track record in sequencing technology sales and channel distribution management, with demonstrated success driving revenue through distributor and channel partner networks.

Working closely with regional channel partners and internal commercial and technical teams, you will develop new business, expand existing accounts, strengthen partner capabilities, and execute territory strategies that deliver sustainable revenue growth.

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences or a related scientific discipline preferred.
  • Minimum 5 years of field-based commercial experience within the life sciences industry.
  • Demonstrated commercial experience selling DNA/RNA sequencing technologies, including next-generation sequencing (NGS) platforms, instruments, or related solutions.
  • Proven experience managing and developing distributor/channel partner networks, including joint business planning, partner enablement, pipeline development, and revenue growth.
  • Strong understanding of sequencing workflows, applications, and customer requirements within academic, government, biotechnology, and pharmaceutical research environments.
  • Proven ability to develop territories, identify new business opportunities, and close complex, multi-stakeholder sales opportunities through channel partners.
  • Strong forecasting, pipeline management, strategic account planning, and negotiation capabilities.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and relationship-management skills, with the ability to influence both channel partners and end customers.
  • Ability to work independently within a matrixed, international commercial organization.
  • Proficiency with CRM systems and structured sales processes.
  • Fluency in English, Spanish, and Portuguese.

Nice to Have

  • Direct commercial experience with Oxford Nanopore, Illumina, PacBio, or other sequencing technology providers.
  • Established relationships with sequencing distributors, research institutions, and genomics customers across Brazil and Latin America.
  • Experience introducing emerging sequencing technologies or expanding market adoption within established NGS markets.
  • Experience working alongside Field Applications Scientists and technical specialists to support complex sales opportunities.

Oxford Nanopore Technologies is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We select and employ candidates based on their merits, qualifications, and ability to perform the responsibilities of the role, without regard to gender, marital status, race, religion, color, age, disability, sexual orientation, military status, or veteran status.

This position is based in Brazil and supports Oxford Nanopore Technologies' commercial operations in the region. As Oxford Nanopore Technologies does not currently maintain a legal employing entity in Brazil, the successful candidate will be employed through an authorized third-party employment partner in accordance with applicable Brazilian employment laws.

raw.description:
About Foundation

Foundation helps B2B tech and SaaS brands get found, cited and recommended when their buyers ask AI for solutions. We do it through Generative Engine Optimization (GEO): the research, content, distribution and optimization that build a brand's presence across LLMs, search, Reddit, YouTube and the sources they draw on.

The role

You run delivery for a $3M+ portfolio: either two or more delivery teams, or a flagship enterprise program that needs its own team. You lead other Program Directors and senior strategists, and you set the delivery standard everyone else follows. When a large client's team wants a straight answer on where things stand and what happens next, they get it from you.

On our enterprise accounts, AEO Program Directors lead the dedicated team that delivers the work: the plan, the people and the quality. AEO Marketing Directors own the client relationship, the strategic roadmap and the account's growth. You're client-facing every week, and the key relationship, renewals and expansions sit with the AEO Marketing Director.

Reports to: a Group AEO Marketing Director. Team: 8–15 people, including other Program Directors or senior strategists who lead teams of their own.

What you'll own

  • Delivery across the portfolio: one plan per client across every channel, with milestones, owners and dates, delivered on time and to standard.
  • Portfolio margin. You set effort estimates, staff to the hours budget and fix teams that drift.
  • Your leaders. You hire, develop and manage Program Directors and team leads, and decide who works on what.
  • Executive delivery conversations: working sessions, roadmap reviews and escalations with senior client stakeholders, alongside the AEO Marketing Director.
  • Capacity planning across the portfolio: when to hire, when to rebalance, and when a team is too full to take a new client.
  • Delivery standards and process across your teams, often holding a capability-lead role for one discipline.

What you bring

  • 10+ years in agency delivery, strategy or client services, including 4+ leading managers.
  • Experience running a $3M+ portfolio of multi-channel B2B marketing programs, including at least one enterprise account.
  • A strategist's background: you can review and improve the work, not just schedule it.
  • Strong commercial instincts on scope, effort and margin.
  • Working knowledge of how AI search is changing B2B buyer discovery.

Compensation

  • Base salary $120k–$145k depending on experience and location
  • Variable compensation: Target 15% of base, paid quarterly on portfolio margin, client retention and delivery quality. Where you land in the range depends on experience. US ranges may be adjusted for cost of labor in your state. Benefits are on top of base.

raw.description:
About Engine

Engine is the AI-native platform for intelligent travel. For a decade, Engine has built the proprietary technology and supply behind modern business travel, serving over 40,000 customers and nearly 2 million travelers, along with leading travel and AI companies that build on Engine's infrastructure. One system powers business travel, group travel, human agents, and AI agents.

That work has earned recognition as one of Fast Company's Best Workplaces for Innovators (2025), TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020–2026).

We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.

Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.

Your Mission
We’re seeking an OBT Partnerships Director to own go-to-market strategy and execution for the Engine OBT+ business, shaping how the company identifies, signs, and scales TMC partnerships.

You’ll build the OBT channel from the start, in one of the most entrepreneurial areas of the business. You’ll own GTM, close deals yourself, and influence the product, often before the playbook exists.

You’ll build and execute strategy, prospect and close your own book of TMC business, and serve as a senior cross-functional partner to Product, Engineering, Supply, Implementation, Legal, and Marketing. You’ll set the strategy and do the work, and you’ll represent Engine externally.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead GTM strategy and execution for Engine OBT+ and its TMC partnership portfolio, segmenting and prioritizing the TMC market by size, GDS, client mix, and readiness to switch
  • Prospect, negotiate, and close strategic TMC partnerships, owning your book of business from first outreach through contract, implementation handoff, and early launch
  • Structure commercial agreements (commission, override, and content economics) and define TMC value propositions, pricing and incentive inputs, and launch plans with Product, Finance, and GTM
  • Translate TMC opportunities into business cases with a clear ROI (including total cost of ownership versus incumbent tools) and clear product requirements, influencing the roadmap on GDS content, agent tooling, and expense and back-office integrations
  • Be the main point of contact between TMC partners and Engineering, Supply, Implementation, Legal, Finance, and Support, moving deals from concept to live bookings and turning TMC and agent feedback into a repeatable sales playbook
  • Represent Engine at corporate-travel industry events (e.g., GBTA) and executive-level TMC meetings, building its reputation as the booking platform TMCs want to work with

What You’ll Bring to Engine

  • 8–12+ years in business development, channel or strategic partnerships, or enterprise sales, ideally selling to or within TMCs, corporate travel, or travel technology, with a proven record of prospecting, negotiating, and closing complex deals
  • Experience building and executing GTM strategy for a new product or channel from zero, and comfort working independently when priorities are still being set
  • Strong cross-functional leadership, particularly with Product and Engineering, and the ability to build business cases that influence roadmap decisions
  • Excellent executive communication, negotiation, and stakeholder management skills, including representing Engine externally at conferences and industry events
  • Working knowledge of TMC operations, GDS economics (Sabre, Travelport, Amadeus), and corporate travel programs is a strong plus

Applications for this role will be accepted through December 31, 2026 or until the role is filled. We encourage you to apply early, as we may begin reviewing applications before the deadline.

Compensation
Our compensation packages are based on several factors, including your experience, expertise, and location. In addition to a competitive base salary, all roles receive equity. Depending on the role, total compensation may also include an annual bonus. Your recruiter will share your complete compensation package as you move through the process.

Base Pay Range
$195,000—$230,000 USD

The Engine Edge: Perks & Compensation
We believe in rewarding great work with great benefits:

  • Compensation: Competitive base pay tied to role and experience, with equity for all employees. Some roles are also eligible for bonuses or commissions.
  • Benefits: Check out our full list at
  • Environments for Success: Different roles have different needs in terms of the environments that drive success which is why we have a hybrid-hub model. Whether you are in one of our amazing offices or fully remote, we'll make sure you have what you need to succeed.

Perks and benefits may vary based on employment type, location, and more

raw.description:
At Roofr, we’re obsessed with our customers. We constantly gather feedback to shape, prioritize, and launch the products they truly need. That’s what makes Roofr’s CRM special. We started by building essential sales tools like aerial roof measurements and digital sales proposals. But when our customers asked for a simple, affordable way to manage and scale their entire businesses, we listened. So, we created a CRM that connects these solutions—along with payments, material ordering, and more—into a seamless, powerful platform. With a clear roadmap ahead, we’re excited to continue expanding and leading the market with innovative products.

We have an amazing culture, strong financials, and best-in-class company metrics. It’s an exciting time to be part of an extraordinary startup that is already successful, yet still early enough to offer its team significant growth, equity, and the opportunity to make a real impact.

This position is for an existing vacancy.

***A quick note: some of our emails may be filtered into your spam/junk folder. Please check there regularly for any communications from us, including interview scheduling, next steps, and updates on your application. If you find one of our emails in spam, please mark it as “Not Spam” to help ensure future messages reach your inbox.***

Roofr is growing our Onboarding team, and we're looking for a Spanish-speaking Onboarding Manager to own the most important window in a customer's journey: the moment they sign to the moment they're live, confident, and getting real value from Roofr.

We onboard hundreds of new customers every month across multiple products. Many of them run established roofing businesses but are new to technology, which means the way you show up matters as much as what you know. This role is built for someone who thrives in high-volume environments, believes great onboarding creates the conditions for everything that comes after, and finds real satisfaction in watching a customer go from uncertain to capable.

Your goal is simple: help customers feel the difference Roofr makes in their business as quickly as possible, and make sure getting there doesn't feel overwhelming. We pay attention to two things to know we're on track: how much of what a customer set out to use in Roofr they're actually working with day-to-day, and whether they'd say the onboarding experience genuinely helped them. Those signals tell us where customers are thriving and where we can do better. They're our compass.

What You’ll Do:

  • Own the full onboarding journey for net-new Roofr customers, from supporting them through Account Setup and training through to a clean handoff to their Customer Success Manager.
  • Manage multiple concurrent onboardings in a high-volume environment, balancing dedicated 1:1 sessions with scalable, group-based training.
  • Guide customers through Roofr in a way that’s practical, confidence-building, and tailored to their unique business workflows, goals, and level of technical experience.
  • Drive customers to a clear graduation milestone: they're live, self-sufficient, and ready for handoff to their Customer Success Manager..
  • Work closely with the Account Setup Team as an onboarding consultant, ensuring Roofr is configured to reflect each customer's real needs and lay the foundation for strong adoption.
  • Deliver engaging live training sessions and group webinars that drive real adoption, not just familiarity.
  • Partner cross-functionally with Sales, Account Management, Retention, Product, and the Customer Success team to surface friction, close gaps, and ensure every handoff is clean.
  • Contribute to the design and continuous improvement of Roofr's onboarding playbook, building something that scales, not just something that works today.
  • Act as a trusted guide during a high-stakes window, helping customers prioritize, build good habits, and set themselves up for long-term success in Roofr.

What You'll Bring to the Role:

  • Fluent in Spanish (written and spoken)
  • 2+ years of experience in customer onboarding, customer success, or enablement within an SMB, B2B, or SaaS environment
  • Experience working in a fast-paced, high-growth startup environment
  • Strong communication and presentation skills across live calls, video meetings, email, and webinars
  • Ability to build rapport quickly and adapt your approach based on customer goals, maturity, and engagement level
  • Proven ability to manage customer needs while making thoughtful, outcome-driven recommendations
  • Comfort demonstrating product value and guiding customers toward broader adoption and better business outcomes
  • High ownership mentality with the ability to work autonomously, manage competing priorities, and follow through consistently
  • Exceptional organization, time management, and attention to detail to deliver a reliable, high-quality onboarding experience

Who You Are:

  • A true customer advocate
  • Highly organized and results-oriented
  • Detail-obsessed (in the best way)
  • You know how to adapt your approach depending on who’s in front of you.
  • You are always looking for ways to improve and scale what works
  • Tech-savvy and comfortable learning new tools quickly

Compensation Band: $70,000.00 - $75,000.00 CAD

Our compensation ranges are built using multiple market benchmarks and reflect both the scope of the role and current market data. While many hires fall within the beginning to midpoint of the band to allow for growth over time, we tailor offers based on each candidate’s experience, seniority, and demonstrated impact.

🏠 What we offer (US + Canada)

When you join our team, you’re not just accepting a job. You’re making a career move. Here’s how we’ll support you in doing some of the most impactful work of your career:

🏝️ Vacation/Paid Time Off:

  • 1st week of employment is mandatory PTO! Start your journey with Roofr by decompressing and recharging - we will see you in week 2!
  • 1 Friday off per month (we call those our laundry days!)
  • Company wide paid shutdown for the week between Christmas and New Years
  • Flexible time off
  • 80% employer-paid benefits in the U.S. and 100% employer-paid premiums for Extended Healthcare and Dental in Canada
  • RRSP/401k match
  • Generous Parental Leave policy

🤝 Perks:

  • We host an annual company retreat with great team building activities
  • Ample learning and development opportunities to continue growing your career
  • Home office setup stipend
  • Internet and phone allowance
  • Remote first culture
  • Weekly Friday paydays!

🤖 AI Notice

At Roofr, we’re big fans of AI. It helps us write job descriptions that don’t put you to sleep, takes notes during interviews so we can actually listen, and even helps us track down awesome humans like you.

Feel free to use AI to prep, research, or get pumped up for your interview (we see you, ChatGPT power users 👀). But when it’s time to chat, we’d love to meet you, not your AI alter ego. Bring your real, unfiltered self, we promise we will too.

raw.excerpt: About Definitive Healthcare:At Definitive Healthcare (NASDAQ: DH), we’re passionate about turning data, analytics, and expertise into meaningful intelligence that helps our customers achieve success and shape the future of healthcare.
raw.description:
About Definitive Healthcare:

At Definitive Healthcare (NASDAQ: DH), we’re passionate about turning data, analytics, and expertise into meaningful intelligence that helps our customers achieve success and shape the future of healthcare. We empower them to uncover the right markets, opportunities, and people—paving the way for smarter decisions and greater impact.

Headquartered just outside of Boston, Massachusetts, Definitive Healthcare operates across North America, Europe, and India, supporting a growing global client base of more than 2,400 customers since our founding in 2011.

We’re also a great place to work. In 2024 and 2025, we earned multiple workplace honors, including Built In’s 100 Best Places to Work in Boston (both years), a Stevie Bronze Award for Great Employers, and recognition as a Great Place to Work in India.

We foster a collaborative, inclusive culture where diverse perspectives drive innovation. Through programs like DefinitiveCares and our employee-led affinity groups we strive to promote connection, education, and inclusion.

About the position:

The Senior Customer Success Manager owns the end-to-end customer experience and net dollar retention (NDR) for a portfolio of enterprise life sciences customers at Definitive Healthcare. Serving as the primary post-sale point of contact, this role drives product adoption, documents measurable ROI, and directly influences renewal and expansion outcomes. The Senior CSM combines a structured, value-selling methodology with deep life sciences industry knowledge to connect data adoption to business outcomes customers can see and quantify, coordinating across Commercial, Medical, Market Access, Marketing, R&D, and HEOR teams within assigned accounts. Operating as a credible, strategic counterpart to customer C-suite stakeholders, the role carries direct accountability for a $5M+ enterprise book of business and a 95%+ NDR target. Success in this role is measured by renewal rates, expansion revenue, and the strength of documented ROI across the portfolio.

What you'll do:

  • Customer Lifecycle Ownership: Own the customer experience across the full lifecycle, including onboarding, adoption, renewal, and expansion, with each stage tied to a clear, documented business outcome.
  • Value-Selling & ROI Documentation: Apply value-selling methodology to build and maintain account-level business cases that quantify the ROI delivered through product usage, analytics, and services.
  • Onboarding Leadership: Lead onboarding by aligning stakeholders on priority use cases and setting measurable adoption targets from day one.
  • Executive Business Reviews: Run QBRs and executive reviews centered on documented value, with strategic roadmaps, outcomes achieved, and ROI realized.
  • Renewal Risk Management: Proactively identify and neutralize renewal risk by deploying risk mitigation strategies that protect NDR before risk is communicated.
  • Renewal & Expansion Strategy: Own the renewal narrative by translating delivered value into a renewal/expansion business case, partnering with Account Management to directly influence renewal decisions and negotiate expansion.
  • Account Value Roadmapping: Maintain a living value roadmap per account, including key stakeholder mapping, to proactively identify expansion opportunities backed by documented ROI.
  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Coordinate across Product, Sales, Marketing, Advanced Analytics, and subject matter experts to resolve customer needs quickly and consistently.

What you'll need:

  • 5-7+ years of deep experience as a Customer Success Manager, ideally within a DaaS, pharmaceuticals, or consulting environment.
  • Demonstrated strategic ownership of a $5M+ enterprise book of business, with accountability for renewal and net dollar retention (NDR) targets across the portfolio.
  • Proven track record using value-selling and ROI documentation to retain and grow an enterprise portfolio at 95%+ NDR.
  • Ability to operate as a credible, strategic counterpart to customer C-suite stakeholders.
  • Strong understanding of life sciences workflows (Commercial, Medical, Market Access, Marketing, R&D, HEOR) and the ability to connect data adoption to quantifiable business outcomes.
  • This is a quota/NDR-accountable individual contributor role; the job description does not indicate people-management responsibility.

Compensation and Benefits:

The salary range for this position is $92,800 - $139,200 per year, which represents the base pay the company reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for this role. Actual pay within this range will be determined based on factors such as relevant experience, skills, and qualifications.

Depending on the position, employees may also be eligible to participate in a company bonus or commission plan. All employees are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, unlimited paid time off, and participation in the company’s 401(k) plan with employer contribution.

Why we love Definitive, and why you will too!

  • Industry leading products
  • Work hard, and have fun doing it
  • Incredibly fast growth means limitless opportunity
  • Flexible and dynamic culture
  • Work alongside some of the most talented and dedicated teammates
  • Definitive Cares, our community service group, gives all of us a chance to give back
  • Competitive benefits package including great healthcare benefits and a 401(k) match

What our Employees are saying about us on Glassdoor:

“Great Work atmosphere, great work life balance, excellent company to work for, amazing top notch product, incredible customer service, lots of tools to help you succeed.”

-Business Development Manager

“Great team. Amazing growth. Employees are treated very well.”

-Research Analyst

“I have waited 36 years to work at a dream job for a dream company and I am so happy to have finally got there.”

-Profile Analyst

If you don’t fit all of these qualifications, but believe you’re still a great fit, feel free to apply and tell us why in your cover letter.

If you are a California, Colorado, New York City or Washington resident and this role is a remote role, you can receive additional information about the compensation and benefits for this role, which we will provide upon request.

Definitive Hiring Philosophy

Definitive Healthcare is an equal opportunity employer that celebrates diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive workplace with equal opportunity for all applicants and teammates. Our goal is to recruit the most talented people from a diverse candidate pool regardless of race, color, religion, age, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation or any other status. If you’re interested in working in a fast growing, exciting working environment – we encourage you to apply!

Privacy
Your privacy is important to us. Please review our Candidate Privacy Notice which tells you how we use and process your personal information.

Please note: All communications regarding the hiring process at Definitive Healthcare will come directly from one of our corporate recruiters or coordinators using an @definitivehc.com email address. We do not advertise open roles on Facebook and will never request money transfers or ask candidates to purchase equipment with a promise of reimbursement. If you receive any suspicious communication, please contact to verify your status in the application process.

Job Summary:

The Controls Engineer is an Engineering Services support position, responsible for the continuous improvement and support of new and existing technical solutions. The role works directly with Engineering, Maintenance, IT, and Operations to ensure technical solutions continue to evolve with the business and manufacturing process. Constant focus on maximizing equipment intelligence, safety and efficiency while looking for ways to minimize repetitive human interactions. Resource that will work with Engineering, Maintenance, Operations, IT, and OEMs’ to ensure networking standards and requirements are followed. Aid in the development and continuous improvement of current Electrical standards and best practices. This role is remote with travel and support to all sites within the network wherever the need may be, with primary focus to initially be in the Chicagoland area. This individual can reside near a plant located in the Chicago area, McComb, OH, Grand Rapids, MI or Michigan City, IN.

Job Duties:

  • Drive continuous improvement in all smart plant and equipment objectives
  • Design control systems that provide instantaneous feedback to operators and supervisors
  • Work with OT Support Engineer and maintenance to create user applications to monitor and control production processes
  • Assist Plant Engineering team with electrical engineering design and review for new and existing equipment installations
  • Industrial Controller (PLC) programming and Human Machine Interface (HMI) design, development, and troubleshooting
  • Wonderware System Platform development and troubleshooting
  • Provide formal and informal training on OT systems as system changes are implemented
  • Develop and maintain asset registers for each site related to OT systems
  • Expose data from new and existing sensors for MES data collection
  • Automation system support, development, and troubleshooting (Robotics, Vision, Gantry, Storage, etc.)
  • Develop and support OT Disaster Recovery processes and procedures
  • Travel up to, but not limited to 50% as required to support other sites
  • Maintain up to date passport for travel outside of the USA as required

Required Competencies & Knowledge:

Knowledge of:

  • Baking, and food processing equipment
  • Rotating machinery; Servo motors, AC induction motors, and DC motors
  • Robotics and integrated systems
  • Project Management Methodologies
  • Other non-standard controls software, Siemens, Omron, Mitsubishi,

• CMMS

  • AutoCAD
  • Visio

Skill in:

  • Electrical to include; AC/DC theory, transformers, power supplies, VFD(s), AC/DC motor starters/controls, relay logic, EIP networking
  • Ladder logic code development
  • PID loop logic
  • Allen Bradley controls platforms; RS Logix 500, 5000, Panel builder, and Studio 5000
  • AutoCAD electrical drawing development
  • High and low voltage troubleshooting
  • Intermediate to advanced excel
  • Financial analysis and budgeting
  • Leadership and strong communication skills
  • Gantt chart development
  • Project management
  • Presentation skills

Ability to:

  • Design new electrical schematics using AutoCAD electrical
  • Work with vendors and internal team to identify correct products for our machinery
  • Generate bill of materials and project related documentation
  • Generate PLC and HMI programs for process and packaging machinery
  • Review electrical drawings/schematics and provide feedback to the team related to corrections and or revisions needed to accomplish end goal of the process
  • Assist in operational checkout of machinery as required for FAT/SAT
  • Development of operating and user manuals as required for new and existing processes
  • Troubleshoot existing machinery and production lines
  • Use AB and Siemens motion control software
  • Communicate cross-functionally to gain alignment of goals and objectives related to project
  • Coach/Mentor project team members as necessary
  • Perform financial analysis as it relates to ROI, Payback, IRR, as well as budget development, budget tracking and financial close-out
  • Convert older/obsolete controls components, PLCs’, HMIs’, VFDs’, Servos’
  • Manage projects and work with limited supervision
  • Exercise independent judgment

Proficiency in:

  • MS Office Suite specifically; Project, Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook
  • Allen Bradley controls platforms; RS Logix 500, 5000, Panel builder, and Studio 5000
  • AutoCAD

Work Environment:

  • Work is primarily done in a manufacturing setting at eight (8) to twelve (12) hour shifts
  • Continuous production environment exposure, which includes: noise, dust, moving machinery, fork lifts and fluctuations in temperature

Physical Requirements:

  • Standing for extended periods of time
  • Stand, walk and climb stairs on a frequent basis
  • Must be able to lift 100 pounds on an infrequent basis

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering preferred or work-related experience
  • 5 or more years’ experience with Allen Bradley controls platforms; RS Logix 500, 5000, Panel builder, and Studio 5000
  • Minimum 3 years’ experience in project engineering
  • Minimum 3 years’ experience in project management
  • Minimum 3 years’ experience in AutoCAD
  • Minimum 3 years’ experience in food experience preferred

Familiarity with and knowledge of IT infrastructure The pay range for this full-time, salaried position is $85,788 -$128,682/year. Individual base pay depends on work location and additional factors such as experience, job-related skills, and relevant education or training. The position is eligible for a discretionary annual incentive based on company and individual performance. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, 401k and wellness benefits beginning on the first day of employment. This information is provided per the relevant state and local pay transparency laws for the location in which this position will be performed. Base pay information is based on market location. Sponsorship for work authorization is not available for this position. It is the candidate’s responsibility to ensure they are legally authorized to work in the location to which they apply.

Digital assets are redefining how wealth is created, used, and transferred. Since 2018 at Nexo, we have been building the future model of financial wealth - dynamic, accessible, and designed for a new generation of forward-thinking investors.

But technology alone doesn’t drive progress. People do.

We are a team of builders, strategists, analysts, creatives, and operators united by a shared mindset: advancement. We move fast, think long term, and take ownership. We challenge ideas, not people. We value clarity over noise and impact over optics.

What makes Nexo different?

We shape industry trends. We rethink how wealth works and build solutions that reflect that belief.

That requires a certain kind of person.

You will thrive here when you think independently and act decisively, take ownership without waiting for permission, and care deeply about quality, long-term value, and disciplined execution. The people who succeed at Nexo bring analytical depth, sound judgment, and resilience - but also curiosity and the drive to keep improving.

This is an environment for people who want to lead, create, and elevate what already exists. If building what’s next excites you, you’ll feel at home at Nexo.

Official website:

Your role:

  • Identify, pursue, and close high-value clients who have never worked with Nexo before.
  • Build a pipeline that fuels long-term revenue growth across our Private Client segment.
  • Originate new business by prospecting, qualifying, and converting high-net-worth individuals and institutional contacts across global markets. You own the pipeline from first touch to signed client.
  • Develop and execute outbound strategies across all relevant channels, including email, phone, social, messaging apps, and in-person events, to generate qualified opportunities at scale.
  • Build a network by attending industry events, conferences, and private gatherings to position Nexo within HNWI and institutional circles.
  • Navigate complex sales cycles - understand client structures, investment preferences, and decision-making dynamics to tailor compelling proposals that close.
  • Collaborate with Account Management to ensure a seamless handover once clients are onboarded, with full context on the relationship, expectations, and opportunity.
  • Maintain a disciplined pipeline in Salesforce - every touchpoint, every opportunity, every forecast accurate and up to date.

What makes you stand out:

  • 3–5 years in a business development, new business sales, or client acquisition role within fintech, financial services, wealth management, or digital assets.
  • A proven track record of sourcing and closing deals - you can point to revenue you personally originated.
  • A natural ability to open doors and start conversations with senior decision-makers and high-net-worth individuals.

Nexo benefits:

  • Annual performance-based bonuses.

raw.description:
Bei CmdScale lösen wir komplexe Probleme an der Schnittstelle von High-Performance Software Engineering und strategischer IT-Beratung. Wir bieten dir die Chance mit namhaften Marktführern und Global Playern zu und diese in der Entwicklung von High-End -Software zu unterstützen und Sie auf C-Level- und Architekturebene zu beraten.

Für diese Rolle suchen wir eine Persönlichkeit, die Go nicht nur als Programmiersprache, sondern als Werkzeug für hocheffiziente Infrastrukturen versteht und diese Expertise souverän in Richtung Kunde kommunizieren kann.

Aufgaben

Was dich bei uns erwartet:

  • High-Impact Projekte: Nach einer fokussierten Onboarding-Phase übernehmen Sie unmittelbar Verantwortung in geschäftskritischen Projekten. Sie agieren auf Augenhöhe mit dem Kunden und setzen Ihre Visionen in skalierbare Architekturen um.
  • Maximale Entscheidungsfreiheit: Wir bieten den Raum für eigenverantwortliches Handeln ohne lähmende Regularien. Bei uns zählt das technische Ergebnis und die wirtschaftliche Nachhaltigkeit der Lösung.
  • Exzellenz-Kultur: Sie arbeiten in einem Umfeld aus Senior Engineers und Gleichgesinnten. Unser Fokus liegt auf leidenschaftlichem technischem Austausch, Open-Source-First und kontinuierlicher Weiterentwicklung auf höchstem Niveau.
  • Professionelles Framework: Wir bieten einen unbefristeten, sicheren Arbeitsplatz mit gelebter Remote-Kultur. Da wir unsere Kunden punktuell auch vor Ort unterstützen, setzen wir eine moderate Reisebereitschaft (ca. 1x pro Quartal) voraus.

Qualifikation

Deine Skill Checkliste:

  • Go Expertise: Du verfügst über mindestens 5 Jahre nachweisbare Erfahrung in der professionellen Entwicklung mit Rust. Du beherrschtConcurrency-Patterns und das Go-Ökosystem auf Experten-Level.
  • Consulting-Mindset: Du bist es gewohnt, Kunden auf professionellem Niveau zu beraten. Du kannst komplexe Sachverhalte strukturieren und sicher vor Gruppen vertreten - du bist fachlich versiert und rhetorisch sicher.

Die Übersicht soll dir nur eine erste Orientierung geben mit welchen Tech-Stacks wir in unseren Projekten zu tun haben.

Go, Rust, TypeScript, Python, C++, C#/.NET

raw.description:
Senior Director, Payments — Remote (US)

EverCommerce (Nasdaq: EVCM) is a leading service commerce platform providing vertically tailored, integrated SaaS solutions that help more than 745,000 global service-based businesses accelerate growth, streamline operations, and increase retention. Across EverPro, EverHealth, and EverWell, EverCommerce provides business management software, embedded payment acceptance, and customer engagement solutions designed around the needs of service-based businesses.


The Opportunity

We are looking for a Senior Director, Payments to help shape and execute the next phase of growth for EverCommerce’s payments business. This is a senior, highly cross-functional leadership role responsible for translating our payments strategy into products, capabilities, and commercial outcomes across the EverCommerce portfolio. The Senior Director will work across product, engineering, go-to-market, customer experience, operations, data, and our individual software businesses to identify opportunities, establish priorities, and drive execution.

The ideal candidate combines deep payments expertise with strong product and commercial instincts. You understand how payments create value within vertical SaaS platforms and can move comfortably between strategy and execution—from identifying a market opportunity or customer problem to defining the solution, aligning stakeholders, launching the capability, and measuring the resulting business impact.

You will bring significant experience in integrated and embedded payments, SaaS, APIs, payment facilitation, merchant acquiring, and the broader payments ecosystem. Just as importantly, you will be a strong business leader who can simplify complex problems, influence across organizational boundaries, and build alignment around the opportunities that matter most.

What You’ll Do

Drive Payments Strategy and Growth

  • Help define and execute the payments strategy across EverCommerce, with a focus on sustainable revenue growth, customer value, and competitive differentiation.
  • Identify and prioritize opportunities across the payments customer lifecycle, including enablement, merchant acquisition and onboarding, activation, retention, wallet share, pricing, and monetization.
  • Translate market, customer, competitive, and financial insights into clear priorities and executable plans.
  • Own business outcomes associated with payments initiatives, including adoption, processing volume, revenue, retention, customer experience, and profitability.
  • Develop business cases and recommendations for new products, capabilities, partnerships, and investments.

Lead Payments Product and Commercialization

  • Define customer, merchant, partner, and developer needs and translate them into differentiated payments capabilities.
  • Partner closely with Product and Engineering to establish roadmaps and prioritize investments based on customer and business value.
  • Drive the evolution and adoption of key payments capabilities, including card and ACH acceptance, recurring payments, invoicing, surcharging, mobile and in-person payments, onboarding, APIs, and other emerging payment experiences.
  • Drive embedded finance solution strategy and growth including instant payouts, merchant lending, consumer financing, and issuing
  • Help shape the future of PaySimple and EverCommerce’s broader payments platform, including how payments capabilities are delivered across internal SaaS solutions and external partners.
  • Ensure new capabilities have clear commercialization, adoption, and measurement plans—not simply technical launch plans.
  • Partner with Sales, Marketing, Customer Experience, and Operations to improve adoption and utilization of both new and existing payments capabilities.

Represent the Customer and the Market

  • Develop a deep understanding of merchants, SaaS partners, developers, and end customers and the problems they are trying to solve.
  • Establish effective feedback loops with customers, partners, sales teams, customer experience teams, and other stakeholders.
  • Maintain a strong understanding of the competitive landscape and emerging trends across embedded payments, merchant acquiring, vertical SaaS, payment facilitation, and financial technology.
  • Use quantitative and qualitative data to identify opportunities, validate hypotheses, and make informed investment decisions.
  • Understands and can drive ecommerce and card present acceptance in EMEA, ANZ, and LATAM markets.

Drive Cross-Functional Execution

  • Lead complex initiatives that span Product, Engineering, Operations, Risk, Sales, Marketing, Customer Experience, Finance, and Data.
  • Create clarity around objectives, ownership, milestones, dependencies, and success measures.
  • Build alignment across business units and functional teams that may have different priorities and operating models.
  • Identify execution risks and remove barriers that prevent teams from delivering customer and business outcomes.
  • Establish clear metrics and operating rhythms to track progress and hold teams accountable for results.

Build and Develop High-Performing Teams

  • Lead, coach, and develop payments and product talent, creating an environment characterized by high standards, strong ownership, curiosity, and collaboration.
  • Attract and develop high-performing team members as the payments organization evolves.
  • Set clear expectations and create accountability for both individual and team outcomes.
  • Foster strong partnerships across Product, Engineering, Commercial, Operations, and other functional organizations.

What You’ll Bring

  • 10+ years of experience in payments, fintech, SaaS, product management, or related businesses, with significant experience in integrated or embedded payments.
  • Deep knowledge of the payments ecosystem, including merchant acquiring, processors, gateways, payment facilitators, card networks, ACH, and payments risk.
  • Demonstrated experience building, launching, commercializing, or scaling payments products and capabilities.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS and API-based products and the role payments can play within vertical software platforms.
  • Proven ability to translate strategy into execution and measurable business outcomes.
  • Experience driving revenue growth, adoption, retention, processing volume, or other commercial payments metrics.
  • Strong financial and analytical capabilities, including experience developing business cases and understanding the economic drivers of a payments business.
  • Experience leading complex, cross-functional initiatives in matrixed organizations.
  • Strong executive communication skills and the ability to communicate complex payments concepts clearly to technical, commercial, and executive audiences.
  • Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and drive decisions without relying solely on organizational authority.

What Success Looks Like

Where

The EverCommerce team is distributed globally, with teams across the U.S., Canada, the U.K., New Zealand, and Australia. With a widely distributed team, we are accustomed to working remotely across different time zones.

raw.title: Director, Digital Strategy
raw.excerpt: About BuildersBuilders is a non-partisan movement of millions, uniting Americans across lines of difference - grounded in the belief that curiosity, compassion, courage, and creativity can move us beyond division.
raw.description:
About Builders

Builders is a non-partisan movement of millions, uniting Americans across lines of difference - grounded in the belief that curiosity, compassion, courage, and creativity can move us beyond division. Founded by Daniel Lubetzky, our community spans 5M+ citizens, 650M video views, and 400+ movement partners including José Andrés, Katie Couric, Adam Grant, Lonnie Ali, and Karl Rove. Through a growing ecosystem of content, tools, partnerships, and activations, we turn civic engagement into meaningful action - empowering people to participate, collaborate, and deliver real-world impact to enact lasting change.

About the Position

Builders has built something rare: a highly engaged, cross-partisan community who are actively leaning in. The infrastructure is there. The audience is real. Now we need a strategic digital leader who knows how to take it to the next level as part of our forward-thinking Marketing team.

The Director of Digital Strategy sits at the center of four interconnected priorities: social strategy, paid media, audience insights, and platform growth. Developing and executing strategies across every platform that deepen engagement with our existing community while systematically expanding our reach to new audiences. That means owning how Builders shows up and scales across every channel - from Instagram and TikTok to YouTube, where there is a significant opportunity to build a strong, engaged presence - while ensuring every campaign and content decision is grounded in data and driving measurable results.

This is a high-ownership role for someone who is equally at home in the data as they are in the cultural conversation. You know what makes audiences grow, what makes them stay, and what makes them act. You understand how platforms work - algorithmically, culturally, and commercially - and you bring the analytical rigor and creative instinct to turn that knowledge into compounding results. Critically, you don’t just measure digital performance: you own the insights function across campaigns, serving as the connective tissue between strategy and execution and ensuring the organization always knows how its work is landing.

Reporting to the CMO, you will partner closely with the Creative Director and the Editorial Director to ensure digital strategy, content, and communications are integrated and moving at the speed of culture. This is an opportunity to cultivate and shape how one of the most important civic movements and communities grows - and to build the systems that make that growth sustainable.

Responsibilities

Social Media Strategy & Community Building

  • Own Builders’ social media strategy across all platforms - setting the vision, standards, and playbooks that guide how the team shows up, engages, and grows across every channel. Develop platform-specific strategies that reflect how audiences actually behave on each channel.
  • Lead and develop the social media team, fostering a culture of creativity, experimentation, and accountability to both quality and performance.
  • Prioritize community quality over vanity metrics, developing strategies that build a highly engaged, loyal audience rather than chasing follower counts, and setting the organizational standard for what meaningful engagement looks like.
  • Develop and execute a creator strategy that spans ideological diversity - finding credible voices on both the left and right who can authentically carry cross-partisan, solutions-oriented stories.
  • Lead YouTube strategy as a significant growth opportunity - developing a channel vision, content framework, and growth plan that builds Builders’ presence into a meaningful destination for civic storytelling and community engagement.
  • Stay ahead of platform algorithm changes, emerging formats, and cultural trends - translating shifts in the landscape into concrete recommendations the team can act on quickly.

Paid Media Strategy

  • Lead paid media strategy across social, search, and programmatic channels - owning the approach to audience targeting, creative testing, and spend allocation.
  • Partner with the CMO on budget planning and media mix decisions, bringing data-driven recommendations on where investment will drive the greatest growth.
  • Develop and manage a rigorous creative testing framework - ensuring every campaign generates learnings that compound over time.
  • Oversee paid media execution in partnership with external agencies or in-house teams, holding partners accountable to performance standards and strategic alignment.
  • Continuously optimize campaigns based on performance data, adjusting targeting, creative, and spend in real time - ensuring campaign learnings compound over time.

Insights, Analytics & Performance

  • Serve as the organization’s strategic lead on campaign insights - owning the frameworks, dashboards, and reporting cadences that give the CMO and senior leadership a clear, integrated view of how strategy is being realized through execution across all channels, not just digital.
  • Define and track social & media KPIs across awareness, engagement, conversion, and audience growth - connecting the dots between what was planned, what was executed, and what actually moved the needle.
  • Translate performance data into clear, actionable recommendations that inform future strategy - identifying what’s working, what isn’t, and where the organization should double down or course correct.
  • Own social listening as a strategic function by using qualitative signals, audience sentiment, and conversation trends to inform content strategy, identify emerging opportunities, and understand how Builders’ message is landing in the real world.

Technology & AI

  • Champion smart, strategic use of AI and emerging technology tools across digital workflows - from content optimization and audience targeting to reporting automation and trend detection.
  • Evaluate and recommend tools that increase the team’s speed, precision, and impact - with a focus on tools that enhance strategy rather than replace it.
  • Stay informed on the evolving AI and martech landscape, bringing forward-looking recommendations to the CMO on where technology can give Builders a meaningful edge.

Cross-Functional Leadership

  • Serve as the digital strategy thought partner to the CMO, Creative Director, and Editorial Director - bringing data and platform expertise into every major content, campaign, and communications decision.
  • Partner with the Editorial Director, Creative Director, GTM lead, Civic Impact team, and Daniel Lubetzy’s social team to ensure social strategy and content are tightly integrated - the right message reaching the right audience in the right format on the right channel.
  • Manage external vendors, analytics partners, and paid media agencies - setting clear expectations, holding partners accountable, and ensuring strategic alignment.

Requirements

Required

  • 7-10 years of experience in digital strategy, growth marketing, or paid media - with a portfolio that demonstrates both strategic leadership and hands-on execution.
  • Deep, current fluency across major social and digital platforms - you understand how they work algorithmically, culturally, and commercially, and you stay ahead of how they’re changing.
  • Proven track record of driving measurable audience growth and engagement through integrated organic and paid digital strategies.
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort with data - you can build a performance framework, interpret the results, and translate them into strategy without needing a data team to do it for you.
  • Experience leading paid media campaigns across social, search, and programmatic channels, including budget ownership and agency management.
  • Exceptional strategic communication skills - you can synthesize complex data and platform dynamics into clear and compelling recommendations for senior leadership.
  • A genuine pulse on culture: you consume media voraciously, you notice what’s breaking through and why, and you bring that instinct into your strategic thinking.
  • Experience working in a fast-moving, mission-driven, or startup-like environment where you’ve had to build systems while simultaneously executing against them.
  • Collaborative and entrepreneurial by nature - you thrive in cross-functional environments and know how to bring editorial, creative, and marketing teams along with you.
  • Genuine enthusiasm for the Builders mission and the ability to apply your craft in service of a cross-partisan, solutions-oriented civic movement.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in civic, advocacy, nonprofit, or public affairs communications.
  • Experience scaling digital audiences for a media brand, movement, or public figure.
  • Exposure to AI-assisted marketing workflows and tools.

Benefits

  • Competitive annual compensation [$135,000 - $150,000]
  • Excellent health, dental & vision insurance with company coverage options of 100%
  • 25 days Paid Time Off (20 personal, 5 sick)
  • 401K with company match
  • Flexible, remote work environment
  • Charitable gift matching program
  • The opportunity to make a real impact through your day-to-day work

EEO

At Builders, we are committed to an inclusive workplace where diversity in all its forms is championed. Builders is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability status, gender identity, or veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. For applicants with disabilities, our recruiting team will actively work with you to accommodate any needs in order for you to be able to interview at your best.

raw.description:
Based in Washington, D.C., Quorum is a fast-growing software company and is the leading provider of workflow software and information services for government affairs professionals across the corporations, non-profits, associations, and governmental end-markets. Quorum allows users to manage stakeholder engagement, launch grassroots advocacy campaigns, and track legislative activity at all levels of government, including federal, state and local.

Quorum provides mission-critical solutions to public affairs professionals for their work in Congress, all 50 state legislatures, major U.S. cities, the European Union, and 30+ countries around the globe. Quorum serves over 2,000 customers globally including over 50% of the Fortune 100, and has over 350 team members across the globe. The company recently acquired Capitol Canary, a market leader in grassroots advocacy software.

As our Deal Desk Specialist, you will be the go to expert and leader on configuring, pricing, quoting, and closing deals for Quorum’s client subscriptions, bringing together colleagues from across the organization to establish and apply consistent rules and make the sales process more efficient. You will be responsible for ensuring that Quorum delights our clients by providing an accurate, transparent, and timely contract review and approval process, and that our sales team performs at a high level by efficiently selling and closing deals that serve our clients’ needs and Quorum’s business goals.

What You'll Do

  • First week: You'll learn Quorum’s products and pricing rules as well as the ins and outs of Quorum’s Salesforce-based Quote and Subscription Agreement processes, gain exposure to our client’s perspective on our contract workflow, and get to know Quorum’s tight-knit Sales Operations team, which is a unit of the Business Development function headed by our Chief Sales Officer.

  • First month: You will begin to advise sales team members on the configuration and pricing of deals and review sales documentation when deals close to verify accuracy of information including, but not limited to, contract terms, billing information, pricing, and consistency with company policies.

  • First 6 months: You will learn the context necessary to support the Deal Desk Analyst during high-volume periods to complete technical risk assessments and review draft Quotes in Salesforce. You will take ownership of Quorum’s complete product price list. You will centralize and modify deal close workflows to improve the accuracy, transparency, and timeliness of Quorum’s deal process for our team members, clients, and vendors. You will conduct a Quality Assurance Audit on 100% of active client subscriptions and vendor agreements. Through this process, you will document and remediate any errors identified (e.g., contract covers a 366 day “annual” period instead of a 365 day “annual” period, contract references outdated technical specifications, etc.).

  • First year: You will also work with sales, customer success, finance, and product to build the foundational processes for a high-performing Deal Desk that can quickly review and close high-value new logo and renewal customers with unique circumstances (e.g., special pricing, product commitment, etc.).

About You

  • You consider attention to detail to be one of your signature strengths. In a room full of 1,000 professionals, you would feel comfortable raising your hand to indicate that you are in the Top 5% in terms of overall attention to detail—and your previous colleagues would agree!

  • You have honed the ability to creatively apply logic and business standards to solve an unfamiliar problem.

  • You are comfortable making sense of technical, legal, and procurement jargon and navigating commercial processes.

  • You have some professional experience working with commercial contracts in a business environment or working on or adjacent to a Sales Operations team with a Deal Desk function.

  • You care deeply about being a part of building an inclusive, supportive, and diverse team environment.

  • You will stand out if you have experience with Federal contracts or have a Federal certification (e.g., DAWIA), security clearance, or military background.

  • You will stand out if you have experience working with Salesforce CPQ and/or revenue management software, such as SaaS Optics or NetSuite.

  • You are a superstar if you have previous experience in a Deal Desk role.

About the Sales Operations Team

  • We take pride in keeping the metaphorical train on its track at a high-growth start-up.

  • We are the resident subject matter experts on business operations—our team covers sales operations, and finance.

  • We believe that precedent is not best practice—we are constantly striving to improve our own workflow. In doing so, we live by Quorum’s growth principles to Take the Lead and Own the Execution.

  • We pay attention to the details and have pride in the work we do, knowing that our team helps provide peace of mind to our team members, clients, and vendors.

  • We're close as a company—we work together, spend time together, and value each others' ideas and input.

Our Work Environment

  • We are a remote-first team with flexible work options: work remotely, or you may choose to come into our office in Belo Horizonte.

  • Our team loves to spend time doing fun things outside of the office - both together and remote, which we call Quorum Fun events. Past Quorum Fun events have included apple picking, yoga, virtual art classes and wine tasting.

If you'd like to learn what it's like to have a real impact at a fast-growing company that is changing the way the advocacy process works, drop us a line. We'd love to talk to you!

Compensation

This is a full time CLT Opportunity.

Benefits

  • Flexible Paid Time Off

  • Standard Brazil holidays plus additional company-wide days off for team members to rest and recharge

  • Free Subscription to the Calm App

  • Free Subscription to LinkedIn Learning to support professional development

  • Invest in Yourself Days - one designated day per quarter is dedicated to your professional development!

  • Monthly Work from Home Stipend

  • Mental and Dental Care by SulAmérica

  • Virtual and in-person team events

  • Mental Health stipend

  • Alelo Food Voucher

  • In company English classes

  • Inclusion & Diversity Affinity Groups to support belonging

Please submit your resume in English.

We comply with all requirements for US government federal contractors issued by the OFCCP, IFR, and the terms of our government contracts.

EEO/AA/F/M/Vet/Disabled

Description

Projects Managers with experience in Dermatology and/or Rheumatology are crucial to the success of Clinical Trials managed by Indero. They are the main point of contact internally as well as externally, ensuring all activities and deliverables are completed on time, on budget, and as expected.

Great project managers go further than creating project plans and following up on tasks. They show leadership to help project teams focus on objectives and deliver results.

This role will be perfect for you if:

  • You want to work for a mid-sized CRO that works on significant multisite trials, including Global Phase III projects
  • You are looking to position yourself in an environment where you can grow your career alongside the company

IMPACT AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Client interactions

  • Serve as primary contact for the Sponsor
  • Provide efficient and timely updates on trial progress
  • Lead client calls effectively

Project planning

  • Oversee and actively participates in the preparation of project deliverables such as; study plans, protocol, informed consent form, electronic case report form (eCRF), tables/listings/figures (TLFs), clinical study report.
  • Participate in the planning and conduct of the Investigator’s Meeting.
  • Ensure that each site has the necessary material to adequately perform the study (e.g., investigational product, study supplies, special equipment, safety lab kits, etc.).

Quality and risk management

  • Ensure assigned studies are “audit ready” at all times.
  • Monitor the quality of study deliverables, (including vendor and SubCRO deliverables) and address issues as they arise.
  • Manage risk and control measures to assure project quality.
  • Analyze discrepancies between planned and actual results.
  • Review and approve responses to quality assurance audits.

Project budget and timelines

  • Control the project budget, with particular attention to internal hours allocated to all activities.
  • Identify out of scope activities for change orders.
  • Proactively manage operational aspects of the clinical trial including trial timelines, budget, resources and vendors. Coordinate tasks and deliverables from all functional departments involved in the project.
  • Communicate effectively with study team members, functional departments, and senior management.
  • Manage and report on recruitment status and highlight initiatives needed to meet recruitment timelines.

Project team leadership

  • Lead the core project team which may include: Associate Project Managers, Project Coordinators, Project Assistants.
  • Ensure all team members have adequate training on the project.
  • Work closely with vendors and the following internal teams to ensure all tasks and deliverables are completed on time, according to plans and according to applicable standards: Site Selection, Regulatory Affairs, Data Management, Clinical Monitoring, Biostatistics, Scientific Affairs.

Requirements

IDEAL PROFILE

Education

  • B.Sc. in a relevant discipline

Experience

  • At least 7 years of industry experience, including a minimum of 5 years leading multi-center clinical trials (phase II-III)
  • Experience leading concurrent multi-centered clinical trials with budgets in excess of $3M USD
  • Experience managing dermatology trials
  • Experience managing rheumatology trials an asset

Knowledge and skills

  • Excellent knowledge of GCP and ICH standards, FDA and local country regulations
  • Excellent knowledge of Microsoft Office suite
  • Fluency in English with excellent oral and written skills, required
  • Ability to work in a team environment and establish good relationships with colleagues and sponsors
  • Good problem-solving abilities
  • Strong ability to carry out different projects and work under pressure while meeting timelines
  • Good knowledge of good clinical practices, and applicable Health Canada and Food and Drug Administration (FDA) regulations/guidelines

Our company

The work environment

At Indero, you will work with brilliant and driven colleagues. Our values are collaboration, innovation, reliability, and responsiveness. We offer a stimulating work environment and attractive advancement opportunities.

Work location

Note that this opening is for a home-based position in Germany

Regular travel, which may include overnight trips and / or international travel is required as part of this role.

About Indero

Indero is a contract research organization (CRO) specialized in dermatology. Since its beginnings in 2000, our organization has benefited from a solid reputation for the quality of its research and services exceeding the expectations of its clients. Based in Montreal, Indero continues to grow and expand in North America and Europe.

Indero is committed to providing equitable treatment and equal opportunity to all individuals. As such, Indero will provide accommodations throughout the recruitment and selection process to applicants with disabilities, upon request.

Indero only accepts applicants who can legally work in Germany.

raw.description:
Intro

For this position we are only looking for candidates located in Greece, Germany or Austria.

Nairon GmbH is a Swiss startup building AI voice agents that answer and make phone calls for businesses. Our platform runs real-time conversations over the phone and on the web, connected to our customers' telephony and business tools. We value clear communication, thoughtful engineering, and a collaborative approach to problem-solving. Join us as we continue to develop tools that make a difference.

Tasks

As a Voice AI Engineer at Nairon GmbH, you will make our agents sound fast, natural and reliable in live calls. Your responsibilities will include:

  • Improving turn-taking: when the agent speaks, waits, yields or gets interrupted, including voice activity and end-of-turn detection.
  • Cutting end-to-end latency across speech recognition, language models and speech synthesis, and making provider failover seamless.
  • Optimising how we use LLMs in conversation: prompting, tool calls, streaming and speculative or parallel requests.
  • Serving our own speech models (STT and TTS) on GPUs, measuring throughput and time to first audio.
  • Fine-tuning speech and language models for our customers' languages and voices.
  • Building evaluation: test calls, benchmarks and quality metrics that tell us when a change really helps.

Requirements

Experience:

A senior or strong mid-level engineer with production experience in real-time audio, conversational AI or ML model serving.

Technical Skills:

Required:

  • Strong Python, including asyncio and streaming pipelines.
  • Hands-on work with speech (STT, TTS, VAD) and LLM APIs in latency-sensitive systems.
  • Model serving on GPUs, for example with vLLM or similar, and the basics of batching and memory limits.

Nice to have:

  • LiveKit Agents, pipecat or WebRTC.
  • Fine-tuning (LoRA or full) of speech or language models.
  • Audio signal processing such as echo cancellation or noise suppression.
  • German, or experience with German-language speech data.

Communication:

  • English proficiency is essential, both written and spoken, as it is the working language for all positions.

Soft Skills:

  • You measure before and after, and trust numbers over impressions.
  • Ownership of a problem from the first bad call to the fix in production.

Benefits

  • Flexible Work Setup: Work fully remotely or from a co-working space — whichever suits you best.
  • Equipment Provided: Company laptop and phone provided for all employees.
  • Collaborative Environment: Join a small, agile team where your contributions have a direct impact.
  • Growth Opportunities: Work across the whole voice stack, from model serving to the conversation the caller hears.

Closing

If you want to make AI conversations feel human on a real phone line, we'd love to hear from you.
