raw.title: Research Data Scientist
raw.excerpt: Innodata (Nasdaq: INOD) is a global data engineering company.
raw.description:
Innodata (Nasdaq: INOD) is a global data engineering company. We believe that data and Artificial Intelligence (AI) are inextricably linked. Our mission is to enable the responsible advancement of artificial intelligence by providing the data, evaluation frameworks, and human expertise required to build AI systems that can be trusted at scale. We provide a range of transferable solutions, platforms, and services for Generative AI / AI builders and adopters. In every relationship, we honor our 36+ year legacy delivering the highest quality data and outstanding outcomes for our customers.

Scope of the Role:

We are looking for a highly skilled Research Data Scientist – GenAI/LLM to join our AI/LLM Delivery Unit and work on research-driven AI/ML initiatives involving Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), NLP, multimodal AI, model evaluation, and AI data.

The role combines strong research and analytical capabilities with hands-on AI/ML expertise, requiring the candidate to design experiments, develop evaluation methodologies, analyze complex datasets, build research prototypes, and translate research findings into practical AI/ML solutions.

The ideal candidate will have a strong research orientation, excellent statistical and analytical skills, and the ability to work collaboratively with researchers, data scientists, AI/ML engineers, domain experts, and client-facing teams.

What You’ll Own:

AI/ML & Generative AI Research:

  • Conduct independent and collaborative research in Generative AI, LLMs, NLP, multimodal AI, machine learning, model evaluation, and AI data.
  • Formulate research questions and translate complex AI/ML problems into structured research methodologies and experiments.
  • Design, execute, and analyze experiments to evaluate and improve AI/ML models and solutions.
  • Build analytical models, prototypes, and research pipelines using Python and relevant ML frameworks.
  • Stay current with emerging research, methodologies, papers, and developments in GenAI, LLMs, NLP, multimodal models, and AI evaluation.

LLM & Model Evaluation:

  • Develop and implement LLM evaluation frameworks, benchmarks, datasets, and evaluation criteria.
  • Evaluate models for accuracy, robustness, bias, hallucination, reasoning, relevance, response quality, and other performance dimensions.
  • Conduct model benchmarking, error analysis, comparative analysis, and performance evaluation.
  • Work on areas such as RAG, SFT, RLHF/DPO, prompt engineering, fine-tuning, embeddings, and LLM optimization, as applicable.
  • Identify model and data gaps and recommend improvements to enhance model performance and reliability.

Data Science & Statistical Research:

  • Collect, clean, analyze, and interpret large and complex structured and unstructured datasets.
  • Perform EDA, statistical analysis, hypothesis testing, significance testing, correlation analysis, sampling, and error analysis.
  • Develop data-driven insights and identify patterns, trends, and relationships relevant to AI/ML research.
  • Apply appropriate statistical and quantitative methodologies to validate research findings

AI Data & Dataset Development:

  • Develop and evaluate datasets, sampling methodologies, taxonomies, annotation frameworks, data quality frameworks, and evaluation criteria for AI/ML models.
  • Analyze data quality and identify issues affecting model performance.
  • Collaborate with annotation, data engineering, and AI/ML teams to improve AI training and evaluation data.
  • Translate data and research findings into actionable recommendations for improving AI system

Research & Innovation:

  • Contribute to research papers, technical reports, whitepapers, patents, benchmarks, internal publications, and other research outputs, where applicable.
  • Identify opportunities to apply emerging research and technologies to real-world AI and data challenges.
  • Explore new methodologies, models, datasets, and evaluation approaches to improve AI capabilities.
  • Contribute to capability building and innovation within the AI/LLM practice

Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement:

  • Work closely with researchers, data scientists, AI/ML engineers, data/annotation teams, domain experts, and delivery teams.
  • Present research findings, analytical insights, and technical recommendations to senior technical stakeholders.
  • Translate complex research and technical concepts into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Where required, participate in client-facing technical discussions and presentations and help translate business requirements into AI/ML solutions.

You’ll Thrive in This Role If You Have:

  • Master’s or PhD in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computational Science, or a related discipline.
  • Bachelor’s/Master’s degree from IITs, NITs, or other premier engineering/research institutions is strongly preferred.
  • 4–7 years of hands-on research experience in AI/ML, Data Science, NLP, Generative AI, LLMs, or related areas.
  • Strong demonstrated research experience with the ability to independently formulate research questions, design experiments, analyze results, and communicate findings.
  • Demonstrated research track record through research publications, patents, conference presentations, open-source contributions, or significant AI/ML research projects.
  • Candidates with publications in reputed conferences/journals and a strong academic/research profile will be preferred
  • Strong proficiency in Python and SQL.
  • Strong hands-on experience with NumPy, Pandas, Scikit-learn, and preferably PyTorch/TensorFlow.
  • Strong understanding of:
    • Machine learning algorithms
    • Statistics and experimentation
    • Data analysis and feature engineering
    • Model evaluation and performance metrics
    • Hypothesis testing and statistical inference
  • Hands-on exposure to LLMs, NLP, Generative AI, and multimodal AI.
  • Experience with one or more of RAG, LLM evaluation, prompt engineering, fine-tuning, SFT, RLHF/DPO, embeddings, or model benchmarking.
  • Experience working with large-scale structured and unstructured datasets.
  • Familiarity with Git and cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, or GCP is desirable.

The expected salary range for this position is $160,000 - $185,000 p/year, based on experience, skills, and qualifications.

raw.excerpt: IntroDu möchtest an einer Legal-Tech-Anwendung arbeiten, die für E-Commerce-Unternehmen wie eine digitale Rechtsabteilung funktioniert?
raw.description:
Intro

Du möchtest an einer Legal-Tech-Anwendung arbeiten, die für E-Commerce-Unternehmen wie eine digitale Rechtsabteilung funktioniert? Du denkst Systeme vom Datenmodell bis zur Oberfläche, konzipierst gern technische Lösungen und übernimmst Verantwortung dafür, dass sie am Ende auch so umgesetzt werden? Dann bist du als Senior Fullstack-Entwickler (m/w/d) / Senior Webentwickler PHP/Laravel (m/w/d) beim Händlerbund genau richtig!

Bei uns entwickelst du an einer Plattform, die rechtliche Prozesse digital abbildet und automatisiert. Von der Erstellung rechtlicher Inhalte über Vertrags- und Prüfprozesse bis hin zu Datenschutz- und Sicherheitsfragen. Dazu gehören Schnittstellen und Plugins, über die unsere Inhalte in die Shopsysteme unserer Mitglieder gelangen, sowie Integrationen mit Partnersystemen. Ziel ist es, komplexe rechtliche Anforderungen in verlässliche, verständliche und effiziente digitale Workflows zu überführen.

In dieser Rolle übernimmst du die technische Leitung von Projekten, die wir in kleinen Projektteams umsetzen: Du konzipierst Lösungen, verantwortest die Umsetzung, leitest andere Entwickler im Projekt an und hältst alle Beteiligten über den Stand auf dem Laufenden. Kleinere Projekte setzt du eigenständig komplett um, bei größeren arbeitest du im Team mit Laravel und Livewire im Stack.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Technische Konzeption: Analyse von Anforderungen, Entwurf der Lösungsarchitektur, Festlegung von Datenmodellen und Schnittstellen sowie Einschätzung von Aufwänden für Features und Projekte.
  • Ownership für die Umsetzung: Verantwortung dafür, dass ein Projekt von der Konzeption bis zum Go-live ankommt. Aufgaben schneiden und priorisieren, Fortschritt im Blick behalten, technische Entscheidungen treffen und Blocker aus dem Weg räumen.
  • Anleitung & Wissenstransfer: Fachliche Führung weiterer Entwickler im Projekt durch klare technische Vorgaben, Pairing und Code Reviews im Backend wie im Frontend. Wissen über Architektur und Entscheidungen landet im Team und in der Dokumentation, nicht nur bei dir.
  • Reporting: Regelmäßige, verständliche Berichte zu Stand, Risiken und nächsten Schritten an Team Lead, Product Owner und Stakeholder.
  • Fullstack-Entwicklung: Umsetzung mit Laravel, Livewire, Alpine.js, Flux UI und Tailwind CSS. Kleinere Projekte eigenständig von Anfang bis Ende, größere im Projektteam.
  • Partneranbindungen & Integrationen: Lösungsevaluierung, Umsetzung und Dokumentation von Schnittstellen zu Partner- und Drittsystemen.
  • Architektur & Technologie-Evaluation: Mitgestaltung von Architektur, Entwicklungsstandards und Tooling; Evaluation neuer Technologien, Frameworks und KI-Einsatzmöglichkeiten im Hinblick auf ihren konkreten Nutzen für Produkt und Team.

Dein Profil

Technisch

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung mit PHP & Laravel: Entwicklung von Webanwendungen über den gesamten Stack, im Frontend idealerweise mit Livewire, Alpine.js, Flux UI und Tailwind CSS.
  • Konzeption & technische Leitung: Erfahrung darin, technische Konzepte zu erarbeiten und deren Umsetzung zu verantworten, allein oder als technische Leitung eines Projektteams.
  • Code Reviews über den gesamten Stack: Praxis im Review von Backend- und Frontend-Code und die Fähigkeit, Feedback so zu geben, dass andere daran wachsen.
  • Testerfahrung: Sicherer Umgang mit PHPUnit oder Pest und Erfahrung mit Teststrategien in größeren Codebasen. Tests sind für dich Teil der Umsetzung, nicht Nacharbeit.
  • Datenbanken & APIs: Sicherer Umgang mit relationalen Datenbanken, Datenmodellierung und API-Design.
  • Agile Teamarbeit: Erfahrung in agilen Teams, idealerweise mit Scrum, inklusive enger Zusammenarbeit und kontinuierlichem Austausch.

Nice to Have, aber kein Muss

  • DevOps-Erfahrung: Cloud-Systeme, PaaS-Plattformen, Container, CI/CD oder Linux-Serveradministration (z.B. DigitalOcean und Laravel Cloud)
  • Erfahrung mit Shopsystemen und der Entwicklung von Plugins oder Apps dafür (z.B. Shopify oder JTL)
  • Gespür für UX und Erfahrung in der Gestaltung benutzerfreundlicher Oberflächen
  • Erfahrung mit Event-basierten Architekturen, Queues oder asynchronen Verarbeitungsprozessen
  • Erfahrung mit der Integration von LLM-APIs in Produktfeatures (Prompting, Evaluierung, Guardrails)

Persönlich

  • Ownership: Du fühlst dich für das Ergebnis eines Projekts verantwortlich. Von der ersten Skizze bis zum Go-live und darüber hinaus und nicht nur für deine eigenen Tickets.
  • Systemisches Denken: Du siehst die Auswirkungen von Änderungen über Komponenten- und Teamgrenzen hinweg.
  • Strukturierte Kommunikation: Du bereitest den Stand eines Projekts für technische und nicht-technische Beteiligte verständlich auf, auch dann, wenn etwas nicht nach Plan läuft.
  • Pragmatismus: Du findest die Balance zwischen sauberer Lösung und pragmatischem Fortschritt.
  • Wissenstransfer: Du hast Freude daran, Wissen weiterzugeben und andere im Team besser zu machen, bspw. in Reviews, Pairings und Dokumentation.
  • KI als Werkzeug: Du nutzt KI-Tools im Entwicklungsalltag selbstverständlich und beurteilst nüchtern, wo sie im Produkt echten Nutzen bringen und wo nicht.

Warum wir?

Code. Chill. Repeat.

  • 4 Tage Code – 3 Tage du selbst: Bei uns ist die 4-Tage-Woche Standard. Kein Gimmick, sondern Realität. Du arbeitest remote oder im Leipziger Büro – so, wie du am besten performst. Flexzeiten, kein Micromanagement, volle Eigenverantwortung. Und ja: unbefristet von Anfang an.
  • Dein Stack, dein Style: Wir stehen auf smarte Lösungen, sauberen Code und Menschen, die mitdenken. Du willst mitentscheiden, ausprobieren und nicht nur Tickets abarbeiten? Here you go. Plus: Mentoring, Weiterbildung nach Bedarf und Raum für echte Weiterentwicklung.
  • Remote first, Team always: Trotz Remote bleibt das Teamgefühl. Wir feiern Releases, grillen im Sommer und stoßen auf tolle Ideen an. Dein Bürohund ist bei uns genauso willkommen wie dein Lieblingseditor.
  • Professionalität: echte Qualität statt Show-off. Wir leben agile Entwicklung mit klaren Iterationen und direktem Feedback. Du arbeitest mit modernen, professionellen Tools, mit klaren Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten – du weißt genau, was dein Job ist und hast die Freiheit, ihn so zu machen, wie es richtig ist. Sauberer Code, smarte Entscheidungen und ein Team, das zusammenarbeitet. Professionalität heißt hier: Du kannst dich auf das konzentrieren, was du am besten kannst – entwickeln.
  • Snacks, Swag & Softdrinks: Obst, Müsli, Kaffee, Wasser – alles for free. Kein Dresscode. Komm, wie du bist. Hauptsache du fühlst dich wohl.
  • Perks, die was bringen: Kita-Zuschuss, Unterstützung bei der Altersvorsorge, Leipziger Jobticket oder sportliche Angebote für deinen Ausgleich – vom Homegym bis zum Fitnessstudio für Kopf und Körper.

Dein Weg zu uns

Keine Lust auf lange Anschreiben? Kein Problem! Erzähl uns einfach kurz, warum du Teil vom Händlerbund werden möchtest und warum wir gut zu dir passen. Nutze dazu die Möglichkeit dich online über unser Bewerbungsformular zu bewerben.

Wir freuen uns auf deine Bewerbung mit Angabe deiner Gehaltsvorstellung und deines frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermins.

raw.title: Workers' Compensation Claims Supervisor
raw.excerpt: Our Story Imagine being part of a team that’s not just shaping the future but actively driving it.
raw.description:
Our Story
Imagine being part of a team that’s not just shaping the future but actively driving it. At Davies North America, we’re at the forefront of innovation and excellence, blending cutting-edge technology with top-tier professional services. As a vital part of the global Davies Group, we help businesses navigate risk, optimize operations, and spearhead transformation in the insurance and regulated sectors.

What's in StoreThe Workers’ Compensation Claims Supervisor is responsible for overseeing a team of workers’ compensation claims professionals handling medical-only, lost time, and complex workers’ compensation claims. This role ensures claims are managed effectively, in compliance with regulatory requirements, company guidelines, and client expectations. You will provide leadership, coaching, and technical expertise to claims staff while supporting timely claim resolution, cost management, and successful return-to-work outcomes for injured workers.

** Must have an active FL 5-20 or 6-20 license **

Key Responsibilities

Team Leadership & Development
  • Supervise and mentor workers’ compensation claims adjusters handling medical-only, lost time, and complex claims.
  • Provide coaching, performance feedback, and technical guidance to claims staff.
  • Support recruitment, onboarding, and professional development initiatives for claims team members.
  • Monitor workload distribution to ensure efficient claims handling and service delivery.
Claims Oversight
  • Review complex or high-exposure workers’ compensation claims and provide guidance on claim strategy.
  • Ensure proper claim investigation, documentation, and reserve management.
  • Monitor claim handling practices to ensure compliance with workers’ compensation regulations and company standards.
  • Approve claim settlements within assigned authority limits.
Medical & Return-to-Work Coordination
  • Partner with Nurse Case Managers and medical providers to support effective treatment and recovery outcomes.
  • Ensure appropriate return-to-work strategies are implemented when applicable.
  • Monitor medical management strategies to support efficient claim resolution.
Client & Operational Performance
  • Serve as a point of contact for clients regarding claim performance and program updates.
  • Monitor operational metrics including claim duration, reserve accuracy, and claim outcomes.
  • Support leadership with reporting and operational insights related to workers’ compensation claims performance.

Skills, knowledge & expertise

  • 5+ years of workers’ compensation claims handling experience.
  • Must have a FL 5-20 or 6-20 license
  • Prior supervisory or leadership experience preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of workers’ compensation laws, regulations, and claim handling practices.
  • Excellent leadership, analytical, and communication skills.
  • Oversees day-to-day claims operations for an assigned team.
  • Provides direct leadership to claims adjusters.
  • Monitors team productivity, service delivery standards, and file quality.
  • Conducts file reviews and supports quality initiatives.
  • Assists with staffing coverage, scheduling, and workload balancing.
  • Supports performance feedback and coaching initiatives.

Equal Employment Opportunity & Legal Notices

Benefits
At Davies North America, we are dedicated to supporting the well‑being and future of our qualifying employees. Our comprehensive benefits package includes:
  • Medical, dental, and vision plans to support your health and that of your family
  • A 401(k) plan with employer matching
  • Time‑off policies, including Discretionary Time Off (DTO) for exempt employees and Paid Time Off (PTO) for non‑exempt employees
  • Paid holidays
  • Life insurance and short‑term and long‑term disability coverage
Benefit offerings, eligibility, and required employer contributions may vary based on role, classification, and applicable federal, state, and local laws, including those tied to an employee’s primary work location.
Where required by law, the Company provides paid sick leave, paid family and parental leave, and other mandated benefits in accordance with applicable state and local requirements.
Diversity and Inclusion
Davies is dedicated to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace that embraces a wide range of perspectives and experiences. We believe that diversity of thought is essential for innovation and creativity, and we actively promote an environment where all voices are valued and heard.

Compensation Transparency:
The salary range listed reflects the full compensation band for this role across all locations. Actual compensation will be based on factors such as skills, experience, qualifications, and geographic location, which may impact the final offer. We share ranges to remain transparent and consistent with pay equity practices.

Essential Functions
The following responsibilities and expectations are considered essential to the successful performance of this role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions.
  • Maintain regular and dependable attendance.
  • Be available and able to perform job responsibilities during established work hours.
Background Check & Fair Chance Compliance
Any background check or review of criminal history, if applicable to the role, will be conducted only after a conditional offer of employment and in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws, including fair‑chance hiring requirements.

Massachusetts NoticeIt is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

AI PolicyAt Davies, we value authentic conversations and a fair candidate experience. While candidates may use AI and technology tools to prepare for interviews, we expect interview responses and assessments to reflect each individual's own experience, knowledge, and professional judgment.
We do not use sites like Facebook, Craigslist, or Telegram to recruit or interview potential employees or contractors. If you have been asked to provide any information through any method other than our career portal, please email us at

raw.description:
Head of Performance Marketing

Marketing, UK Remote

Overview

This position requires a leader who is analytical and data-driven in their decision-making process, well versed in performance marketing best practices and marketing technologies, has a high level of understanding of multi-channel acquisition and is assertive about new approaches to optimisation and growth.

The ideal candidate would also be a skilled manager of people and embrace a hands-on, team approach. If you are a success-centric marketing leader that thrives on growth and scaling a demand engine in a business with a start up mentality and scale up success, this role is an unmatched career opportunity!

We’re looking for an excited and passionate marketeer, ready to challenge themselves at the highest level managing a multi-million pound media budget to deliver sensational results .

Key responsibilities

  • Own the creation and execution of Moneyboat’s mulit-channel paid acquisition strategy to achieve growing revenue targets within an acceptable CPA
  • Lead the affiliate / partnership relationships to maximise the share of business Moneyboat acquires
  • Manage the Digital Marketing agency to performance based targets across the main digital channels like Paid Search, Meta and Programmatic.
  • Identify and define commercial opportunities across all stages of the customer lifecycle to drive awareness adoption, activation, and retention by implementing new tactics, running optimisation tests, and improving campaign performance.
  • Ensure the implementation of digital analytics and tracking is accurate and leverage new technologies
  • Own and execute media planning and budget allocation
  • Own the KPI’s and provide regular reports on pipeline metrics, throughout the entire customer journey.
  • Analyse and report on the impact of marketing activities on the customer lifecycle.
  • Work closely with the Credit Risk and Technology teams to validate go-to-market strategies, buyer personas, value proposition, messaging, and content needs and message optimisation.

Your skills & experience

Essential

  • Strong analytical skills, data-driven decision-making, technical ability.
  • 5+ years of managerial-level experience in user acquisition marketing and a proven track record of success (fintech company is a huge advantage).
  • 2+ years of B2C high volume lead gen marketing and user acquisition experience in the regulated consumer space. Agency experience and sector experience are a huge plus.
  • Proven excellence in relationship-building and collaboration
  • Excellent judgement and creative problem-solving skills, including negotiation and conflict resolution skills.
  • Excellent writing, communication, time management, and project management skills.
  • Experienced in working with marketing and analytics tools and platforms such as Google Ads, GDN, Programmatic etc. as well as Facebook, Google Analytics, GTM, Data Studio, SEMRush (SQL a plus).
  • Excellent spoken and written English.
  • Proven ability to manage a multi-million pound budget

Desired

  • Experiencing working in a FCA regulated environment
  • Experience of working in HCST lending sector

About us

Ahoy there! We’re Moneyboat, a UK-based direct lender that provides consumers with short-term loans from £200 to £1,500. We started our journey in 2014 with a vision to make a mark as a company that puts transparency, affordability, and quality service at the heart of everything we do.

We know the value of flexibility, creativity, and innovation in today’s fintech space, and we work hard to create and deliver best-in-class experiences that support our customers and give them the confidence they need to live life to the full.

Vision, Mission & Values

Our vision, mission & values are what drive the amazing work we do.

From the decisions we make to the actions we take, they form the foundations of Moneyboat's brand & strategy.

Our vision describes our view of the world because of Moneyboat. It's the way we want it to be and the reason we keep going, even if times might seem tough.

We give confidence to people, enabling them to live life to the full

When people have access to the financial resources and knowledge that are right for them, we know they can do great things. We exist to help them get access to a solution that's right for them, even when others might have refused to help.

Our core set of values are what we hold to be true, no matter what. We have four core values here at Moneyboat, Accountability, Care, Diligence and Collaboration.

Our vision, mission, and values guide everything that we do. They're the fundamental "pillars" of our company that make us who we are, and help to ensure that anyone we interact with (internal or external) remembers Moneyboat, what we do, and what we stand for.

Employee Benefits

  • Remote working
  • Time-off on Birthday
  • Life assurance 6x salary
  • Gym benefits
  • Childcare benefits
  • Salary sacrifice scheme
  • Health cash plan
  • Access to learning platform
  • Professional subscription benefits

**Please note that AI technology may be used as part of our recruitment and selection process to evaluate applications. All final hiring decisions continue to be made by our human recruitment team

Salary: £75-80k

raw.description:
Summary:

This role is a part of learning and reskilling initiatives across Hong Kong and other AME markets. As these programmes continue to grow, there is a need for a dedicated Communications Specialist to drive stakeholder communications, learner engagement and programme adoption across multiple learning journeys.

The Communications Specialist will develop and execute communication strategies, engagement plans and communication campaigns that support candidates, leaders, hiring managers and other stakeholders involved in learning and reskilling journeys. The role combines strategic planning with hands-on delivery and will work closely with Heads of Learning, programme stakeholders and communications teams to ensure clear, consistent and effective communications across markets.

This is an opportunity to play a key role in supporting the successful rollout and adoption of learning and reskilling initiatives across multiple markets.

Working closely with:

  • Heads of Learning across Hong Kong and AME

  • Programme and Journey Leads

  • Communications teams

  • HR and Talent stakeholders

  • Business leaders supporting learning and reskilling initiatives

Contract Details: Full-Time, 6‑month contract, Open to extension

Roles and Responsibilities:

  1. Strategic Communications & Engagement:

  • Develop and maintain communication strategies and engagement plans supporting learning and reskilling journeys.

  • Create communication roadmaps, communication calendars and campaign plans across multiple programmes and markets.

  • Develop clear and compelling messaging that supports programme awareness, participation and adoption.

  • Tailor communications approaches to the needs of different audiences (candidates, managers, leaders and business stakeholders), markets/regions and also gather stakeholder feedback and adapt communication approaches accordingly.

  • Support the expansion of programmes from Hong Kong to other AME markets and potentially beyond.

  • Partner with Heads of Learning and programme stakeholders to identify communication requirements and engagement opportunities.

  1. Communications Delivery & Content Development:

  • Create and manage communication assets including:

    • Email campaigns

    • Newsletters

    • Participant communications

    • Leader updates

    • Change communications

    • Frequently Asked Questions (FAQs)

    • Programme guides

    • Process documentation

    • Presentation decks

  • Ensure communications are accurate, timely and aligned to programme milestones.

  • Coordinate the review, refinement and approval of communication materials with programme stakeholders, HSBC teams and communications partners.

  1. Communications Advisory & Programme Support

  • Recommend communication approaches and engagement activities that support programme objectives and stakeholder needs.

  • Support the maintenance of learning programme materials and operational documentation.

  • Ensure communications align with organisational standards, governance requirements and brand expectations.

  • Contribute to the continuous enhancement of programme communications as initiatives expand across markets.

Essential Requirements

  • Experience delivering communication strategies and campaigns.

  • Experience supporting learning, talent, change or reskilling programmes.

  • Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.

  • Experience working across multiple geographies and stakeholder groups.

  • Exceptional writing, editing and presentation development capabilities.

  • Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.

  • Experience measuring communication effectiveness and engagement outcomes.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.

  • Success measure of the role:

    • Stakeholder satisfaction

    • Quality of communications assets

    • Newsletter click-through rates

    • Workshop / ILT / event enrolments

Desirable Requirements

  • Experience supporting learning, talent or workforce transformation programmes.

  • Experience within financial services or other regulated industries.

  • Familiarity with learning journeys, career pathways, reskilling or talent development initiatives.

  • Experience partnering with regional or global communications functions.

  • Experience supporting change and adoption communications.

raw.title: Functional Lead: SAP Sales & Distribution/Materials Management
raw.excerpt: Software International (SI) supplies technical talent to Fortune 100/500/1000 companies in Canada/US.
raw.description:
Software International (SI) supplies technical talent to Fortune 100/500/1000 companies in Canada/US. We currently have a long term 10 month contract with our IT consulting client that is working with their large end client.

Role(s) Required: Functional Lead: SAP Sales & Distribution/Materials Management

Location: Ontario, Canada - REMOTE

Required Start Date: ASAP

Type: Contract

Hours: FULL TIME Hours

Rate: Open based on expectations (C2C) Incorporation

Deep Knowledge of SAP Modules & SAP Certified in their area of domain: A consultant must be an expert in specific SAP modules relevant to the implementation. Depending on the project, they should have extensive experience in modules. Greater than >5 years experience and have completed at min 3 end to end SAP ECC implementations.

We are looking for an experienced **Functional Lead SAP Sales & Distribution (SD) / Materials Management (MM)** to join our team. The Functional Lead will play a critical role in leading SAP implementation projects and managing ongoing support and optimization of the SAP SD and MM modules. You will act as the primary liaison between the business and technical teams, ensuring that SAP solutions meet the organization's needs and align with industry best practices.

**Key Responsibilities:**

  • Lead the implementation and configuration of SAP Sales & Distribution (SD) and Materials Management (MM) modules to support business processes.
    - Gather and analyze business requirements, translate them into functional specifications, and design SAP solutions to address these needs.
    - Provide subject matter expertise in SAP SD/MM modules, ensuring optimal use of system functionalities and integration with other SAP modules.
    - Oversee end-to-end project lifecycle, including requirements gathering, system configuration, testing, user training, and post-implementation support.

raw.description:
About Summit:

Summit Therapeutics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical oncology company with a mission focused on improving quality of life, increasing potential duration of life, and resolving serious unmet medical needs. At Summit, we believe in building a team of world class professionals who are passionate about this mission, and it is our people who drive this mission to reality. Summit’s core values include integrity, passion for excellence, purposeful urgency, collaboration, and our commitment to people. Our employees are truly the heart and soul of our culture, and they are invaluable in shaping our journey toward excellence.

Summit’s team is inspired to touch and help change lives through Summit’s clinical studies in the field of oncology. Summit has multiple global Phase 3 clinical studies, including:

Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)

  • HARMONi: Phase 3 clinical study which was intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo plus chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC who were previously treated with a 3rd generation EGFR TKI.

  • HARMONi-3: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

  • HARMONi-7: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab monotherapy compared to pembrolizumab monotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

Colorectal Cancer (CRC)

  • HARMONi-GI3: Phase 3 clinical study intended to evaluate ivonescimab in combination with chemotherapy compared with bevacizumab plus chemotherapy.

Ivonescimab is an investigational therapy not presently approved by any regulatory authority other than China’s National Medical Products Administration (NMPA). Summit is headquartered in Miami, Florida, and has additional offices in California, New Jersey, the UK, and Ireland.

Overview of RoleThe Director, Sourcing & Procurement – R&D Clinical Operations and Supplies will serve as business partner supporting sourcing strategy, contracting, and governance activities across Summit’s Clinical Operations organization and global clinical trial portfolio. This individual will report to the Head of Procurement. The role is responsible for supporting the selection, contracting, and oversight of key clinical service providers, including CROs, central laboratories, imaging vendors, eCOA and other eClinical technology providers, patient recruitment and retention suppliers, investigator payment providers, specialty service vendors, and clinical trial supply partners. The position may also support clinical supply and logistics-related procurement activities, helping ensure the timely and cost-effective delivery of materials and services required to execute global clinical studies. The breadth of this role provides significant exposure across the end-to-end clinical development lifecycle and the opportunity to influence sourcing strategy, supplier performance, and operational execution across the clinical portfolio.

Working closely with Clinical Operations, R&D, Clinical Supply Chain, Finance, Legal, and other cross-functional stakeholders, this individual will help drive vendor strategy, optimize study-related spending, improve sourcing and contracting processes, mitigate supplier risks, and establish effective governance models with critical suppliers. As Summit continues to grow and expand its clinical development portfolio, this role will have opportunities to support additional R&D and Commercial procurement categories and contribute to broader procurement transformation, process improvement, and vendor management initiatives across the organization.


Role And Responsibilities

  • Serve as a lead/procurement business partner to Clinical Operations, providing strategic sourcing and commercial guidance throughout study planning, startup, execution, and closeout.
  • Develop and execute category and supplier strategies across Clinical Operations, Clinical Trial Supplies, and related R&D categories, balancing quality, compliance, service continuity, speed, and total cost.
  • Lead end-to-end competitive sourcing activities across CROs, central laboratories, imaging, eCOA and eClinical technology, IRT/RTSM, patient recruitment and retention, investigator payments, specialty clinical services, logistics, and clinical trial supply vendors.
  • Partner with Clinical Operations, R&D, and Clinical Supply Chain to translate study requirements, timelines, enrollment assumptions, and supply needs into effective sourcing plans and fit-for-purpose vendor solutions.
  • Provide commercial insights, market intelligence, benchmarking, bid analysis, and supplier recommendations to support study feasibility, budgeting, vendor selection, and executive decision-making.
  • Lead negotiation and review of MSAs, SOWs, work orders, rate cards, pricing models, service levels, and other commercial terms in collaboration with Legal, Finance, and business stakeholders.
  • Support financial oversight of outsourced clinical services by reviewing study budgets, change orders, scope modifications, forecasts, and supplier invoices to improve cost transparency, challenge unsupported charges, and identify savings or cost-avoidance opportunities.
  • Establish and facilitate vendor governance for strategic clinical and supply partners, including business reviews, performance scorecards, KPIs and SLAs, issue escalation, risk mitigation, and continuous improvement plans.
  • Proactively identify and help resolve supplier risks affecting study execution, including performance concerns, capacity constraints, timeline impacts, supply continuity, logistics dependencies, quality events, and contract compliance.
  • Contribute as a procurement generalist to broader enterprise priorities, including process standardization, sourcing tools, spend analytics, supplier rationalization, AI and automation projects, and other procurement transformation initiatives.

Experience, Education and Specialized Knowledge and Skills

  • Minimum BA/BS degree or relevant graduate degree preferred
  • Minimum of 10+ years of experience in a Procurement/Vendor Management or Finance environment in a pharmaceutical, CRO/ biotech company or worked in a clinical R&D operations setting with a CRO/Sponsor company
  • Good understanding of the drug development R&D process is important
  • In-depth understanding of clinical trial-related execution of large global studies, including CROs, central labs, imaging, drug supply, CMC vendors, and ancillary suppliers. Oncology experience preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of GCP, ICH, and regulatory expectations governing outsourced clinical activities
  • Demonstrated ability to multi-task, prioritize, and independently solve problems in a rapidly changing environment
  • Proficient user of standard MS Office suite (e.g., Word, Excel), experience using electronic document management systems (e.g. Veeva Vault, etc.), and document review tools desirable
  • Strong computer and database skills and experience with procurement or contract management systems (e.g., Ariba, Coupa, etc.)
  • Attention to detail, accuracy and confidentiality with clear and concise oral and written communication skills
  • Excellent organizational skills
  • Critical thinking, problem solving, ability to work independently
  • Demonstrated ability to collaborate cross-functionally, manage competing priorities, and operate in a fast-paced, high growth organization

This is the pay for this position

Pay Transparency
$190,000—$237,000 USD

Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location. This may be different in other locations due to differences in the cost of labor. The total compensation package for this position may also include bonus, stock, benefits and/or other applicable variable compensation.

Summit does not accept referrals from employment businesses and/or employment agencies in respect of the vacancies posted on this site. All employment businesses/agencies are required to contact Summit’s Talent Acquisition team at to obtain prior written authorization before referring any candidates to Summit.

Who are we?

StoryToys, an independent subsidiary of Team17 Group plc, is a premier, award-winning developer and publisher of interactive educational apps designed to help children learn, play, and grow. We collaborate with the world’s most recognizable entertainment giants—including The LEGO Group, The Walt Disney Company, Marvel Entertainment, Mattel, and BBC Studios—to bring beloved characters like Bluey, Peppa Pig, and Barbie into engaging digital worlds.

Our global success spans all major distribution networks, amassing over 300 million app downloads and reaching millions of active families worldwide in up to 28 different languages. While headquartered in Dublin, Ireland, our internal team of over 130 professionals operates alongside a vast, highly agile global network of creators.

About the role

We are seeking a talented mid-level 2D Artist with a specialism in UI to join our mobile games development team. You will create engaging, intuitive and visually appealing interfaces for our preschool audience, alongside supporting the wider 2D art needs of our products.

Working closely with Design, Engineering, Production and the wider Art Department, you will translate agreed user flows and creative direction into polished UI artwork and production-ready assets. The successful candidate will combine strong 2D art fundamentals with an understanding of how young children interact with games, delivering clear, playful interfaces that reflect our licensed brands and perform well on mobile devices.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • UI Art Production: Create high-quality screens, buttons, icons, menus, overlays and other interface assets, maintaining clear visual hierarchy and consistency across each product.
  • Child-Friendly Interfaces: Use shape, colour, scale and visual feedback to make interactions understandable for young children, including those who cannot yet read. Work with Design to refine clarity and usability.
  • Brand and Creative Consistency: Translate creative direction and licensed brand guidelines into UI and 2D artwork, responding constructively to internal reviews and partner feedback.
  • UI Systems and Asset Libraries: Build and maintain reusable UI components, style guides and organised asset libraries to support consistent, efficient production.
  • Unity Implementation and Handover: Prepare and export assets with appropriate dimensions, slicing, transparency and naming. Collaborate with Engineering on layout, scaling and implementation, and review the results in Unity and on devices.
  • Wider 2D Art Support: Contribute supporting illustrations, backgrounds, props and other 2D content as required, with UI remaining the primary specialism.
  • Iteration and Quality: Refine artwork through feedback and playtesting. Work with QA and Engineering to resolve visual issues, including screen sizes, aspect ratios and localisation requirements.
  • Agile Delivery: Participate in task estimation, sprint planning and reviews. Communicate progress, dependencies and risks early, and maintain organised source files and production-ready deliverables.

Required Skills

  • Professional experience as a 2D or UI Artist in games or interactive media, with the ability to deliver work independently within an agreed brief and seek feedback at appropriate stages.
  • A portfolio demonstrating polished UI artwork, strong visual hierarchy and clear, consistent interface design, alongside sound 2D art fundamentals.
  • Strong understanding of composition, colour, shape language and typography, with the ability to work across different visual styles.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator, or equivalent 2D art tools, and familiarity with Figma or a comparable interface design tool.
  • Understanding of UI asset preparation for Unity, including sprites, slicing, scalable layouts and efficient texture use. Ability to review artwork in engine and collaborate on implementation.
  • Understanding of mobile interface constraints, including touch targets, device formats, readability and performance-conscious asset production.
  • Clear communication, a collaborative approach and the ability to respond to feedback while managing tasks and deadlines.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience creating UI for mobile games, especially apps for children or families.
  • Experience working with licensed IP and external brand approvals.
  • Hands-on experience assembling UI in Unity and creating simple UI animation or interaction feedback.
  • Experience supporting localisation and accessible interface design.
  • Familiarity with Agile production, Jira and version control such as Git.

Application Process

Please submit your CV and a portfolio showing your strongest UI and 2D work. Include examples of complete screens or interface systems, and briefly explain your contribution to collaborative projects.

raw.description:
Our client doesn’t need pretty ads. They need ads that make money.

We are hiring on behalf of our client, a US-based performance marketing company that runs affiliate lead generation and e-commerce campaigns on Meta (Facebook and Instagram). The offers are mostly B2C and pain-driven, in verticals such as insurance, finance, education, and e-commerce, in video campaigns only.

The role

You will write direct-response scripts and ad concepts, study how they perform, and improve them.

Day-to-day, you will:

  • Write 30-second video scripts and ad copy with a strong pain-driven hook, built around something the viewer wants to run away from.
  • Get to the conversion ask quickly instead of telling a slow brand story.
  • Think in terms of broad targeting, where the message does the audience selection.
  • Read performance data and decide what to test next.
  • Study competitor ads, then create something new instead of copying them

You are probably a great fit if you: -

  • Know Meta ads well, including creative testing and how the algorithm responds to different hooks.
  • Write short, punchy, conversion-focused scripts.
  • Think in angles, hooks, and pain points, and enjoy finding new ones.
  • Are creative and curious, and would rather test ideas than manage spreadsheets.
  • Can look at a plain-looking ad and explain why it converts.
  • Uses Tracker (RedTrack, Voluum, Binom), an affiliate network (MaxBounty, Perform), spy tools (AdPlexity, Anstrex), experience with restricted verticals (nutra, dating, finance), or experience managing your own ad spend.

Requirements

  • Strong Meta (Facebook/Instagram) ads experience, or a clearly demonstrated ability to write for Meta.
  • A relevant portfolio of Meta or direct-response ads and scripts (see below).
  • Fluent spoken and written English, including a short phone check.
  • Availability for EST-compatible hours [confirm required overlap, e.g. 4+ hours].
  • Willingness to take part in a paid trial.

How to apply: please read carefully

Every application must include all three items below. Applications missing any of them will not be considered.

1. Attach your CV. Shortlisted candidates will be asked to confirm a phone number for a short English check.

2. A relevant portfolio. This means real video examples of Meta (Facebook/Instagram) ads, direct-response scripts, or ad creatives you wrote or produced, shared as a link (Google Drive, Notion, website, Loom) or as attachments; they are not doing static ads.

3. Include results where you have them (screenshots, numbers, or a short description).

  • What counts as relevant: Meta ads, direct-response or performance scripts, hooks and angles for lead gen or e-commerce.
  • What doesn’t: general design or branding work, social media posts with no conversion goal, or a link to a generic profile with no ad samples.

4. A short note on why you think one of your portfolio ads worked

What happens next:

1. We review your CV and portfolio first. The portfolio is the first gate.

2. Shortlisted candidates receive a short personality assessment and a 2-minute phone call.

3. Candidates who pass are introduced to our client for a 10–15-minute chat.

4. Selected candidates start the paid trial.

raw.excerpt: About UsAt Prenuvo, we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive “sick-care” to proactive health care.
raw.description:
About Us

At Prenuvo, we are on a mission to flip the paradigm from reactive “sick-care” to proactive health care. Our award-winning whole body scan is fast (under 1 hour), safe (MRI has no ionizing radiation), and non-invasive (no contrast). Our unique integrated stack of optimized hardware, software, and increasingly AI, coupled with the patient-centric experience across our domestic and global clinics, have allowed us to lead the change against “we caught it too late again".

We are looking for a Manager, Credentialing & Medical Staff Services to build and lead a centralized function spanning multi-state credentialing and licensure, clinician onboarding, compliance, FPPE/OPPE administration, and related medical staff services.

This visible, high-impact role combines hands-on operational ownership with function building. The successful candidate will stabilize critical workflows, modernize systems, and shape the service model and team needed to support more than 200 healthcare professionals as Prenuvo Medical Group grows.

This role does not provide visa sponsorship. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States at the time of hire and must not require employer sponsorship for a work visa (current or future).

Help reshape the world through proactive healthcare while working with cutting-edge technology and high performing teams with deep expertise - join us to make a difference in people’s lives!

What You'll Do

Credentialing, Licensing & Compliance

  • Own end-to-end primary source verification, credentialing, re-credentialing, initial licensure, and license renewals for in-scope physicians, nurse practitioners, registered nurses, MRI technologists, and other licensed healthcare professionals across required states.
  • Partner with Legal and Clinical Leadership to define and maintain role- and state-specific licensure requirements, then translate approved requirements into documented workflows, controls, tracking, and escalation processes.
  • Maintain an accurate, authoritative healthcare professional roster and credentialing record, including documentation, application status, expiration dates, restrictions, and at-risk items.
  • Proactively manage renewals and conduct or coordinate monitoring of licensing-board status, sanctions, exclusions, and other adverse-status changes, as applicable.
  • Establish advance deadlines, controls, and escalation pathways that prevent avoidable lapses and maintain audit readiness.
  • Coordinate required training, attestations, certifications, continuing medical education requirements, background checks, fingerprinting, and other applicable compliance requirements.
  • Support internal and external audits and ensure required records remain accurate, complete, and accessible.
  • Administer FPPE and OPPE workflows by maintaining clinician-specific review schedules, sending advance reminders, tracking completion, escalating overdue items, and maintaining audit-ready records. Clinical leaders retain responsibility for evaluation content and decisions.

Healthcare Professional Onboarding & Lifecycle

  • Lead the operational onboarding and offboarding lifecycle for healthcare professionals within the role’s defined scope.
  • Coordinate credentialing, licensing, required documentation, system access, training, and other readiness dependencies against accountable owners and target dates.
  • Establish onboarding checklists and service levels, remove bottlenecks, and escalate incomplete requirements before they affect anticipated start dates or clinical operations.

Systems, Data & Operational Improvement

  • Establish and maintain an authoritative source of truth for credentialing, healthcare professional readiness, and FPPE/OPPE status.
  • Define data ownership, reconciliation processes, quality controls, reporting standards, and accountability across systems.
  • Design standardized and trackable workflows using credentialing platforms and internal systems.
  • Use company-approved automation and AI tools to reduce manual work, improve visibility, and increase operational reliability.
  • Measure cycle time, backlog, accuracy, readiness, service performance, and other key operating metrics.
  • Identify recurring failure points and implement scalable solutions rather than relying on repeated manual intervention.

Medical Staff Operations & Healthcare Professional Experience

  • Serve as the centralized operational point of contact for defined clinician administrative needs and maintain a documented service catalog, intake process, response-time standards, and escalation pathways.
  • Own and continuously improve healthcare professional reimbursement workflows, including continuing medical education, licensure, and other approved professional expenses.
  • Resolve practice-related administrative issues in partnership with Clinical Leadership, Human Resources, Finance, Legal, Compliance, and Information Technology.
  • Standardize, automate, delegate, or enable self-service for recurring requests to create a responsive and scalable clinician-support model.

Cross-Functional Leadership & Growth

  • Partner closely with senior clinical and operational leaders to establish priorities, accountability, and operating standards.
  • Set submission deadlines and service-level expectations for healthcare professionals and cross-functional partners whose actions affect readiness.
  • Proactively escalate at-risk licenses, incomplete applications, healthcare professional non-responsiveness, and unresolved organizational dependencies.
  • Support expansion into new states and markets by ensuring healthcare professionals are operationally ready to practice.
  • Help define the future staffing model, technology roadmap, vendor strategy, and organizational structure for credentialing and medical staff operations.
  • Manage assigned staff, contractors, and vendors by establishing clear roles, priorities, service levels, workload allocation, and performance expectations.

What You’ll Bring

  • Five or more years of progressively responsible experience in healthcare professional credentialing, multi-state licensure, medical staff services, or medical group operations.
  • Direct experience with primary source verification, license renewals, compliance monitoring, audit-ready recordkeeping, and healthcare professional onboarding.
  • Demonstrated success building or improving credentialing systems, workflows, operational reporting, and source-of-truth records.
  • Experience operating in a complex, multi-state healthcare environment.
  • Ability to establish deadlines, influence healthcare professionals and cross-functional leaders, and escalate risks constructively.
  • Strong project management, analytical, communication, and operational problem-solving skills.
  • Ability to move between detailed workflow execution and higher-level program design.
  • Experience administering FPPE, OPPE, or comparable medical staff professional-practice evaluation processes, including tracking, documentation, reporting, and escalation.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in a high-growth healthcare, digital-health, telehealth, or multi-site medical group.
  • Experience implementing or optimizing credentialing platforms, workflow automation, or AI-enabled operational processes.
  • Experience managing credentialing staff, shared-service teams, contractors, or external vendors.
  • Experience designing centralized medical staff operations or healthcare professional support functions.

Our Values

First: we are Pioneers

  • Transforming healthcare requires divergent thinking, bias for action, disciplined experimentation, and consistent grit and determination to maintain momentum. This journey is as challenging as it is rewarding.

Second: we are Platform-Builders

  • We’re always building foundations that allow us to achieve tomorrow more than we did today. We never lose sight of what’s ahead – in a mindset of ownership and duty to our mission.

Above all: we are Patients

  • We could all be the next person who walks through our very doors, seeking clarity or peace of mind. We are proud of our impact on our patients’ lives, and we won’t stop till everyone can benefit from our work.

What We Offer

  • An avenue to make a positive impact on people's lives and their health
  • We believe in preventative healthcare for everyone, including our team - Prenuvo provides free, whole-body scans to each team member
  • Growth opportunities are at the heart of our people journey, we’re doing big things with bright minds - there is no single path to success, it can be shaped along the way
  • Building strong relationships is at the core of everything we do - our team gets together each week to connect, share, and socialize
  • Recognizing time away to restore is vital to our wellbeing - we have a flexible vacation policy and we will encourage you to use it
  • We now offer the Prenuvo’s Commuter Benefits Plan to help cover your transit and parking costs. Whether you ride, drive, or park, we’ve got you covered—making your commute easier and more affordable!
  • Prenuvo offers a 401(k) retirement savings plan to eligible employees, allowing team members to make pre-tax contributions toward their retirement. While Prenuvo facilitates access to the plan, the company does not currently offer matching contributions.
  • We offer a comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, vision, including Mental Health coverage, to support you and your family
  • The base salary for this role ranges from $110,000 to $125,000 USD, depending upon experience and geographic location

We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

As part of the hiring process, successful candidates will undergo a background check in compliance to applicable federal, provincial, and state rules.

Please be advised that official communication from our recruitment team will only come from our authorized domain []. If you are contacted by a recruiter, please ensure their email address ends with @prenuvo.com. We do not use third-party recruitment services or any other email domains for hiring purposes. If you receive communication that you believe to be fraudulent, please report it immediately to .

raw.excerpt: We're BlueCat—a Great Place to Work for good reason.
raw.description:
We're BlueCat—a Great Place to Work for good reason. Our team solves critical network challenges for some of the world's largest organizations. In simple terms, we manage the systems that keep networks running smoothly, securely, and reliably—the backbone infrastructure that powers digital transformation for enterprises globally. Our Intelligent Network Operations platform delivers and enables AI-driven agentic ops at scale, automating and simplifying how companies manage, secure, and optimize their networks.

But what makes us different is how we work: we believe great work happens in an environment where you're trusted, heard, and supported. With teams globally, we're building a workplace culture that values collaboration and integrity as much as innovation. If you're looking to advance your career with a company that invests in its people, this is it.

About the Sales Team

The BlueCat sales team is a group of intelligent and market-aware sales professionals who like to have fun and win together. We are a highly engaged team that loves bringing creative solutions to the table to help grow and transform our business. We know how to be competitive, learn, and continue to support each other and our customers.

Does the idea of being on the forefront of network, cloud, and security technology excite you? If so, read on!

The Role

We are looking for a hungry and experienced Global Vice President of Mid-Market Sales to build and lead our worldwide Mid-Market sales organization across North America, EMEA, and APAC. The Mid-Market segment is defined as customers under 10,000 employees or $5B in revenue. This is a high-impact leadership role responsible for the global strategy, execution, and results of a segment that is central to BlueCat’s growth. We are looking for a true builder and a do-er who creates the model, designs the plan, and builds the activities and operating rhythm to deliver it, not someone who has only executed a plan handed to them.

You will lead through regional sales leaders and field teams, operating our Velocity Engine, a partner-first strategy, and an activity-driven sales model to deliver repeatable, scalable, and predictable growth. This position reports to BlueCat’s Chief Revenue Officer.

What You'll Own

  • Build the operating model and go-to-market plan, define the activities and cadences that drive results, and own the outcome end to end.
  • Lead and develop a global Mid-Market sales organization, managing regional sales leaders and their teams of Account Executives across North America, EMEA, and APAC.
  • Own the global Mid-Market ACV and bookings targets on an annual and quarterly basis, and deliver consistent attainment across all regions.
  • Run the Velocity Engine globally: drive a consistent, repeatable sales motion that increases pipeline velocity, shortens sales cycles, and improves conversion at every stage.
  • Execute a partner-first strategy: ensure Mid-Market business is sourced, influenced, and closed with BlueCat’s channel partners (including the BlueCatalyst Partner Program), and work closely with Worldwide Channel and Alliances to build joint business plans, grow partner-sourced pipeline, and register and win deals together.
  • Champion an activity-driven model: define, instrument, and inspect the daily and weekly behaviors (prospecting, territory and account planning, high-quality customer engagements) that lead to successful outcomes, and coach leaders to manage to those leading indicators.
  • Own global pipeline generation, pipeline management, system hygiene, and accurate forecasting; deliver reliable forecast calls to executive leadership.
  • Partner with Marketing, Sales Engineering, Customer Success, Sales Operations, Finance, and Product to align demand generation, enablement, and coverage models and to meet the rapidly expanding needs of the sales organization.
  • Design and evolve the global Mid-Market coverage model, territory structure, quota capacity, and compensation alignment to support new-logo acquisition, expansion, and migration plays (for example, competitive DDI migrations).
  • Play a key role in recruiting, hiring, onboarding, and developing sales leaders and sellers across regions; build a deep bench and a culture of coaching.
  • Drive and foster a fun, inclusive, and winning culture that reflects our culture code, and win as One with colleagues across the company.
  • Lead quarterly business reviews, performance reviews, and operating cadences globally, and report on performance, risks, and opportunities to the CRO and executive team.

Knowledge, Skills, and Experience Required

  • 10+ years successfully selling enterprise software with a consistent track record of exceeding quota.
  • At least 5 years in sales leadership, including experience leading leaders and managing a multi-region or global team.
  • At least 2 years selling infrastructure solutions to IT buyers; background in networking, DNS/DDI, cloud, or security is a strong plus.
  • Proven success leading teams in high-performing, growing software sales organizations, including building or scaling a Mid-Market or Commercial segment.
  • Demonstrated “GM of the business” mindset and a hands-on builder’s track record: someone who has created the model, built the plan, and put the activities in place, not simply run an existing plan. Experience at a larger company is valued, but we want a do-er as well.
  • Experience selling into companies of roughly 2,000–10,000 employees or $1B–$5B in revenue.
  • Deep experience with partner-led and channel-first go-to-market models, including working with resellers, distributors, MSPs, and alliance partners across regions.
  • Experience implementing activity-based management, sales methodologies, and operating rhythms that improve pipeline velocity and forecast accuracy.
  • Experience landing new logos, developing territories, and expanding existing accounts in partnership with Customer Success.
  • Experience operating across multiple geographies and cultures; comfortable adapting playbooks to regional market dynamics.
  • Bachelor’s degree required.

Key Attributes

  • Exceptional oral and written communication skills and proven negotiation skills, with executive presence.
  • Passionate about the skill and career development of others and about leveraging teams to multiply success.
  • Takes pride in the daily process that leads to future success. Metrics driven.
  • Enthusiastic. Loves to win, but hates losing more.
  • Will break glass to delight customers and partners.
  • Loves to learn and grow.
  • Ability to travel frequently globally, including to partner, customer, and company events such as the Annual Sales Kick-off (SKO).
The base salary range for this position is $200,000-$225,000 USD, with additional commission opportunity. Final compensation will be determined based on skills, experience, and qualifications. This role is for an existing vacancy.

Why BlueCat

BlueCat offers a friendly and exciting culture, great benefits, and a range of career opportunities in Canada, the US, Iceland, and Europe. Your voice and ideas matter to everybody, including our leadership team. We are Great Place To Work certified in multiple countries, and we have fun while we do it.

If you share our enthusiasm for the future of our company and are eager to contribute to our vibrant workplace, we look forward to receiving your application!
This position is eligible for a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision insurance; tax advantaged accounts (HSA, FSA); annual Lifestyle Spending Account (LSA); a 401(k) with company matching; paid parental leave; vacation, personal, and wellness days; an annual learning and development budget. Eligible employees may also participate in the company's annual bonus program.
Join us in shaping the future of our organization, where your talent and dedication can truly thrive. We invite you to apply and become a valuable member of our team!
BlueCat is an Equal Opportunity Employer that is committed to inclusion and diversity. We also take affirmative action to offer employment and advancement opportunities to all applicants, including minorities, women, protected veterans, and individuals with disabilities. BlueCat will not discriminate or retaliate against applicants who inquire about, disclose, or discuss their compensation or that of other applicants.

Their primary role is to understand the business requirements and translate them into functional designs that align with the organization’s needs. This is a part-time, fully remote position, contract position.

Brief History of Lescault & Walderman, Inc.:

LWI was founded in 2006 providing outsourced accounting services to clients remotely in a wide range of industries. We have provided remote positions to staff for over 10 years. LWI has the experience and infrastructure to support this work-from-home model.

  1. has built a culture that prioritizes both staff and clients. LWI believes in a healthy work life balance for our staff. You will work normal business hours with flexibility. We are not the type of firm who pushes our staff to work 45-60 hour weeks.
  2. is scaling rapidly and looking for experienced accountants to help grow the organization. We have experienced moderate growth in all years leading up to 2021 and now service clients globally. Since 2021, LWI has doubled in size from organic growth and two acquisitions. We are looking for opportunistic hires who look forward to a challenge and have a desire to grow with the company.

Global Support

Social Media Manager

We’re looking for a strategic and creative Social Media Manager who can own client outcomes across platforms—while still jumping into the creative trenches when needed. This isn’t just about scheduling posts or hitting KPIs. It’s about understanding what drives real engagement, guiding content that performs, and knowing when to lead versus when to create.

  • Client Strategy & Outcomes
    • Act as the strategic lead for multiple brand accounts across social platforms (Instagram, TikTok, Facebook, Threads, YouTube Shorts, etc.)

Who You Are:

  • A hybrid thinker—equally strategic and creative
  • Comfortable leading client conversations and presenting performance insights
  • Can easily flex between overseeing a team and rolling up your sleeves

  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously.

Our approach to compensation:

We take a market-based & data-driven approach to compensation. We leverage data from trusted third-party compensation sources to help us understand the market value of a role based on function, level, geographic location, and scope. We evaluate compensation bi-annually, including performance and market-related factors.

Our salaries are benchmarked against market Total Cash Compensation for the geographic location of our job posting. Compensation for some roles is structured as On Target Earnings (OTE = base + commission/variable) while for others it is structured as Salary only.

To comply with local legislation and ensure transparency, we share salary ranges on all job postings. Skills, experience and other factors help determine the final salary we offer which may vary from the original range posted.

Additionally, all permanent team members are eligible to participate in various benefits plans as part of their overall compensation package.

Salary Range:

$ 90,000-100,000

Where we work:

We have offices in Boston, MA; Vancouver, BC; and Vancouver, WA. For select positions, we are open to hiring fully remote candidates. We post our positions in the location(s) where we are open to having the successful candidate be located.

Diversity, inclusion, and accessibility:

At Later, we are committed to fostering a culture rooted in an inclusion-first mindset at every level of the company, embracing the importance of hiring and building teams for culture add rather than culture fit. raw.description:
Werden Sie selbstständiger Überführungsfahrermit DriiveMe Partner

Erhalten Sie Zugang zu bezahlten Fahrzeugüberführungen in ganz Deutschland, mit flexibler Organisation und erstatteten Fahrtkosten.

👉Registrieren Sie sich hier, um auf die Aufträge zuzugreifen:

DriiveMe ist die führende europäische Plattform für Fahrzeugüberführungen. Jeden Monat werden unserer Community aus selbstständigen Fahrern mehr als 20.000 bezahlte Aufträge in ganz Deutschland angeboten.

Große Unternehmen der Automobilbranche vertrauen DriiveMe, um ihre Fahrzeuge zu bewegen: Stellantis, Ayvens, Tesla, Volkswagen, Hertz, Avis, Europcar und viele weitere.

In ganz Deutschland müssen täglich zahlreiche Unternehmen Fahrzeuge von einem Ort zum anderen transportieren lassen. Dafür veröffentlichen sie ihre Anforderungen auf DriiveMe und stellen diese Aufträge der DriiveMe Partner-Community zur Verfügung.

Worin besteht ein DriiveMe-Auftrag?

Es ist einfach: Als selbstständiger Fahrer fahren Sie ein Fahrzeug von einem Abholort zu einem Zielort. So funktioniert es:

  1. Sie erstellen Ihr Konto aufdriiveme.com.

  2. Sie greifen auf die verfügbaren Aufträge in Ihrer Region zu.

  3. Sie prüfen Strecke, Vergütung und Bedingungen des jeweiligen Auftrags.

  4. Sie buchen mit wenigen Klicks die Aufträge, die Sie durchführen möchten.

  5. Am Tag des Auftrags begeben Sie sich zum Abholort, übernehmen das Fahrzeug und liefern es am Zielort ab.

  6. Nach Abschluss und Bestätigung des Auftrags erhalten Sie Ihre Zahlung automatisch innerhalb von 10 Tagen.

Warum selbstständiger Fahrer mit DriiveMe Partner werden?

  • Zusätzliches Einkommen: Jeder Auftrag wird vergütet, der Preis ist im Voraus bekannt.

  • Flexible Organisation: Sie wählen selbst, welche Aufträge Sie durchführen möchten.

  • Fahrtkosten werden übernommen: Kraftstoff und Mautgebühren werden gemäß den Bedingungen des Auftrags erstattet.

  • Einfache und intuitive Plattform: Aufträge online ansehen, buchen und verwalten.

  • Aufträge in ganz Deutschland: Täglich werden neue Möglichkeiten veröffentlicht.

Wie viel verdiene ich?

Ihr Umsatz hängt davon ab, wie viele Aufträge Sie durchführen möchten.

Jeder Auftrag hat eine eigene Vergütung, die sich nach der Strecke, der Anzahl der Kilometer und der Komplexität des Transports richtet.

Bevor Sie einen Auftrag buchen, kennen Sie alle wichtigen Informationen: Abholort, Zielort, Vergütung und Bedingungen. Sie entscheiden frei, welche Aufträge Sie annehmen möchten.

Gesuchtes Profil

Um DriiveMe Partner beizutreten, sollten Sie idealerweise:

  • über eine gültige Fahrerlaubnis verfügen;

  • selbstständig sein oder bereit sein, selbstständig tätig zu werden;

  • zuverlässig, pünktlich und sorgfältig sein;

  • die Verfahren zur Abholung und Übergabe der Fahrzeuge einhalten;

  • verfügbar sein, um gelegentliche Aufträge in Ihrer Region oder in anderen Teilen Deutschlands durchzuführen.

Jetzt registrieren

Die Registrierung der Fahrer erfolgt zentral über die offizielle DriiveMe-Seite.
