raw.description:
Cin7 is a fast-growing global software company that provides solutions for modern-day product sellers. We help these sellers connect and simplify their operations, keep track of their inventory at scale, and help them sell their products across multiple sales channels around the world.
Cin7 is expanding very quickly with a mission to empower product sellers to thrive by making selling as easy as buying. We are committed to this mission to become the leading Inventory Management Software brand in the world.
Serving over 8,000 customers globally, processing more than 125 million orders per year, and supporting over $35B of Gross Merchandise Value, Cin7 has been rated best overall in inventory management software in 2024 by Forbes Advisor.

How you'll make an impact:

We're looking for an Email Marketing Specialist to own email creation in HubSpot. Reporting to the Marketing Operations Manager, you'll build, test, and schedule the emails that reach our prospects, customers, and partners, including newsletters, event invitations, product announcements, and nurture campaigns.

This role is hands-on. You'll take campaign briefs and copy from across the marketing team and turn them into polished, accurate, on-brand emails. You'll build the lists and segments behind each send, use test results and performance data to improve future emails, and keep the email calendar and approval process running smoothly. You'll also create simple graphics in Canva when our graphic designer is busy with larger projects.

You'll work with a small, collaborative team and with people in several time zones. Your work will be seen by our prospects, customers, and partners every week.

You will build emails across a variety of campaign types:

  • Workflow-based drip campaigns (6+ weeks)

  • Automated nurtures (demo, free trial, lifecycle stages)

  • One-off campaigns (trade shows, announcements, etc.)

  • Webinar promotion series (invites, reminders, follow-ups)

  • Monthly newsletter (gather content from stakeholders, build, iterate, and send)

What you'll do:

  • Own email creation in HubSpot, building marketing emails from start to finish using templates, modules, and personalization tokens.

  • Build and segment lists, creating targeted lists in HubSpot so each email reaches the right audience.

  • Run A/B tests, testing subject lines, content, send times, and calls to action, and applying what you learn to future emails.

  • Analyze email metrics to guide decisions, tracking open rates, click rates, and unsubscribes, and using the results to recommend changes to content, timing, and audiences.

  • Maintain the email calendar, planning and scheduling sends across teams so campaigns are coordinated and audiences aren't over-emailed.

  • Manage the approval process for email sending, getting emails to reviewers on time, tracking feedback and sign-off, and making sure nothing is sent before it's approved.

  • Maintain oversight of marketing team inbox, organizing, deleting and responding to email responses as necessary.

  • Test every email before it goes out, checking links, merge fields, recipient lists, and how each email looks on desktop and mobile.

  • Turn campaign briefs into finished emails, working with marketing team members to get copy, images, and calls to action ready for review.

  • Create basic graphics in Canva, including email banners, buttons, and simple images, using Cin7 brand guidelines and approved templates. Hand larger design projects to our graphic designer.

  • Keep email assets organized, including templates, saved content, and image files, so the team can find and reuse them.

  • Follow email best practices and privacy rules, including unsubscribe handling and consent requirements for the regions we send to.

What you'll bring:

    What you'll bring:

  • 2-3 years of experience in email marketing, marketing operations, or a similar role.

  • Hands-on experience building and sending emails in HubSpot's marketing email tool.

  • Experience building and segmenting lists in HubSpot.

  • Experience running A/B tests and using the results to improve future emails.

  • The ability to read email metrics and turn them into clear recommendations.

  • A basic understanding of HubSpot workflows, such as enrolling contacts and sending automated emails.

  • Basic graphic design skills and working experience with Canva.

  • Experience using Asana or similar project management tool (ClickUp, Trello, Etc.)

  • Strong writing and proofreading skills, with close attention to detail.

  • The ability to manage several projects at once, keep a calendar on track, and meet deadlines.

  • Clear, friendly communication with teammates across time zones.

  • A willingness to learn new tools, including AI-powered tools, that help you work faster and improve results.

  • Nice to have: HubSpot certifications, basic HTML and CSS for email troubleshooting, and familiarity with GDPR, CAN-SPAM, and CASL.

Why join us?

  • Own a key part of how Cin7 communicates with prospects, customers, and partners.

  • Grow your HubSpot and email marketing skills with support from an experienced marketing operations team.

  • Work closely with a collaborative marketing team.

  • See the results of your work in every campaign you send.

In return, we offer:

  • Competitive benefits include medical, dental, vision, and a 401k company match program.

  • A flexible PTO policy, allowing you the time you need to recharge.

  • A diverse team, where everyone helps each other and inclusion is a core value.

  • Remote work flexibility allows you to maintain a work-life balance in a way that suits your needs.

  • Frequent company-sponsored events so you can get to know your coworkers.

Why CIN7?

CIN7 is a leader in one of the most exciting software verticals right now, and we're growing exponentially. We're looking to add people to our team who are passionate about working with a fast growth tech company.
At CIN7, we make great products available to everyone. Every month, millions of sales orders flow through our platform reducing the cost, effort and time for product sellers so they can quickly get products to customers and build their brands without worrying about their operations. We pride ourselves on providing Inventory Management and Supply Chain software to help medium-large product businesses thrive in a highly competitive, digital world. CIN7 centrally manages inventory across multiple locations and channels, connecting 500+ systems to support receiving, selling and shipping stock.
We value diversity at Cin7, and bring people into the heart of everything we do. We hire, recruit, and promote without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, pregnancy or maternity, veteran status or any other status protected by applicable law. raw.description:
Full-Cycle Account Executive
New Business Development: find the buying moment, build the case, close the deal

The Opportunity

Most infrastructure decisions don’t happen because a salesperson called. They happen because something forced them: a server fleet hitting end of life, a hypervisor renewal that jumped overnight, a colocation contract running out, an audit that didn’t go well. The best sellers in our industry spot those moments before anyone else, and show up with the right answer.

That’s the job. We’re looking for a true hunter who builds their own pipeline, sells a smart comparison instead of a canned pitch, and closes new business from first conversation to signature. No inherited accounts to babysit and no waiting on marketing leads, just a real market, a flexible portfolio, and room to build something that’s yours.

Why This Role Is Different

  • You’re not stuck selling one product. Public cloud, private cloud, Dell hardware, colocation—you recommend what actually fits the workload, even when the honest answer is “keep that one in Azure.” Customers notice. So do their referrals.
  • You stay a hunter. Client Success owns renewals and account management, so your time—and your commission plan, stay focused on winning new logos.
  • You don’t hunt alone. We co-sell with leading technology advisors including Intelisys, Telarus, Upstack, and Avant, so your reach goes well beyond your own list.
  • Your impact is visible. You’ll work directly with the VP of Sales and company leadership, and what you build will shape how Dynascale grows.

About Dynascale

Dynascale provides cloud solutions, colocation, infrastructure modernization, AI sovereignty, cybersecurity, and managed IT services. We help organizations with demanding performance, cost, and compliance requirements put every workload in the right place—and run it reliably once it’s there.

What You’ll Do

Find the buying moment

  • Build your own territory map and hit list, ranked by real timing signals: hardware end-of-life dates, contract and lease expirations, licensing changes, funding, acquisitions, and audit cycles.
  • Reach out when it matters—by phone, email, LinkedIn, events, and referrals—using HubSpot, Apollo.io, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and ZoomInfo.
  • Turn technology advisors and brokers into a second pipeline engine through smart co-selling.

Build the case

  • Run sharp discovery with IT managers and directors, find the event driving the decision, and qualify with discipline using MEDDIC/MEDDPICC or a similar method.
  • Own the first technical conversation, virtualization, backup, bandwidth, compliance—and bring in Solutions Engineers when the design gets deep.
  • Arm your champion with a one-page business case that wins the room you’re not in: why now, the cost of doing nothing, and why this is the right move.

Close and hand off

  • Negotiate and close new-logo deals that make sense for the customer and for Dynascale, no buying revenue with discounts.
  • Run a forecast you’d put your name on, with HubSpot kept clean and current.
  • Hand off to Client Success with a complete, accurate service order—then get back to hunting.

What You Bring

  • 3–7 years selling recurring infrastructure or managed services: colocation, IaaS, private cloud, MSP/MSSP, DRaaS, or managed network.
  • A track record of sourcing at least half of your own closed business—and a method you can walk us through in detail.
  • Experience selling to IT managers and directors at companies with roughly 50–1,000 employees.
  • Quota attainment earned without a big marketing engine, an SDR team, or a sales engineer on every call.
  • The patience for four- to seven-month cycles and the fluency to talk about deals in recurring revenue and margin, not just contract value.
  • Real CRM and forecasting discipline, ideally in HubSpot.

Bonus Points

  • You have beaten AWS or Azure on cost predictability and control.
  • You have closed deals alongside technology advisors or brokers such as Intelisys, Telarus, Upstack, or Avant.
  • You have quoted hardware and a recurring service in the same deal.
  • You know compliance-driven industries such as healthcare, financial services, entertainment and post-production, or the public sector.
  • You sell with MEDDIC/MEDDPICC, Challenger, or a similar methodology.

How We Measure Winning

New monthly recurring revenue closed against an annual quota of roughly $20K in net-new MRR. Along the way, we look at self-sourced pipeline, qualified opportunities with a clear buying event, deal progression, win rate, margin, forecast accuracy, and clean handoffs to Client Success. Bottom line: new customers and recurring revenue that last.

This Is Your Role If…

  • You’ve built a book from nothing and can tell us exactly how you did it.
  • Spotting a hardware refresh nine months early excites you more than a warm inbound lead.
  • You’d rather recommend the option that pays you less than lose a customer’s trust.
  • You can walk through the economics of every deal you’ve closed.
  • You don’t need a playbook handed to you—you’d rather write one.

It’s probably not the right fit if you’re looking for a steady stream of inbound leads, a dedicated SDR, or a sales engineer on every first call.

Compensation

Base salary: $75,000 – $85,000 plus OTE.

Ready to Hunt?

If you know how to find the buying moment, build the case, and close—and you want a role where that skill is the whole job—we want to hear from you. When you apply, tell us about the best deal you ever sourced yourself.

Dynascale Technologies, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law.

raw.description:
ABOUT UNRIVALED

Unrivaled is a premier professional women’s 3v3 basketball league showcasing the top players in the sport. Our mission is to elevate the profile of women’s basketball through exceptional talent, groundbreaking partnerships, and unparalleled fan experiences.

JOB OVERVIEW

Unrivaled is seeking an experienced Video Editor with a strong VFX and AfterEffects skillset to elevate our social content during the 2026–2027 Unrivaled season. The engagement is expected to begin on December 26, 2026 and continue through approximately mid-March 2027, subject to completion of the agreed scope of services. The services are expected to be performed remotely, except as otherwise agreed by the parties.

You'll be our go-to for building out motion graphics, adding visual effects, and creating animation templates to turn our highlights, campaigns, and partner content into more dynamic and visually driven pieces — while staying tightly aligned with our internal brand system and partner/sponsor guidelines.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Design and execute visual effects, motion graphics, and animated elements for short-form and long-form social content (game highlights, hype content, partner & campaign assets, sponsor integrations)
  • Build and maintain reusable AE templates, title cards, lower thirds, and effect packages that allow the broader content team to edit quickly without sacrificing quality
  • Partner with the social, brand, and partnerships teams to ensure every asset reflects current brand guidelines and any partner/sponsor-specific requirements (logo placement, color, messaging restrictions, usage rights)
  • Elevate raw footage with color correction, compositing, and effects work that matches Unrivaled's visual identity across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and other platforms
  • Collaborate with Content Producers and the Social team to conceptualize effects-driven content from pre-production to post-production
  • Manage multiple projects and quick-turn requests in a fast-paced, real-time sports content environment
  • Maintain organization of all created assets, project files and version control within our asset and archive systems

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 3+ years of video editing experience with a portfolio that demonstrates strong VFX/motion graphics work, beyond storytelling & narrative editing
  • Advanced proficiency in Adobe After Effects (required); proficiency across multiple video editing software is highly valued ie. (Premiere Pro, Davinci, Final Cut Pro)
  • Experience building a reusable motion graphic templates & effects system that scale across a content calendar, not just one-off pieces
  • An eye for brand consistency — you can take guidelines and translate them into visually engaging work rather than treating them as a constraint
  • Strong communication is a must given the remote nature of this role, must be able to respond in a timely matter consistently
  • Must be knowledgeable of different file types with the ability to convert files types as needed
  • Bonus: experience in sports, live events, or fast-moving social-first content environments

Unrivaled is an equal opportunity organization. All qualified individuals will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, ancestry, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other basis protected under applicable federal, state or local law.

raw.excerpt: About EngineEngine is the AI-native platform for intelligent travel.
raw.description:
About Engine

Engine is the AI-native platform for intelligent travel. For a decade, Engine has built the proprietary technology and supply behind modern business travel, serving over 40,000 customers and nearly 2 million travelers, along with leading travel and AI companies that build on Engine's infrastructure. One system powers business travel, group travel, human agents, and AI agents.

That work has earned recognition as one of Fast Company's Best Workplaces for Innovators (2025), TravelTech's Reservation Platform of the Year (2026), and one of Built In's Best Places to Work (2020–2026).

We're looking for bold, ambitious people to help redefine how businesses manage and experience travel. Working here, you can expect exponential growth, an ambitious pace, full ownership, and high-caliber colleagues who push you to do the best work of your career. Every hire raises the bar.

Come outpace the ordinary and build the future of travel with us.

Join Our Journey at Engine
At Engine, we’re revolutionizing work travel. Our modern travel platform isn’t just about booking trips; it’s about transforming how businesses and their teams experience travel. From seamless booking with top airlines, hotels, and car rental providers to single-invoice billing and flexible trip modifications, we make travel easier to manage and better to experience.

Engine is bringing its platform to the corporate-travel channel: travel management companies (TMCs) sign on, bring their corporate accounts, and book flights, hotels, and cars on Engine, direct bill, and Flex built in. Every TMC we sign, and every corporate account behind it, has to be configured, trained, and taken through its first booking before any of that value shows up. That work is this job.

Your Mission:

As Senior Lead OBT Implementation Manager, you'll own the path from signed agreement to live, booking TMC. You'll stand each agency up on Engine (GDS credentials, agency profile, queues, agent access), configure their corporate accounts (travelers, departments, travel policies, direct bill, Flex, custom fields, rewards), train their agents, and hold the timeline across several activations at once. You'll be our first dedicated implementer, which means you define how Engine implements TMCs: you build the playbook while you run it, set the standard for the implementers who follow you, and make sure the twentieth TMC goes live in a fraction of the time the second one did.

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead TMC implementations end to end: kickoff, discovery and scoping, project plan, risk log, go-live, and 30-day stabilization. Run several launches in parallel.
  • Configure the platform for each TMC and its corporate clients: travel policy, approval flows, traveler profiles, display and content rules, Engine-only rates alongside TMC-negotiated rate programs, and chain rate-access approvals.
  • Own GDS readiness across Sabre, Travelport, and Amadeus: pseudo-city and agency setup, PNR structure, queue placement, profile sync, ticketing and mid-office handoff.
  • Scope and deliver integrations: SSO, HRIS profile feeds, expense systems, duty of care, reporting and BI, commission tracking.
  • Run UAT with TMC agents and corporate admins; triage defects with Product and Engineering; make the go/no-go call.
  • Build the implementation playbook: standard timelines, configuration templates, UAT scripts, and migration runbooks for corporates moving from legacy OBTs or from Engine.com self-serve onto Engine OBT+.
  • Train agents, admins, and travel managers; produce written and video collateral they can reuse.
  • Feed the roadmap: document TMC requirements and gaps, and carry the implementation lens into product reviews.
  • Support Sales on pre-sale technical discovery, RFPs, and implementation scoping for enterprise TMCs.

What You'll Bring to Engine:

  • 7+ years in implementation, onboarding, or customer success, including time at a TMC or a travel technology company, and at least one role where you built the process rather than ran someone else's.
  • Hands-on GDS experience in at least one of Sabre, Travelport, or Amadeus. Multi-GDS is a strong plus.
  • Hands-on experience administering or supporting an online booking tool (Concur, Deem, Spotnana, or similar): profiles, policies, approvals, payment and billing setup.
  • Strong written communication: you can turn a setup call into a reusable guide and a customer problem into a clear brief for Product.
  • You've managed or mentored other implementers, or built an implementation function from the first hire.
  • Comfort using AI tools to document, diagnose, and scale implementation content without sacrificing accuracy or depth.

Bonus points

  • You've worked inside a TMC and know the account-manager and agent workflows from the inside.
  • Experience with direct bill, central billing, or corporate card setup in a travel program.
  • Background in meetings and events or group travel.

Applications for this role will be accepted through February 20 or until the role is filled. We encourage you to apply early, as we may begin reviewing applications before the deadline.

OTE Compensation
In addition to a competitive base salary, our listed compensation range includes the estimated variable target. Your OTE (on-target earnings) are based on several factors including your experience, expertise, and location. In addition, all roles receive equity. Your recruiter will share your complete compensation package as you move through the process.

Total OTE Range (Base Salary + Variable)
$185,000—$210,000 USD

The Engine Edge: Perks & Compensation
We believe in rewarding great work with great benefits:

  • Compensation: Competitive base pay tied to role and experience, with equity for all employees. Some roles are also eligible for bonuses or commissions.
  • Benefits: Check out our full list at
  • Environments for Success: Different roles have different needs in terms of the environments that drive success which is why we have a hybrid-hub model. Whether you are in one of our amazing offices or fully remote, we'll make sure you have what you need to succeed.

Perks and benefits may vary based on employment type, location, and more

The Crown Is Yours

As a Senior Technical Program Manager, Data, you’ll lead high-impact data initiatives across our Sportsbook Trading domain, connecting business priorities with scalable technical solutions. You’ll partner across Engineering, Analytics, Trading, and Data teams to define what we build, align priorities, and drive complex programs from concept through delivery. You’ll bring structure to ambiguous challenges while helping evolve the data capabilities that power our Sportsbook platform.

What you’ll bring

  • A Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field and at least 4 years of experience in technical program management, technical product management, engineering leadership, or a similar role.
  • Ability to work Eastern Time Zone business hours to support seamless collaboration with cross-functional teams.
  • Experience working in Sportsbook, iGaming, Trading, or another closely related data-intensive environment.
  • Experience using AI to improve workflows through agents, automation, or other reusable solutions.
  • Strong SQL skills and the ability to analyze data, validate assumptions, and turn insights into decisions.
  • Experience with data platforms such as Snowflake, Databricks, or Sigma and an understanding of data pipelines, extract-transform-load processes, and data architecture.
  • Strong technical communication skills with the ability to turn complex challenges into clear requirements and actionable plans.

At Orica, it’s the power of our people that leads change and shapes our futures. Every day, all around the world, our people help mobilise vital resources essential to progress. About the role

We are seeking a Underground Mine Planning & Blast Design Engineer (Remote) to support Orica's global underground mining operations through the delivery of high-quality drill and blast engineering services. This role is part of Orica's growing Remote Engineering & Design Services capability and provides a unique opportunity to apply underground mining expertise while working from a central engineering hub in Hyderabad.

You will work closely with underground mining operations, technical services teams, global subject matter experts, and WebGen™ specialists across multiple regions. You will be responsible for reviewing, validating, and optimizing underground drill and blast designs, supporting loading package development, analysing blast performance, and delivering technical recommendations that drive safe and successful blasting outcomes.

This is an exciting opportunity for underground mining professionals who want to remain highly technical while gaining exposure to global operations. Instead of being permanently based at a mine site, you will support multiple underground metal mining operations around the world, working alongside industry-leading experts and helping shape the future of remote mining engineering services.

What you will be doing

  • Deliver remote underground engineering services including drill and blast design reviews, loading package creation, and design validation for global WebGen™ operations.
  • Develop, review, and optimize underground blast designs to ensure safety, quality, and operational effectiveness.
  • Act as a technical quality gatekeeper by reviewing blast designs and loading packages against Orica standards and critical control requirements.
  • Analyse blast measurements and performance data to identify opportunities for improvement and optimization.
  • Evaluate stope performance, dilution, recovery, blast outcomes, and design success factors to support continuous improvement initiatives.
  • Prepare technical reports, benchmarking studies, and performance analyses for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with underground operations, technical services teams, WebGen™ specialists, and engineering experts across multiple global regions.
  • Ensure delivery of engineering services within agreed service levels and operational timelines.
  • Support mentoring, knowledge sharing, and capability development within the remote engineering team.
  • Identify and contribute to automation, workflow improvement, and efficiency initiatives that enhance engineering service delivery.

What you will bring

  • Bachelor's Degree in Mining Engineering.
  • Minimum 5 years of experience in underground metal mining with strong exposure to underground drill and blast design and mine planning.
  • Hands-on experience in stope design and evaluation, including assessment of dilution, recovery, blast performance, and stope stability.
  • Strong understanding of underground mining methods such as Longhole Open Stoping, Cut & Fill, and Sublevel Stoping.
  • Demonstrated experience reviewing and interpreting blast performance data and post-blast reconciliation outcomes.
  • Experience using ShotPlus™ UG or other industry-recognized underground blast design software.
  • Strong technical problem-solving skills with the ability to make sound engineering decisions in a dynamic operational environment.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across global teams and cultures.
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail, accountability, and commitment to quality and safety.
  • Experience with Deswik, underground mine planning software, WebGen™, or electronic blasting technologies will be highly regarded.

What we offer

As part of a truly global company, you will have the ability to grow and learn in a diverse, collaborative culture. We foster relationships and learning through connected global and local teams, promote flexible and diverse career paths and support the development of your knowledge and skills.

You will be paid a competitive salary, learn from talented individuals across multiple disciplines and be able to thrive in a safe workplace within a collaborative culture. Ignite your career at a place where your distinct potential can find its home.

We respect and value all

Orica promotes and fosters a culture of inclusion and Equal Opportunity Employment everywhere we operate. We treat our people and applicants with fairness, dignity, and respect, getting the best of everyone’s contributions.   • Technical Expertise you will leverage your solid technology expertise to review and analyze current client software and requirements to determine the most effective solution to include in business proposals; install, upgrade and customize ISV software tools in a multi-system z/OS mainframe environment, and help to ensure software and hardware remains current to avoid End of Support costs.

    • Demonstrated ability to handle maintenance and upgrades as well as applying maintenance patches to MQ systems.

    • Good understanding of MQ security including access controls, encryption, and authentication.
    • Experience troubleshooting and problem solving MQ related issues, including message flow interruptions or performance related issues.
    • Experience maintaining comprehensive documentation for MQ environments as well as any operational procedures.
    • Good understanding on how MQ integrates with DB2, IMS and CICS, and have strong knowledge of networking including TCP/IP for MQ communication.

  • Analyze quality trends and identify root causes of recurring defects.

    • LLM evaluation

    • Prompt-response evaluation

    • Image/video/audio annotation

  1. Solve and validate aerodynamic and fluid-dynamics problems.
  2. Translate physical requirements into computational models and solver-ready cases.
  3. Create or modify geometries, computational domains, and meshes.
  4. Define appropriate initial conditions, boundary conditions, fluid properties, and solver settings.
  5. Run CFD and aerodynamic-analysis workflows using command-line-accessible tools.
  6. Use Python to automate preprocessing, simulation execution, parameter sweeps, postprocessing, and validation.

Required Qualifications

  1. An MS or PhD in Aerospace Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering with an aerodynamics, fluid dynamics, or thermofluids specialization; or
  2. A BS in Aerospace or Mechanical Engineering plus at least 1–2 years of aero-specific professional or research experience.
  3. Strong understanding of fluid mechanics and applied aerodynamics.
  4. Experience formulating and executing CFD or aerodynamic analyses.
  5. Practical proficiency with Python.
  6. Experience with at least one engineering tool or library that can be operated through a CLI, scripting interface, configuration files, or programmatic API.
  7. Ability to select and justify modeling assumptions, boundary conditions, mesh strategies, and solver settings.
  8. Ability to diagnose non-convergence, unstable solutions, incorrect results, and physically invalid outputs.
  9. Ability to communicate technical reasoning and engineering trade-offs clearly.

Relevant tools may include Python,OpenFOAM, SU2, Gmsh, FEniCSx, Elmer, CalculiX, SciPy, or similar programmatic engineering software. Experience with an equivalent CLI-accessible tool is acceptable.

Relevant Python tools may include NumPy, SciPy, pandas, Matplotlib, Jupyter, solver APIs, mesh-processing libraries, or domain-specific scientific packages. No single library is mandatory.

Process

  1. Apply to the role and complete the screening questions.
  2. Complete an AI interview of approximately 30 minutes.
  3. Complete the hiring manager review.

Compensation Structure

Compensation is output-based. Experts are paid per task that meets the project specifications. The time required to complete each task may vary depending on the expert’s experience and workflow.

Minimum submission requirements apply.

Start Timeline & Availability

  1. We typically fill roles within 48 hours and are looking for experts who are ready to begin immediately. If selected, you will be expected to start your first task within 24–48 hours of completing onboarding.

Title: Legal Operations Specialist, Technology and AI
Location: All Canada - Remote

The world of payment processing is rapidly evolving, and businesses are looking for loyal and strategic partners, to help them grow.

Meet Nuvei, Nuvei is the global fintech building the infrastructure for every payment, everywhere. Its modular, flexible, and scalable technology enables leading companies to accept next-generation payments, offer all payout options, and benefit from card issuing, banking, risk, and fraud management services. Connecting businesses to their customers in more than 200 markets, with local acquiring in 52 markets, 150 currencies, and over 720 alternative payment methods, Nuvei provides the technology and insights for customers and partners to succeed locally and globally through one integration.

At Nuvei, we live our core values, and we thrive on solving complex problems. We’re dedicated to continually improving our product and providing relentless customer service. We are always looking for exceptional talent to join us on the journey!

Your Mission:

Nuvei is looking for a Legal Operations Specialist, Technology & AI to join its Legal Department. This is a new role, created to bring dedicated technical expertise into a legal function that has been actively building out its processes and tools. This is an exciting opportunity for an individual who is a self-starter, enjoys taking ownership and is eager to drive meaningful change.

The person in this role will be responsible for the systems and automation that support Nuvei’s legal team. That means configuring and maintaining legal technology platforms, connecting them to the enterprise tools the business already uses, and leading the build of automated workflows that reduce manual effort. Where processes are slow or manual, this person will work with lawyers and legal ops colleagues to understand the problem and fix it.

The role sits within the Legal Department and works in close collaboration with Nuvei’s IT, Product and AI/Innovation teams. This is not an isolated function. The expectation is that this person can gather requirements from lawyers and legal colleagues and then work across those technical teams to deliver solutions.

AI is part of the toolkit. The role includes building AI-assisted workflows on top of existing platforms, including contract redline tools, document intake automation and AI-powered assistants for the legal team.

A legal background is not required, but comfort working in a legal and regulated environment is important. This role will suit someone with 5+ years of experience in a business systems, operations technology or enterprise SaaS environment who is technically hands-on and curious about AI.

Responsibilities:

The role covers three areas. The scope and balance of work will evolve as the function grows.

Systems, Integrations & Process Improvement

• Configure, administer and maintain legal technology platforms including CLM, matter management, document management and e-billing, working within Nuvei’s existing enterprise environment.

• Build and maintain integrations between legal platforms and other systems used across the business, including Salesforce, SharePoint and Power BI, working with IT and Product teams on technical requirements and architecture.

• Work with lawyers and legal ops colleagues to identify where processes are slow, manual or error-prone; map those workflows and implement improvements.

• Assess gaps between current platform capabilities and what the legal team needs; recommend and deliver solutions.

• Produce process documentation, business requirement documents and functional specifications.

• Support the evaluation and selection of new tools, providing technical input on integration requirements and platform fit.

Automation & AI Tools

• Build automated workflows such as Power Automate or equivalent, reducing repetitive manual tasks across the legal function.

• Develop AI-assisted tools on top of legal platforms, including contract automation, document intake workflows, watched-folder triggers and Copilot-based tools for the legal team, in collaboration with Nuvei’s AI and Innovation team.

• Connect AI tools to existing systems via APIs; manage prompt libraries, workflow configurations and documentation.

• Support the Legal Department in adopting new tools, including training and troubleshooting.

Reporting & Data

• Build and maintain dashboards and reports in Power BI or equivalent, covering workload, contract cycle times, team performance and other operational metrics for legal leadership.

• Analyze operational data to identify patterns, surface inefficiencies and flag automation opportunities.

• Define and track KPIs for the legal function, working with legal colleagues and the BI team.

Requirements

• 5+ years of experience in business systems, operations technology or enterprise systems role, with a track record of configuring SaaS platforms, building integrations and driving technology-enabled process improvements.

• Practical experience configuring and administering enterprise platforms such as Salesforce, SharePoint and Power BI, including connecting them to other systems through automation tools and APIs.

• Experience leading or championing cross-functional projects, influencing stakeholders, and driving change in environments where collaboration, initiative, and ownership are critical to success.

• Demonstrated ability to identify process problems, map workflows and deliver solutions that reduce manual effort.

• Able to gather requirements from non-technical colleagues and translate them into working technical solutions.

• Strong analytical skills; comfortable with data, reporting and using metrics to guide decisions.

• Clear and direct communicator, able to work effectively across technical and non-technical teams.

• Bachelor’s Degree in a related field or equivalent experience.

Assets

• Experience with legal technology platforms including contract lifecycle management and matter management tools.

• Experience building workflows that incorporate AI tools - for example, automating document review, intake or routing using platforms like Claude, Microsoft Copilot or similar.

• SQL, data modeling or scripting experience in Python or JavaScript.

• Background in a regulated industry, particularly fintech, payments or financial services.

• Experience working in or supporting an in-house legal or compliance team.

• Familiarity with AI governance or responsible AI practices in a business context.

Benefits

Nuvei is an equal-opportunity employer that celebrates collaboration and innovation and is committed to developing a diverse and inclusive workplace. The team at Nuvei is comprised of a wealth of talent, skill, and ambition. We believe that employees are happiest when they’re empowered to be their true, authentic selves. So, please come as you are. We can’t wait to meet you.

  • Competitive holiday allowance
  • Group Insurance Benefits
  • Flexible working model
  • Employee Assistance Program

Our recruitment process may use automated tools, including AI, to support application management and candidate shortlisting.

Working Language
English (written and spoken) is the language used most of the time, as work colleagues, clients, and strategic suppliers are geographically dispersed.

Ontario Compliant Range: 80,000 CAD-100,000 CAD

Our client is a game-changing social trading platform aimed at becoming the one-stop DeFi app!

Whenever a user portfolio is copied, he/she earns associated royalties. The more copies of a portfolio are made, the more royalties a user will earn!

Our client's team has put a lot of effort into designing the most user-friendly dApp, while preserving the highest level of decentralization.

Our client has raised more than $8M from the most renowned institutional and angel investors, including Alan Howard & Jump.


Our vision:
Today, there are less than 1M DeFi users worldwide, while there are 90M verified Coinbase users. Most CeFi users will become DeFi users during the next adoption wave. They will look for a decentralized platform with a similar user experience to trading applications they are accustomed to.

This role is responsible for guiding participants through their employer-sponsored retirement plans, including educating them on plan benefits, employer matching contributions, and investment strategies, while helping them make informed decisions about their retirement savings.   • Demonstrated initiative and a proactive approach to identifying client needs and opportunities
  • Strong organizational, time management, and prioritization skills in a fast-paced environment
  • Openness to coaching, performance feedback, and adapting to evolving business needs and priorities
  • Ability to effectively leverage planning tools and resources to help participants assess and improve their retirement readiness
  • Proven ability to conduct needs-based conversations, identify appropriate solutions, and support asset acquisition, retention, and growth

The Team

The Tax-Exempt Market Planning & Advice (TEMPA) organization exists to help employees in our tax-exempt workplace communities. Our mission is to serve as a trusted partner for plan sponsors and participants, providing education and financial planning and advice for our 403b and 457 plan participants. Our value is delivered to over one million plan participants every year, encouraging them to reach their financial goals and bringing the broader Fidelity Advantage to life.

Fidelity is transitioning to a full-time onsite working model through a phased rollout across regions and roles. Sales

raw.description:
This position is with the Global Strategic Communications Council (GSCC), a global network of communications professionals in the field of climate, energy and nature. GSCC is a programme hosted by the Meliore Foundation.
The newly expanded Climate Litigation communications team aims to generate a global shift in discussions and understandings of developments in climate-related litigation. The Strategic Communications Associate, Climate Litigation, will produce and deliver high-impact communications that execute and bring to life our climate litigation strategy.
The Associate will support GSCC desks across the world to shape narratives by building relationships with partners and media, drafting briefings, press releases and other communications materials, developing digital strategies, and monitoring results.
Reporting to the Strategic Communications Lead, Climate Litigation, the Associate will drive the day-to-day execution and delivery of communications outputs, translating global strategy into actionable interventions that build understanding of the content and implications of climate-related litigation. This includes working across a range of channels, including earned media, broadcast, and social media.
The Associate will also lead on digital strategy for the team, coordinating with colleagues to ensure digital tactics are well integrated into communications efforts and successfully executed.
The ideal candidate is a highly organised, proactive communicator with a track record of taking the initiative and managing projects seamlessly from concept to execution. They will be a collaborative operator, skilled at building strong, trust-based relationships across diverse teams and between organisations. Previous experience with litigation or legal issues is not required.
This is a full-time position with an employment or consultant contract, subject to location, for 12 months, with possible renewal after one year depending on securing external funding.

How you'll contribute

To succeed in the role, you will:
  • Develop and deliver core communications outputs: Deliver the global climate litigation communications strategy by drafting and distributing a wide range of high-impact communications materials, including press releases, media backgrounders/briefings, social media content, campaign toolkits, and event communications support.
  • Craft targeted messaging: Develop audience-specific messaging to support short- and long-term campaign goals and ensure consistent, impactful messaging across platforms and regions.
  • Support media relations: Foster strong relationships with journalists covering climate, energy, and litigation. Help brief reporters, pitch story angles, and boost understanding of the implications of climate-related litigation.
  • Lead on digital strategy: Work with digital experts and partner colleagues to develop and ensure successful implementation of digital strategies.
  • Partner and desk support: Work closely with partner organisations and GSCC national teams worldwide, building high-trust relationships to coordinate joint communications and align strategy.
  • Impact monitoring and reporting: Keep track of media hits and campaign outcomes. Collect, evaluate, and contribute to tracking data to help assess impact, refine cross-border strategies, and improve future campaign activities.

Our ideal candidate has

  • Experience in media relations tactics, including pitching, messaging coordination, briefing journalists, and identifying or preparing spokespeople.
  • Experience working across digital platforms and channels to achieve communications goals.
  • Outstanding partnership skills, with the ability to support, influence and coordinate a range of partners towards common objectives.
  • Experience identifying, briefing, and supporting diverse spokespeople, including experts, community representatives, and campaign partners.
  • Experience crafting clear, compelling written content targeted to specific audiences and platforms.
  • Highly organised with strong project management skills; able to bring clarity to complex multi-stakeholder environments, work independently, and meet tight deadlines.
  • Has a baseline understanding of key climate and energy issues, and has experience of translating technical issues into accessible, effective communications outputs.
  • High levels of self-motivation, with the ability to work quickly as part of dispersed international teams and to pivot quickly to reactive communications in response to events.
  • Versatile and adaptable, with the necessary skills to flourish in a fast-paced work environment and work across time zones using tools including the Google Workspace suite and Slack.
  • Fluency in written and spoken English, our working language; additional languages are an asset.
  • The disposition to work generously with colleagues in a high-trust global community of peers.
  • Committed to an inclusive and empowering approach to addressing climate change.

Why join us?

  • Be part of a remote-first, international network of professionals working on climate, energy and nature and work with a bunch of dynamic, culturally diverse individuals who combine their passion to make a difference with a rigorous and results-oriented approach to work.
  • 6 offline days (with no calls or meetings) per year to focus on your work
  • Reduced working time on Fridays during the Dry Season (summer)
  • Access to our employee assistance program to support your mental health and personal development
  • Supplementary paid business closure for end-of-year holidays
  • Maternity leave matched to 20 weeks for countries where regulation allows less than that
  • Enjoy regular opportunities to connect and collaborate with colleagues around the world
  • A full-time position with an employment or consultant contract, subject to location, for 12 months, with possible renewal after one year.
Location: flexibly remote, ideally within +/- 3 hours CET

Europe: France, Germany, Italy, Spain, Poland, The Netherlands, UK.
Africa: Kenya, Nigeria, Senegal, South Africa.

Some international travel will be required. We may be able to provide co-working spaces in some locations. Only candidates with the right to work in their location will be considered.

Contract and Benefits disclaimer: Contract type and some benefits may vary by jurisdiction. We will confirm eligibility and the applicable terms during the hiring process.

Salary / Fee: Meliore sets compensation levels through a systematic alignment with local market data, taking into account the responsibility level of each role or the expected level of services and the skills and experience of the selected candidate. We apply a consistent, equitable, compensation policy, and provide data on our calculations and pay or fee ranges, in all locations where we operate. Our compensation practices reflect our commitment to fairness, inclusion, and accountability, and are regularly reviewed to ensure alignment with evolving market standards and organisational values.

Flume Health is a software company that connects the fragmented healthcare data ecosystem for more efficient health plan administration. As a single, cloud-native integration platform, Flume’s Relay platform allows companies to easily connect various systems and vendors for efficient data exchange that’s increasingly demanded of the modern health plan. Payers, third-party administrators, prescription benefits managers, and health solutions are provided the simplicity, speed, and security they need to automate data integration and movement between relevant stakeholders. Relay supports multiple data transmission protocols, data types, and file types. By streamlining data flows between payers and solutions, a world of opportunity exists to improve access to healthcare.

Flume Health is hiring a Forward Deployed Program Manager to own program and integration delivery and solve complex client problems across our portfolio, with a primary focus on our largest accounts. You are the person who sits at the intersection of client needs, data integration complexity, and AI-powered execution. You figure out how to get things done, unblock delivery, and drive outcomes.

What makes this role different: you will build, manage, and continuously tune a team of AI agents that solve complete problems end-to-end. Diagnosing why a connection is failing, generating client-ready deliverables, automating workflows that used to take days. You are responsible for agent performance: refining prompts, improving outputs, expanding what your agents can handle, and pushing the boundary of what one person with AI leverage can deliver.

This role requires a consulting mindset: the ability to walk into ambiguity, structure the problem, mobilize resources (human and AI), and deliver. You will manage the program and integration delivery cadence, but more importantly, you will be the person clients call when something is hard and needs to get figured out.

This is not a traditional project management role. This is an execution-oriented position with a clear progression path into Flume's Forward Deployment and Strategic Deployment practice, where you will own client engagements that drive platform transformation and measurable business outcomes for health payers and TPAs.

What You'll Do

  • Client Problem-Solving:** Be the person who figures it out. When a TPA integration is failing, when a client has a data question no one can answer, when a new connection request requires scoping and creative problem-solving. You own it. Structure the problem, mobilize resources, and deliver.
  • AI Agent Management & Tuning:** Build, manage, and continuously improve a team of AI agents. You own agent performance. That means refining prompts, evaluating outputs, expanding agent capabilities, and tuning workflows to solve increasingly complex problems across integration diagnostics, client deliverables, reporting automation, intake processing, and data analysis.
  • Program & Integration Delivery Ownership:** Own the delivery cadence for our flagship account (80+ contracted connections) and a portfolio of secondary accounts. Manage the Jira intake workflow, ensure requirements are captured cleanly, and drive work through the build pipeline
  • Client-Facing Escalation:** Serve as the primary operational POC for key client IT and Business Operations stakeholders. Attend leadership calls, surface blockers early, and ensure delivery commitments are met.
  • Stakeholder Communication:** Own weekly delivery reporting to senior client stakeholders. Use AI to generate it, not your weekends
  • Cross-Account Coverage:** Provide problem-solving support across the broader client portfolio as needed, including delivery troubleshooting, integration scoping, and contract coordination.

What You'll Need

  • 5+ years in consulting, implementation, or healthcare operations:** You've been the person in the room who has to figure out a hard problem with incomplete information and deliver under pressure. Strategy consulting, management consulting, implementation, or similar client-facing delivery experience.
  • AI-native (required):** This is non-negotiable. You build agents, tune them, measure their output quality, and expand their scope over time. You don't just use AI to summarize emails. You think in terms of what a team of well-tuned agents can do, not what you can do alone.
  • Client-facing confidence:** You can sit in a daily technology leadership call with senior client stakeholders and field hard questions without flinching. You're comfortable being the single point of contact when things get complicated.
  • Structured thinker:** You walk into ambiguity and create clarity. You break down complex integration problems into workable pieces and drive them to resolution.
  • Low ego, high throughput:** You're willing to do the operational work well because you understand it's the foundation for everything strategic. No task is beneath you if it moves the client forward.
  • Healthcare exposure preferred, not required:** If you've worked with payers, providers, claims data, or health plan operations, great. If not, you're sharp enough to ramp fast.

Nice to Haves

  • Experience building, tuning, and measuring AI agent workflows to solve multi-step business problems
  • Background in strategy consulting, management consulting, or implementation delivery at a professional services firm
  • Familiarity with TPA operations, claims processing, healthcare EDI, or health plan administration
  • Experience with Jira, Snowflake, or healthcare data integration platforms
  • Comfort working in a fast-paced, early-stage environment where scope evolves quickly

Salary

$130k - $160k + equity

Flume’s Perks & Benefits

  • Flexible PTO - you’re going to be working hard so enjoy time off
  • A robust stock option plan to give our employees a direct stake in Flume’s success
  • WFH stipend - we’ve always been remote first
  • Competitive compensation and 401k with a 4% match
  • Comprehensive healthcoverage (medical, dental, vision)

Business Development Director

Location: Home Based

Department: Senior Management Team / Activate Collision Solutions

Contract type: Permanent / Full-time

About the role

We’re looking for a Business Development Director to join our Activate Collision Solutions team!

The Business Development Director is responsible for driving profitable growth, both by personally securing new business and by ensuring existing client relationships are retained, deepened and well served.

The role combines front-line sales ownership with leadership of a small team covering client relationship management and marketing, giving the postholder end-to-end accountability for winning, keeping and growing revenue.

Activate Group is a growing UK business with 1,000+ team members nationwide. This is an exciting opportunity to build a long-term career with a company that values its people and offers genuine development and progression opportunities.

Key responsibilities

Client Relationship Leadership:New business growth:

  • Building a strong network across the sector owning the new business pipeline from prospecting, through proposal to close and contract.
  • Working with marketing team to provide generic and bespoke presentations and marketing materials to secure new business wins and expand the reach and awareness of the company’s service proposition.
  • Attending industry events to promote Activate Collision Solutions and its proposition, making and strengthening relationships, leading to profitable long-term accounts
  • Represent Activate Collision Solutions with credibility and authority in client-facing forums, senior reviews, external events, strategic planning sessions and as required.

Client retention and development:

  • Supporting the Managing Director with a selection of relationships in a portfolio of major insurer and broker clients within Activate Collision Solutions, acting as a point of contact and advisor.
  • Understand each client's business model, claims processes, cost drivers, and strategic priorities, tailoring our service offerings to align with their operational and commercial goals.
  • Build strong, trusting relationships across internal and external stakeholder groups, involving the right people early and communicating openly and respectfully to strengthen long-term partnerships.
  • Act as a senior escalation point for complex client issues, ensuring swift, high-quality resolution and sustained client satisfaction.
  • Represent Activate Collision Solutions with credibility and authority in client-facing reviews, creating and delivering presentations on performance and future opportunities as required.

Commercial Performance:

  • Take full accountability for the retention, profitability, and growth of the client portfolio, delivering against revenue, margin, and volume targets.
  • Identify and pursue opportunities for account growth, service enhancement, wider group cross-sell, and innovation, building compelling business cases where investment is required.
  • Lead contract renewals, commercial negotiations, and tender responses, protecting and improving commercial terms.
  • Monitor market trends, regulatory changes, and competitor activity to inform account strategy and keep Activate Collision Solutions ahead of the industry.
  • Use insight and data to inform decisions and direction, tracking performance against KPIs and translating analysis into clear commercial action.

Service Delivery and Operational Excellence:

  • Lead regular service reviews and performance reporting, ensuring SLAs and client expectations are consistently met or exceeded across the repair network.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure seamless, high-quality delivery.
  • Assist in driving continuous improvement in service quality, efficiency, and customer outcomes, challenging outdated ways of working and championing better ones.
  • Support the development of bespoke solutions, aligned to our core activities for insurer and broker clients.
  • Anticipate delivery risks early and remove barriers before they escalate, keeping progress on track and clients informed.

Leadership and Collaboration:

  • Manage the day-to-day activities of the Client Relationship Manager, ensuring that their duties are fulfilled.
    Influencing colleagues and setting clear objectives to foster a collaborative, high-performance culture.
  • Support the development of colleagues across the business by sharing expertise, offering guidance, feedback, and recognition, and building capability without formal reporting lines.
  • Communicate updates, risks, and long-term plans consistently to senior management, building clarity and alignment across the business.
  • Work within agreed budgets and commercial governance, ensuring resources are used carefully to maximise impact.
  • Adhere to all relevant regulatory rules and guidance applicable to the role.

Leadership Behaviours:

This role is expected to lead in line with the Activate Group Leadership Competency Framework:

  • Win Together — build strong, trusting relationships with clients and internal teams; involve the right people early, communicate clearly and respectfully, remove barriers between teams, and create an inclusive culture of collaboration and shared success
  • Strive for Better — champion innovation and challenge outdated thinking; use insight and data to inform direction, welcome constructive challenge, establish ambitious standards, and continuously improve service and ways of working.
  • Make It Happen — take full accountability for decisions and outcomes; make timely, well-judged decisions even with limited information, set clear direction, remove barriers before they escalate, and deliver high-quality results at pace.

Skills and experience

  • Proven experience in new business development with motor insurers and brokers.
  • Strong understanding of motor claims, repair networks, and the accident management lifecycle.
  • Demonstrable track record of winning and growing major accounts, delivering revenue and margin targets, and leading contract renewals and negotiations.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence and build trust at senior and board level.
  • Demonstrable experience of people management.
  • Commercial awareness and analytical ability to identify growth opportunities and turn data into action.
  • Experience presenting to external stakeholders and managing complex, high-value strategic partnerships.
  • Confident leading service reviews and performance reporting, with strong data literacy (e.g. Excel, Power BI, CRM reporting tools).
  • Proficiency in CRM systems, reporting tools and Microsoft office packages (PowerPoint, Word etc).
  • Awareness of relevant regulatory and compliance requirements within the insurance and claims environment.
  • Solution-orientated, resilient, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, multi-site environment.
  • A self-starter, focused on successfully achieving goals, with a can-do attitude.
  • Flexible to travel to locations across the UK as required.

Benefits

We believe in rewarding our people for the great work they do. When you join Activate Group, you can expect:

•33 days holiday, including bank holidays

•Personal health cash plan – claim back the cost of everyday healthcare such as dental and optical check-ups

•Enhanced maternity, paternity, adoption and shared parental pay

•Life assurance at three times your basic salary

•Free breakfasts and fresh fruit

•A birthday surprise for everyone

What you can expect from us

At Activate Group, we want everyone to have the tools and support they need to do their best work. We’re an innovative business that continuously reviews and improves our systems, processes and ways of working, making sure they support our teams to do their jobs effectively.

Every role at Activate Group is aligned to our wider business vision and purpose – making someone’s bad day better. You’ll understand how your role contributes to the bigger picture and how your work helps deliver excellent outcomes for customer and partners.

We believe work should be enjoyable. We make time to celebrate success, recognise achievements and bring people together at team events and company-wide celebrations. We’ll also support your ongoing development through regular feedback and career planning.

Whether you’re based in one of our contact centres in Halifax, Peterborough or Huddersfield, working at an Activate Accident Repair (AAR) site, or working from home, you’ll be part of a supportive culture where people are encouraged to succeed.

A bit about us

Activate Group is a fast-growing business approaching 1,000 team members nationwide.

We work with some of the UK’s largest fleets and insurance companies, supporting drivers that have been involved in road incidents through our contact centres in Halifax, Peterborough and Huddersfield.

We manage every step of the repair journey - repairing vehicles at our own Activate Accident Repair (AAR) body shops, as well as through a UK-wide network of trusted independent repair partners.

We also work with the UK’s largest vehicle manufacturers, supporting their approved repair programmes, and deliver innovative technology solutions to fleets, vehicle repair centres and dealerships.

Our purpose & values

Our purpose underpins everything we do: Make someone’s bad day better

Our values define how we work with our team members, customers and suppliers:

•Make it happen – Be accountable. Take the initiative, work fast, and do a great job.

•Strive for better – Be bold. Challenge the norm - make small improvements often.

•Win together – Be a team player. Win together, learn together, respect each other.

We take great strides to ensure our employees have the resources to live well, be healthy, continue learning, develop skills, grow professionally and serve our local communities. We invite you to apply for a career with us.


Residency in or relocation to Louisiana is preferred for all positions.


Applicants must be authorized to work for Louisiana Blue in the United States without employer-sponsored immigration support. Louisiana Blue will not provide current or future employment-based immigration sponsorship or other immigration support for this opportunity, including H-1B, L-1, O-1, H-1B1, E-3, TN, or J-1 sponsorship or F-1 OPT/STEM OPT/CPT support. Applicants who would require such sponsorship or employer support during their employment should not pursue this opportunity.

POSITION PURPOSE

This position is responsible for auditing providers to ensure correct medical coding and billing practices, enforce reimbursement and member agreement compliance, and recover incorrect payments. Additionally, this position is responsible for complying with all laws and regulations that are associated with duties and responsibilities.

NATURE AND SCOPE
  • This role does not manage people
  • This role reports to this job: MANAGER, PAYMENT INTEGRITY, CLINICAL
  • Necessary Contacts: In order to effectively fulfill this position the incumbent must be in contact with:

    All levels of BCBSLA personnel; other insurance carriers, agencies and professional organizations; other Blue Cross Plans; physicians and their office personnel; hospital and allied provider administration and personnel; Blue Cross subscribers; medical/surgical suppliers; attorneys; medical specialty organizations (i.e. American College of Obstetric and Gynecology); national medical coding associations (i.e. American Academy of Professional Coders, AHIMA, AMA); Blue Cross Association and CMS (Medicare).
QUALIFICATIONS

Education
  • Bachelor's Degree in Nursing or RN Certification required
Work Experience
  • 2 years of experience as an RN required
  • Experience in multi-speciality setting preferred
  • Experience with provider billing practices, American Medical Association coding guidelines, Correct Coding Initiative edits, Physician Specialty guidelines, BCBSLA reimbursement programs, provider agreements, claims adjudication processes, and regulatory agency policies (CMS/HCFA, DOI, State regulations) preferred
Skills and Abilities
  • A thorough knowledge of disease processes and medical and surgical procedures is required.
  • Good research, audit skills and prior background in audit-related functions is preferred.
  • Must have excellent oral and written communication skills.
  • Good analytical, organizational, and interpersonal skills.
  • Working knowledge of relevant software (Word, Excel) and ability to learn new applications is necessary.
  • Must be able to travel overnight, up to one week, in personal vehicle.
Licenses and Certifications
  • Current, unrestricted Nursing\RN - Registered Nurse - State Licensure And/Or current, unrestricted Compact State Licensure RN licensed to practice in Louisiana 1 year required
  • Current, unrestricted Nursing\RN - Registered Nurse - State Licensure And/Or current, unrestricted Compact State Licensure RN license to practice in states other than Louisiana 1 year preferred
  • If there is a restriction allowed by a relevant jurisdiction, according to the medical director or clinical director, it is of the type that does not affect the health professional’s ability to fulfill the roles and responsibilities of a reviewer
  • Medical coding background (ICD9 and CPT4) preferred
  • Certified Professional Coder (CPC) preferred
ACCOUNTABILITIES AND ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS
  • Audit providers to ensure correct medical coding and billing practices, enforce reimbursement and member agreement compliance, and recover incorrect payments.
  • Resolve CPT or ICD9 reimbursement and medical coding appeals and inquiries for internal and external requests to clarify medical coding issues, clinical editor bundling, medical coding policy, coding-related reimbursement and medical policy issues.
  • Identify provider reimbursement related problems, including medical coding and processing issues. Research, audit, and make recommendation for corrective action by providers or BCBSLA.
  • Maintain a thorough understanding of medical coding guidelines, provider operations and billing systems, contract benefits, claims procedures, provider contracts and reimbursement agreements.
  • Engages in provider relations activities which assist in provider and subscriber problem resolution and maintain a positive Plan image.
  • Research and identify excessive medical coding and charge patterns, and over utilization of services to support provider contracting and reimbursement negotiation efforts.
Additional Accountabilities and Essential Functions
The Physical Demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the Accountabilities and Essential Functions of the job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable an individual with disabilities to perform the essential functions
  • Perform other job-related duties as assigned, within your scope of responsibilities.
  • Job duties are performed in a normal and clean office environment with normal noise levels.
  • Work is predominately done while standing or sitting.
  • The ability to comprehend, document, calculate, visualize, and analyze are required.

An Equal Opportunity Employer

All internal employees please apply through Workday Careers.

PLEASE USE A WEB BROWSER OTHER THAN INTERNET EXPLORER IF YOU ENCOUNTER ISSUES (CHROME, FIREFOX, SAFARI)

Additional Information

Please be sure to monitor your email frequently for communications you may receive during the recruiting process. Due to the high volume of applications we receive, only those most qualified will be contacted. To monitor the status of your application, please visit the "My Applications" section in the Candidate Home section of your Workday account.

If you are an individual with a disability and require a reasonable accommodation to complete an application, please contact for assistance.

In support of our mission to improve the health and lives of Louisianians, we encourage the good health of its employees and visitors. We want to ensure that our employees have a work environment that will optimize personal health and well-being. Due to the acknowledged hazards from exposure to environmental tobacco smoke, and in order to promote good health, our company properties are smoke and tobacco free.

We perform background and pre-employment drug screening after an offer has been extended and prior to hire for all positions. As part of this process records may be verified and information checked with agencies including but not limited to the Social Security Administration, criminal courts, federal, state, and county repositories of criminal records, Department of Motor Vehicles and credit bureaus. Pursuant with sec 1033 of the Violent Crime Control and Law Enforcement Act of 1994, individuals who have been convicted of a felony crime involving dishonesty or breach of trust are prohibited from working in the insurance industry unless they obtain written consent from their state insurance commissioner.

Additionally, we are a Drug Free Workplace. A pre-employment drug screen will be required and any offer is contingent upon satisfactory drug testing results.

POSITION SUMMARY:

The Counsel-Licensing position is within Milliman’s legal department and provides analysis and counsel on legal issues. This position primarily supports key business leaders in Milliman’s Health division. The successful applicant will collaborate with Milliman team members to understand business goals and requirements. They will also work to ensure compliance with Milliman’s legal and risk management policies. Reports to an Associate General Counsel (AGC).

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Contract Drafting, Review and Negotiation

  • Draft, redline, negotiate and advise on assigned contract types, including, NDAs, SOWs, amendments, consulting service agreements, business associate agreements, master service agreements, SaaS subscriptions, SLAs, software licensing agreements and vendor agreements
  • Under the guidance of Associate General Counsel, draft templates

Counsel

Compliance and Risk Management

  • Under the guidance of AGC, interpret and advise on policies.

  • Support Firm, GCS or Department Initiatives, as directed

Travel

SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS REQUIRED:

  • The ideal candidate must have intermediate working knowledge of Microsoft Word, and Outlook, working knowledge of SharePoint and OneNote.
  • The ideal candidate must have Contract Management System experience (Agiloft preferred).

  • Must have excellent project management skills including the ability to prepare, prioritize and complete work plans.
  • Must have strong collaboration skills and ability to work well within all levels of the organization.
  • Must have the ability to work autonomously.
  • Must have the proven ability to collaborate effectively in a fast-paced, multidisciplinary environment.

SKILLS & QUALIFICATIONS PREFERRED:

  • Understanding of regulatory requirements specific to the healthcare sector.

LOCATION:

  • This is a remote role. This job posting is expected to close on October 30th, 2026

COMPENSATION:

The overall range for this role is $131,600 - $249,780. For candidates residing in:

  • Alaska, California, Connecticut, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, New Jersey, New York City, Pennsylvania, Virginia, Washington, or the District of Columbia the range is $151,340 - $249,780.

A combination of factors will be considered, including, but not limited to, education, relevant work experience, qualifications, skills, certifications, etc.

  • Medical, Dental and Vision – Coverage for employees, dependents, and domestic partners.

  • 401(k) Plan – Includes a company matching program and profit-sharing contributions.

  • Family Building Benefits – Includes adoption and fertility assistance.
  • Paid Parental Leave – 11 weeks of paid leave for employees who meet eligibility criteria.
  • Life Insurance & AD&D – 100% of premiums covered by Milliman.

ABOUT MILLIMAN:

Independent for over 77 years, Milliman delivers market-leading services and solutions to clients worldwide. Today, we are helping companies take on some of the world’s most critical and complex issues, including retirement funding and healthcare financing, risk management and regulatory compliance, data analytics and business transformation.
