Job Category

Sales

Job Details

About Salesforce

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.

Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.

Overview
The Solution Engineer is a role that we often hire at Salesforce. If you are interested in any type of Solution Engineering role, you've come to the right place. We look forward to reviewing your application and finding the right role for you! By applying to the Solution Engineer role, recruiters and hiring managers who support multiple cloud offerings and verticals across the organization will review your resume. Our goal is for you to apply once and have your resume reviewed by multiple hiring teams. Please note some of these positions may be office-based, office-flexible or remote depending on the team.

Do you want to be part of an outstanding team that is selling into the worlds top organizations? Come join us at the Salesforce Solution Engineering team. Through collaboration with the customer, the Products team, and Professional Services the Solutions Engineers develop thoughtful solutions that help our customers connect with their customers in new ways. This unique perspective creates an opportunity for the SE to interact with the entire customer lifecycle. If you enjoy a fast-paced environment full of exciting challenges and opportunities to build compelling Solutions then the Solution Engineering Team is the department for you. The SE world is a dynamic, constantly evolving environment where expertise in design, business consulting and technology is used every day to drive innovation.

The Solution Engineer must have a strong desire to demonstrate their technical and/or sales skills, including the ability to solicit business requirements, develop a technical sales strategy, configure and successfully demonstrate the solutions that address these requirements and provide business value.

What roles are we looking to fill in Solutions Engineering?
The SE team is organized into several smaller teams based on the products they are selling, or theindustry/vertical they are selling into aligning with the sales teams. In addition, we have Core Teams that sell the entire Salesforce Platform while our Co Prime teams specialize in a specific cloud solution including but not limited to Marketing Cloud, Service Cloud, Commerce Cloud, Heroku, Quip and more. We hire based on skills/experience and are open to hiring at all levels for the right candidate.

Responsibilities

Must have experience within Manufacturing, specifically Automotive, Utilities, or Energy.

  • A Solution Engineer plays a pivotal role in aligning innovative strategies to technology solutions within complex accounts. This role focuses on partnering with clients and collaborating with internal team members and C-level client contacts to drive consensus on multi-product technology solutions across the various Salesforce product lines.Solutions Engineers work on a wide array of assignments including business development, operations and IT strategies, as well as executive level product demonstrations. This person must assume the role of trusted advisor for driving innovative solutions forward while also improving business performance.Business Problem Solving: Take ambiguous and sophisticated business problems and using research and business assessment capabilities, define the problem, drive innovative ideas, define the opportunity set, and recommend practical next steps.Innovation Management: Bring focus to a client's decision making process by communicating and evaluating solution options, and driving consensus among key collaborators. In some instances, we help our clients develop new decision frameworks and governance processes that continue to deliver value far beyond a particular engagement.Connect Experiences: Demonstrate through software demos and rapid prototyping how connected experiences come to life with The Salesforce Solutions. This includes the delivery of executive level software demonstrations, construction of future state customer journey strategies, and developing long term IT roadmaps."Solutioning" is fundamental to the SE role. It is important to realize that a component of the responsibilities will include assisting the customer, Account Executive and Professional Services team with the discovery, analysis and ultimately the recommendation of strategic solutions for the customer by delivering transformational pitches based in live product demonstrations to validate. These Solutions will use all of the Salesforce technologies to address the core challenges and objectives that are uniquely identified for each customer.Discover the customer's business needs, and position the best Salesforce solution to achieve those business objectivesBuild and present customized solutions and demonstrations focused on Salesforce products to multiple customer personas showing how Salesforce will accelerate their business strategies and a path to value.Convey a deep understanding of the customer's architecture as it pertains to Salesforce's solutionsOrchestrate and lead cross-functional solutions guides, and align them to the opportunity strategyDevelop and deliver the story of the customer experience aided by Salesforce technologiesParticipate in all appropriate product, sales, and procedural training and certifications to acquire and maintain the knowledge vital to be effective in the positionAbility to travel based on territory alignment and region.

Required Qualifications:

Must have experience within Manufacturing, specifically Automotive, Utilities, or Energy.

  • B.S., M.S. or PhD in Computer Science, Software Engineering or MIS
  • Knowledge of related applications, relational database and web technology
  • Solid oral, written, presentation, collaboration and interpersonal communication skills
  • Ability to work as part of a team to solve technical problems in varied political environments
  • Minimum of 4 years of professional experience

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Salesforce Certifications
  • Previous experience as a solution/sales engineer for a CRM company or similar technology

Unleash Your Potential

When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance andbe your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you cando your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

Accommodations

If you need a reasonable accommodation during the application or the recruiting process, please submit a request via this Accommodations Request Form.

Please note that Salesforce uses artificial intelligence (AI) tools to help our recruiters assess and evaluate candidates’ resumes and qualifications throughout the recruiting process. Humans will always make any candidate selection and hiring decisions. Please see our Candidate Privacy Statement for more information about how we use your personal data and your rights, including with regard to use of AI tools and opt out options.

Posting Statement

Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination. Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal. Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. raw.description:
About Abridge

Abridge was founded in 2018 with the mission of powering deeper understanding in healthcare. Our AI-powered platform was purpose-built for medical conversations, improving clinical documentation efficiencies while enabling clinicians to focus on what matters most—their patients.

Our enterprise-grade technology transforms patient-clinician conversations into structured clinical notes in real-time, with deep EMR integrations. Powered by Linked Evidence and our purpose-built, auditable AI, we are the only company that maps AI-generated summaries to ground truth, helping providers quickly trust and verify the output. As pioneers in generative AI for healthcare, we are setting the industry standards for the responsible deployment of AI across health systems.

We are a growing team of practicing MDs, AI scientists, PhDs, creatives, technologists, and engineers working together to empower people and make care make more sense. We have offices located in the Mission District in San Francisco, the SoHo neighborhood of New York, and East Liberty in Pittsburgh.

The Role

Abridge is looking for a People Operations Generalist to join our People team and keep our core People Ops work running smoothly: onboarding, benefits, workers’ comp, compliance, and HR support tickets. You’ll work closely with the Head of People Operations and the rest of the People team to keep things running smoothly and build processes that keep up as we scale.

This role suits someone who is proactive, moves fast, and brings solutions instead of questions. They’re resilient when priorities shift, comfortable with ambiguity, and have a bias for action. They enjoy owning the details, switching between tasks easily, and want to help scale People Ops at a fast-growing startup.

What You’ll Do

HR Support & Systems

  • Triage and respond to employee questions in our HR ticketing system quickly and accurately, and escalate when needed.

  • Use Rippling day to day to manage employee data and pull reports. Spot data issues and fix them before they cause problems.

  • Find recurring ticket themes and turn them into self-serve resources or process fixes.

Onboarding & Employee Lifecycle

  • Own new hire onboarding from offer to first day, including paperwork, Rippling setup, and coordination with IT on devices and access.

  • Make sure every new hire has a smooth, well-organized experience, and keep improving the experience as hiring accelerates.

Benefits & Workers’ Comp

  • Administer employee benefits, including enrollments, qualifying life events, open enrollment, and renewals, and be the first point of contact for employee benefits questions.

  • Manage workers’ compensation claims from start to finish.

Compliance

  • Manage compliance programs, including audits, harassment prevention training, and other regulatory mandates.

  • Lead compliance reporting requirements such as EEO-1 and state-specific filings, making sure submissions are on time and accurate.

  • Maintain internal documentation (policies, calendars, audit trails) and build scalable processes that can flex with our team’s growth.

  • Support audits and respond to regulatory inquiries with thorough, organized documentation and clear processes.

Cross-Functional Partnership

  • Work with Payroll, Legal, Finance, and IT to give employees a seamless experience.

  • Jump in wherever there’s an operational gap, and help bring clarity and structure as we grow.

What You’ll Bring

  • 3–5 years of experience in People Operations, HR Generalist, or HR Coordinator roles.

  • Hands-on experience with an HRIS. Rippling is strongly preferred.

  • Experience administering benefits and managing workers’ comp claims.

  • Working knowledge of federal and multi-state compliance requirements, including reporting such as EEO-1 and required training mandates.

  • The ability to prioritize on your own in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift.

  • A proactive, solutions-first mindset. You notice gaps and fix them without waiting to be asked.

  • High attention to detail and strong organizational skills.

  • Excellent written and verbal communication. You can explain HR and compliance topics in a way employees understand.

This role is a hybrid position (Mondays, Wednesdays, and Fridays) based in San Francisco.

Why Work at Abridge?

At Abridge, we’re transforming healthcare delivery experiences with generative AI, enabling clinicians and patients to connect in deeper, more meaningful ways. Our mission is clear: to power deeper understanding in healthcare. We’re driving real, lasting change, with millions of medical conversations processed each month.

Joining Abridge means stepping into a fast-paced, high-growth startup where your contributions truly make a difference. Our culture requires extreme ownership—every employee has the ability to (and is expected to) make an impact on our customers and our business.

Beyond individual impact, you will have the opportunity to work alongside a team of curious, high-achieving people in a supportive environment where success is shared, growth is constant, and feedback fuels progress. At Abridge, it’s not just what we do—it’s how we do it. Every decision is rooted in empathy, always prioritizing the needs of clinicians and patients.

We’re committed to supporting your growth, both professionally and personally. Whether it's flexible work hours, an inclusive culture, or ongoing learning opportunities, we are here to help you thrive and do the best work of your life.

If you are ready to make a meaningful impact alongside passionate people who care deeply about what they do, Abridge is the place for you.

How we take care of Abridgers:

  • Generous Time Off: 14 paid holidays, flexible PTO for salaried employees, and accrued time off for hourly employees

  • Comprehensive Health Plans: Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage for all full-time employees and their families.

  • Generous HSA Contribution: If you choose a High Deductible Health Plan, Abridge makes monthly contributions to your HSA.

  • Paid Parental Leave: Generous paid parental leave for all full-time employees.

  • Family Forming Benefits: Resources and financial support to help you build your family.

  • 401(k) Matching: Contribution matching to help invest in your future.

  • Personal Device Allowance: Tax free funds for personal device usage.

  • Pre-tax Benefits: Access to Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) and Commuter Benefits.

  • Lifestyle Wallet: Monthly contributions for fitness, professional development, coworking, and more.

  • Mental Health Support: Dedicated access to therapy and coaching to help you reach your goals.

  • Sabbatical Leave: Paid Sabbatical Leave after 5 years of employment.

  • Compensation and Equity: Competitive compensation and equity grants for full time employees.

  • ... and much more!

Equal Opportunity Employer

Abridge is an equal opportunity employer and considers all qualified applicants equally without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, or disability.

We're committed to providing reasonable accommodations throughout the interview process. Once you submit your application, we'll follow up with details on how to request an accommodation for interviewing, completing any assessments, or otherwise participating in the selection process.

Staying safe - Protect yourself from recruitment fraud

We are aware of individuals and entities fraudulently representing themselves as Abridge recruiters and/or hiring managers. Abridge will never ask for financial information or payment, or for personal information such as bank account number or social security number during the job application or interview process. Any emails from the Abridge recruiting team will come from an @abridge.com email address. You can learn more about how to protect yourself from these types of fraud by referring to this article. Please exercise caution and cease communications if something feels suspicious about your interactions.

DriiveMe is Europe’s leading platform for vehicle deliveries. Every month, more than 20,000 paid assignments are offered to our community of self-employed drivers across the United Kingdom.

Major automotive companies trust DriiveMe to move their vehicles, including Stellantis, Ayvens, Tesla, Volkswagen, Hertz, Europcar, and many more.

What does a DriiveMe assignment involve?

It is simple: as a self-employed driver, you drive a vehicle from a collection point to a delivery point. Here is how it works:

  1. You create your account ondriiveme.com.

  2. You access the available assignments in your area.

  3. You review the route, payment and conditions for each assignment.

  4. You book the assignments you want to complete in just a few clicks.

  5. On the day of the assignment, you go to the collection point, collect the vehicle and deliver it to the destination.

How much will I earn?

Your turnover depends on the number of assignments you choose to complete.

Each assignment has its own payment, based on the route, the number of miles and the complexity of the transport.

Before booking an assignment, you know all the essential information: collection point, delivery point, payment and conditions. You are free to book only the assignments that suit you.

raw.description:
Opportunity at a Glance

The Forensic Psychology PhD program. Adjunct faculty members' primary responsibility will be to chair and/or serve as second members on doctoral dissertation committees as methodologists and/or content experts. Infrequently, and based on student enrollment, Adjunct Faculty may be invited to instruct content courses or research methodology courses for which they are credentialed to teach. Participation in Mentor Training will be provided and required.

Adjunct faculty members serve in a part-time capacity to educate Walden University students by effectively and proficiently using online technology and resources so that knowledge, information, feedback, and critique are imparted to and shared with students in thoughtful, carefully formulated, well-written, and timely communications. This is accomplished in an environment that is respectful of the student, the Faculty Member, Walden University, and the discipline in which the Faculty Member is involved. Faculty Members are expected to adhere to all Walden University Faculty expectations, which are clearly set forth to the Faculty Member at the start of their employment with the University.

Responsibilities

  • Dissertation Committee Service (Primary Responsibility): Chair and/or serve as a second committee member on doctoral dissertations, providing methodological and/or content expertise to forensic psychology doctoral candidates.
  • Training: All new Faculty Members receive specific training from Walden University in teaching techniques, use of the electronic learning platform, policies and procedures of the School or College in which they will teach, socialization into Walden University culture, assessment of academic integrity of student work (including use of www.turnitin.com), and research supervision of theses and dissertations.
  • Course Teaching (Secondary Responsibility): When assigned a course, Faculty Members teach using the Canvas platform and are responsible for interacting with students within it. Discussion boards are open 24/7; postings may be made at any time but must be completed in a timely manner per the Faculty Handbook. Responses to student questions must be posted within 48 hours. Faculty Members are required to verify the accuracy of student postings and submissions and to provide feedback and grades through Canvas.
  • Availability: Faculty are expected to be reasonably accessible to students, including outside the course discussion board, and to provide substantive feedback on assignments and postings. Faculty publish their availability through course syllabi, instructor information in the classroom, and/or other appropriate documents. Regular and predictable availability, such as online office hours or chats, is suggested.
  • Residencies: Faculty Members may be required to attend residencies held domestically or internationally to teach intensives and colloquia and facilitate school- and university-wide discussions. (Part-time faculty may, but are not required to, attend.)
  • Performs other duties as assigned
  • Complies with all Walden University policies and standards
  • Ph.D. in Forensic Psychology or a related field from an accredited institution required
  • Forensic experience at the doctoral level preferred
  • One year of experience serving on doctoral committees preferred (experience chairing a committee preferred)
  • Evidence of continuing scholarly or creative work within the past 5 years; proficient in APA 7th edition
  • Strong research methodology background in quantitative, qualitative, and/or mixed methods (preference given to quantitative)
  • Excellent leadership, communication, teamwork, and human relations skills
  • At least 1,000 hours of direct forensic psychology experience over five years, or completion of a 2,000-hour formal postdoctoral fellowship in forensic psychology

Technology Requirements

  • Adjunct faculty provide their own laptops and are expected to use the Walden University Learning Management System and Microsoft 365 tools with their assigned Walden email addresses in all Walden activities. Walden University provides a Walden email account and access to the learning platform, password-protected faculty sections of the website, university and college cloud services, and other faculty communication tools.
  • Faculty Members must be able to use Microsoft Office products (Word, Excel, PowerPoint), zip software, and Adobe Acrobat, and must have reliable internet access as well as alternate access in case primary access becomes unavailable.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

Additional information

In support of the pay transparency laws enacted across the country, the expected compensation rate for this position is as follows:

  • Graduate Course Instruction: $1,560 - $4,080 per Quarter or Semester, depending on type of course taught and length of course
  • Undergraduate Course Instruction: $700 - $2,200 per quarter, depending on type of course taught and length of course

    Actual pay may be adjusted based on job-related factors permitted by law, such as type of course taught; experience and training; geographic location; licensure and certifications; market factors; departmental budgets; and responsibility. Walden also offers other opportunities for its contributing faculty members, such as dissertation/doctoral study committee chair positions, research reviewing, and dissertation and doctoral study mentoring.

    Our Talent Acquisition Team will be happy to answer any questions you may have, and we look forward to learning more about your salary requirements.

Equal Opportunity – Minority / Female / Disability / V / Gender Identity / Sexual Orientation

Walden

Walden University is a member of Covista Global Education (NYSE: ATGE). More than 50 years ago, Walden University was founded to support adult learners in achieving their academic goals and making a greater impact in their professions and communities. Students from across the U.S. and more than 115 countries are pursuing a certificate, bachelor’s, master’s, or doctoral degree online at Walden. The university offers more than 100 online degree and certificate programs. Walden University is accredited by The Higher Learning Commission, hlcommission.org. For more information, please visit WaldenU.edu and WaldenFacts.com.

Parachute Health is transforming post-acute care as the leading digital ordering platform for medical equipment and supplies. We connect major health systems, health plans, and suppliers to help patients get the life-saving products they need at home. Since launching, we've connected 300,000+ clinicians and 3,000+ supplier locations across all 50 states and helped 15M+ patients. What started as a DME ePrescribing tool has become the order management platform of choice for home medical equipment.

Join our team and make a difference in patient care.

About the Role

As a Senior Product Manager for Provider Experience on our Clinical Strategy team, you will be responsible for enabling providers to elevate the patient experience while giving them more time to focus on care. You will work with your product team, stakeholders, and customers to build our product across a large, nationwide network of clinicians. Your impact will not only be seen in the lives of the patients who receive timely and adequate care but also in the way our healthcare system operates by increasing digital connectivity across the system.

Responsibilities

Product Strategy and Research

  • Work with current and potential partners to aid in customer research, business development, feedback collection, and product planning for your roadmap
  • Define product release slices for Clinician experience that optimize for time to value
  • Measure and analyze the product success/fail metrics in your product area and align them to our overall business goals

Product Development Delivery

  • Align your balanced product team on a clear strategy and prioritize work in progress to maximize user outcomes, customer satisfaction and business growth
  • Build artifacts that help unify the organization (roadmaps, product briefs, etc.)
  • Supports your team through the product build and launch process
  • Manage milestones and deliverables to maximize time to value
  • Help define and measure success metrics
  • Define methods for customer feedback loops
  • Partner with Engineering and Design teams
Adoption and Go-to-Market
  • Drive adoption and engagement across health systems and clinician practices. Partner with Customer Success, Implementation and Marketing to find friction in onboarding and ordering, and use what you learn from usage data to make Parachute the default way clinicians order HME
  • Collaborate with marketing and operations to bring products to market

Team and Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Work with customers and external stakeholders to develop solutions
  • Collaborate with marketing and operations teams to develop and get products to market
  • Coordinate across the organization, customers, and partners to articulate and execute product decisions

Who You Are

  • Communication & Collaboration: An excellent communicator, presenting ideas clearly and succinctly, and highly collaborative, working with diverse stakeholders to create alignment around product vision and prioritization.
  • Results-Oriented & Analytical: You can look at problems and create solutions from high-level goals that drive real business impact to ground-level execution. You are analytical, using data to clarify decisions wherever possible.
  • Strategic & User-Focused: Great at prioritizing in a complex healthcare landscape. You are user-focused, empathetic, curious, and ask questions before offering solutions. You build the right thing, with a bias towards delivering customer value based on goals and metrics.

  • Ambiguity & Risk Management: You have past successes driving software products forward, ideally at a startup. You cut through ambiguity, comfortable taking calculated risks and making decisions under uncertainty.

Nice to Have

  • Bachelor’s Degree in a technical, scientific, or quantitative field, or equivalent experience
  • A background in healthcare, and knowledge of healthcare complexity
  • Experience with EHR integrations or healthcare data standards (HL7, FHIR)
  • Experience in a fast-paced startup environment

  • You're not a solo act. Our PMs lead by influence. They thrive in a team-based environment and believe in making decisions with broad input.

About us

At GotPhoto, we are freeing photographers to be more successful.

Through our platforms GotPhoto.com and , we help professional photographers simplify and transform the way they work — from photo management and client communication to ordering and payment processing. Our end-to-end workflow and e-commerce solution gives photographers more time to focus on what matters most: being behind the lens.

Since 2012, we’ve built a sustainable and profitable business driven by entrepreneurial spirit, innovation, and a deep understanding of photographers’ everyday challenges. Today, thousands of photographers trust our software , creating their own success stories along the way.

As the leading e-commerce engine for professional volume photographers and a business backed by EQT, one of the world’s leading private equity firms, we’re powered by a team of 150+ talented and international people building technology that simplifies photographers’ everyday work and helps them focus on capturing meaningful moments.

Join us on our journey to empower photographers like never before.

AI Automation Specialist - Marketing & Web (all genders)

Do you enjoy turning repetitive tasks into seamless AI automations? Are you driven by finding hidden opportunities data couldn't unlock before? Do you want to build AI use cases for a Marketing team that has already started its AI journey?

At GotPhoto you join a company that is advanced in its AI journey. You work with peers across Product, Tech, Design and Data who speak your language. You build automations that your colleagues use every day, and you grow with the scope as it expands.

Your Journey at GotPhoto

Phase 1: High-Impact Projects & Workflow Foundation (First Months)

In your initial phase, you will combine strategic project ownership with AI workflow automation. You will gather a long list of potential use cases with the team, prioritize them using clear impact metrics, and dive straight into two key anchor projects:

  • Discovery & Mapping: Work closely with the marketing team to map out further potential AI use cases across content, acquisition, operations, and campaign analytics.

  • Evaluation & Prioritization: Apply a structured evaluation matrix (measuring efficiency gain, effort, and business impact) to pick high-value quick wins.

  • Build, Automate & Measure: Build structured workflows, clean up tool knowledge bases, measure performance, and document processes for seamless handover and adoption by colleagues.

  • Anchor Project 1: Website Rebuild & Full Ownership: Take direct ownership of the GotPhoto website. You will lead the rebuild project from a marketing perspective, leveraging modern AI tools for copy generation, structure planning, SEO/GEO optimization, and content deployment.

  • Anchor Project 2: AI-Driven Design Workflows: Automate and streamline our visual asset creation. You will implement generative AI design workflows (e.g., using tools for visual asset generation, localization, scaling banner creation, or brand asset management) to elevate our creative output and reduce manual designer effort.

Phase 2: Growth & Scaling (Your Path Forward)

As you establish our AI design pipelines, maintain the rebuilt website, and master our marketing stack, your role will expand along a dedicated growth trajectory:

  • Strategic AI Ownership: Shift from initial workflow setups to owning end-to-end AI initiatives across complex multi-channel marketing campaigns.

  • Advanced Architecture & Custom Automation: Lead the optimization of centralized team knowledge bases, custom GPTs, and sophisticated multi-agent or API-based automations (e.g., using Make, n8n, or custom scripts).

  • Enablement & Community: Become the core AI ambassador within marketing, driving up team-wide AI literacy, establishing prompt engineering standards, and collaborating with cross-functional AI peers across GotPhoto.

  • Website Optimization & Web Operations: Evolve from web manager to growth operator, using AI-driven A/B testing, dynamic personalization, and automated conversion rate optimization (CRO).

Experience

  • Hands-on experience building AI automations in a professional setting, typically 1 to 2 years.

  • Proof that you ship: you can show us at least one automation you built end-to-end, describe the impact and explain how it handles errors.

  • Experience running a website is a plus: publishing and updating content in a CMS

  • Experience in SEO/GEO or CRO optimization is a plus

  • Experience in a high-growth environment where you built with limited documentation is a plus.

Skills

  • Strong working expertise with Claude, including building use cases beyond prompting.

  • Workflow automation with n8n or a comparable tool such as Make or Zapier.

  • API integration: REST, webhooks and authentication.

  • Accuracy and safety: you build checks, logging and review steps into every automation.

  • Working knowledge of MCP, GitHub and basic JavaScript or Python is a plus.

Mindset

  • The Owner: you take full accountability for your projects, from the first workflow to the final output.

  • The Experimentalist: you enjoy figuring things out when there is no manual.

  • The Quality Advocate: you prefer a robust, lasting solution over a quick one-off hack.

Languages

  • English spoken and written. German is a plus.

Why You’ll Love Life at GotPhoto

  • Best of Both Worlds: We live and breathe a flexible hybrid model. Our beautiful office at Hausvogteiplatz is our vibrant Berlin hub for collaboration, but you have the freedom to leverage the setup that works best for you.

  • Work from (Almost) Anywhere: We believe in flexibility that respects your lifestyle. Once you have completed your probation, you have the option to work remotely from within Europe for up to 40 days per year. Whether you are visiting family or simply seeking a change of scenery, we support a work-from-anywhere culture that helps you stay inspired.

About Surefire Cyber

Surefire Cyber is redefining the incident response model by delivering a swifter, stronger response to cyber incidents such as ransomware, email compromise, malware, data theft, and other threats. Our client-centric approach reduces stress and provides clients the confidence needed to prepare, respond, and recover from cyber incidents – and fortify their cyber resilience after an event.

Surefire Cyber’s approach and delivery are designed by industry veterans who have worked shoulder-to ­shoulder with law firms, insurance carriers, brokers, law enforcement, and impacted organizations in responding to cyber incidents. We are marshaling this experience to address the industry’s persistent challenges of efficiency, predictability, and transparency.

Job Title: Principal Engagement Lead-Digital Forensic and Incident Response (DFIR)

Location: Remote, USA

Role: Full time / Exempt

What Makes You Stand Out

You are a seasoned cybersecurity professional with a strong background in digital forensics and incident response (DFIR), and incident management. You thrive in a dynamic and client-focused consulting environment, where you can tackle complex cybersecurity challenges. You are skilled at mitigating risks and making well-informed decisions, even in high-pressure scenarios.

You have a demonstrated ability to manage multiple cybersecurity incidents effectively. Your experience includes coordinating incident response efforts, working with cross-functional teams, and external stakeholders including insurance carriers and legal counsel. You strive to consistently deliver quality based client results and ensure a timely resolution while minimizing downtime.

How You'll Make An Impact

As a Principal Engagement Lead, you will be responsible for leading multiple active cybersecurity engagements, interacting with clients, cyber insurers, and legal counsel. Your expertise will guide scoping calls, and you will collaborate closely with other Engagement Leads and Forensic Consultants on our team to ensure high quality service and resolution on active client matters.

Your Role In Action

  • Lead and oversee active client-facing incident response engagements, working closely with other team members to guide clients through the entire incident response lifecycle from detection to recovery.
  • Conduct scoping calls with clients to define the incident scope, objectives, and expectations of each engagement.
  • Work closely with other Engagement Leads and Forensic Consultants to ensure effective coordination of resources and expertise on client matters.
  • Build and cultivate strong client relationships based on trust, open communication, and collaborative problem-solving.
  • Provide well-informed solutions that go beyond immediate client challenges to achieve long-term security goals.
  • Communicate advanced cybersecurity concepts both internally and externally and produce clear and concise verbal and written reports detailing incident findings, and analysis.
  • Actively knowledge share with team members cultivating a culture of continuous learning, and stay up to date on industry trends, emerging threats, and best practices.
  • Provide after-hours (on-call/weekend rotational) support as required to address critical incidents and maintain continuous coverage.

Your Expertise

  • Experience in Cybersecurity, Computer Science, Information Technology, related degree, or relevant professional work experience in these disciplines.
  • Former professional experience in leading and managing active cybersecurity engagements, including incident response, digital forensics investigations, and interaction with clients, legal counsel, and cyber insurers.
  • Experience in conducting security investigations in Linux and Windows environments.
  • Understanding of cloud platforms and security considerations within AWS, Azure, and GCP.
  • Knowledge of digital forensic artifacts and tools such as ELK, Axiom, Encase, FTK, Volatility, or Open-Source tools.
  • Proficiency in conducting forensic analysis, threat assessments, and post incident reviews.
  • Eagerness to learn from team, grow your knowledge, and teach your colleagues.
  • Ability to provide after-hours (on-call/weekend rotational) support as required to address critical incidents and maintain continuous coverage.

Expertise in all these areas is not required, but you should be excited by the opportunity to learn new things and comfortable with working with other team members to expand your knowledge base and experience. We at Surefire Cyber invite you to apply even if you do not feel you have mastery in all the requirements listed on the job description and welcome a further discussion.

Interview Process

  • Submit interest and application to on our website
  • Preliminary phone interview with the the Talent & People Team (approx., 30 minutes)
  • Virtual/Teams interview with Engagement Leads (approx., 60 minutes)
  • Virtual/Teams interview with DFIR Consultants (approx., 60 minutes)
  • Virtual/Teams interview with Chief Delivery Officer (approx., 45 minutes)
  • Mock Scenario Interview (approx., 60 minutes)
  • Virtual/Teams interview with CEO (Chief Executive Officer) (approx., 30 minutes)

Please note that we reserve the right to modify the process at any time.

Benefits for Full-Time Surefire Cyber Team Members

  • Competitive compensation plan and equity for all team members
  • Remote workforce
  • Generous paid time off plan and floating holidays
  • Employer paid premiums for both team members and their dependents for medical, dental, and vision
  • Comprehensive health, vision, dental, 401K matching program, disability, Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA), Health Savings Account (HSA), Life and AD&D benefits.
  • Paid parental leave
  • Professional development and career advancement opportunities
  • We prioritize employee growth and development through a robust performance management platform to provide ongoing coaching, clear feedback, recognition, and opportunities for career growth

Surefire Cyber is an Equal Opportunity Employer that does not discriminate on the basis of actual or perceived race, color, creed, religion, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, age, sex, or gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, and pregnancy-related conditions), gender identity or expression (including transgender status), sexual orientation, marital status, military service and veteran status, physical or mental disability, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state or local laws and ordinances.

Job Description:

Are you passionate about transforming data into meaningful insights and helping development teams deliver innovative products? CSI is seeking a Technical Product Owner - Data Products - to serve as the execution bridge between product strategy and engineering delivery.

In this role: you will partner closely with Product Managers, engineers, designers, and stakeholders to translate business needs into well-defined requirements and successful product releases. You'll work on data-focused applications that provide analytics, visualization, customer segmentation, and marketing capabilities for financial institutions through modern data warehouse technologies and embedded business intelligence solutions. This is an ideal opportunity for someone who enjoys a blend of product ownership, business analysis, SQL, APIs, data validation, and Agile delivery.

What You'll Do

  • Partner with Product Managers and stakeholders to define business requirements, use cases, and acceptance criteria.
  • Translate product initiatives into well-defined epics, user stories, and technical requirements.
  • Own and maintain a prioritized product backlog.
  • Lead backlog refinement sessions and support sprint planning activities.
  • Collaborate with engineering teams throughout the software development lifecycle.
  • Develop a strong understanding of application architecture, data sources, APIs, and integrations.
  • Write SQL queries to validate data, investigate issues, and support acceptance testing.
  • Perform user acceptance testing of features, integrations, and APIs.
  • Monitor data quality and validate consistency between backend systems and user-facing applications.
  • Partner with UX/UI and Design teams to improve user experience and product workflows.
  • Create detailed acceptance criteria for functional, API, and data-related development work.
  • Support release readiness activities, documentation, release notes, and user guides.
  • Leverage approved AI tools such as Copilot, Claude, Jira Rovo, or similar technologies to improve productivity, documentation, requirements gathering, and testing efficiency.
  • Mentor colleagues and contribute to a culture of continuous learning and collaboration.

What We're Looking For

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in a technical, analytical, or related field preferred.
  • 6+ years of experience as a Product Owner, Technical Product Owner, Business Analyst, or similar role within a software development environment.
  • Strong experience managing Agile backlogs, sprint planning, and refinement sessions.
  • Demonstrated experience writing detailed user stories, acceptance criteria, and technical requirements.
  • Strong API experience, including documenting requirements and validating integrations.
  • Advanced SQL experience, including data validation, troubleshooting, and exploratory analysis.
  • Experience working with data-focused products, analytics platforms, reporting tools, or business intelligence applications.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts for business stakeholders and business requirements for engineering teams.
  • Experience using Jira, Confluence, or similar Agile project management tools.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in fintech, banking, financial services, or other regulated industries.
  • Experience with embedded analytics or business intelligence tools such as Domo, Power BI, Tableau, or similar platforms.
  • Experience with Snowflake or modern cloud data platforms.
  • Experience working with relational databases such as Oracle or MySQL.
  • Familiarity with Figma and UX/UI collaboration processes.
  • Product Owner, Agile, Scrum, or Business Analysis certifications.

What Makes Someone Successful in This Role

  • Ability to bridge the gap between business goals and technical execution.
  • Comfortable discussing APIs, integrations, data flows, and application architecture with engineering teams.
  • Strong data mindset and curiosity around how information is sourced, transformed, validated, and presented.
  • Ability to independently validate requirements through SQL queries and testing.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to delivering high-quality product outcomes.
  • Experience using AI-powered productivity tools to improve requirements gathering, documentation, testing, and delivery processes.

As a forward-thinking software provider, Computer Services, Inc. (CSI) helps community and regional financial institutions solve their customers’ needs through open and flexible technologies. In addition to its award-winning core banking platform, these include the latest in lending, digital banking, payments, financial crime prevention and cybersecurity. Building on its 60-year track record of personalized service, CSI is shaping the future of banking and empowering its customers to rival their competition. For more information about CSI, visit

Rejoignez la meilleure compagnie d'évaluation de produits en tant que Chef du Marketing! C'est votre opportunité d'avoir un réel impact sur la façon dont des millions de personnes découvrent RTINGS.com et interagissent avec notre marque. Votre expertise contribuera à façonner notre croissance, à renforcer notre relation avec nos utilisateurs et à accroître notre présence à l'échelle mondiale.

RTINGS.com bénéficie déjà d'une solide réputation, compte des millions d'utilisateurs et offre un produit auquel les gens font confiance. L'objectif n'est donc pas de bâtir une marque à partir de zéro, mais plutôt de faire évoluer ce que nous avons déjà construit et de l'amener à sa prochaine étape de croissance.

Votre mandat principal

Vous évaluerez la façon dont RTINGS.com se positionne aujourd’hui et déterminerez ce qui doit évoluer au niveau de notre marque, de notre positionnement, de nos messages, de nos relations publiques, de nos médias sociaux, de notre SEO, de nos infolettres et de nos autres canaux organiques.

Vous dirigerez ensuite cette transformation avec pour objectif de faire de RTINGS.com une marque beaucoup plus reconnue à l’échelle mondiale et de créer des relations plus fortes et plus directes avec nos utilisateurs.

Aperçu de ce que nous offrons:

  • Rémunération compétitive, basée selon l’expérience et l’expertise du candidat
  • Horaire flexible 
  • Prestations d’assurance collective payées
  • Cotisation REER de l’employeur
  • Contribution au remboursement de la condition physique
  • Contribution au remboursement de transports
  • Programme de référence des employés
  • Culture de plaisir et de convivialité
  • Lorsque vous travaillez au bureau, les boissons sont gratuites!

Responsabilités

  • Diriger la stratégie de marque et de développement de l'audience de RTINGS.com afin d'accroître sa notoriété, sa crédibilité et la demande directe à l'échelle mondiale pour notre laboratoire de tests indépendant
  • Relève directement du président
  • Être responsable de la marque, des relations publiques, des communications, des médias sociaux organiques, du SEO, des infolettres et de la croissance de l'audience organique
  • Gérer, encadrer et développer un équipe de marketing performante
  • Définir la vision à long terme du département de Marketing, y compris les capacités, les canaux, la structure et les initiatives nécessaires pour permettre à RTINGS.com de poursuivre sa croissance au-delà de son modèle actuel
  • Définir et suivre des indicateurs de performance (KPI) clairs liés à la notoriété de la marque, à sa réputation et à la croissance de l'audience (p.ex.: volume de recherches de marque, trafic direct, part de voix, sentiment envers la marque et contribution des nouveaux membres en début de parcours)
  • Collaborer étroitement avec l'équipe de Croissance, qui est responsable de l'acquisition payante, de la conversion, du marketing relationnel (lifecycle) et de la fidélisation, afin de s'assurer que les équipes de Marketing et Croissance contribuent aux mêmes objectifs d'affaires
  • Travailler en étroite collaboration avec les équipes de Produit, Revenus, Opérations et les autres départements afin d'offrir une expérience utilisateur fluide à forte valeur ajoutée

Personnalité

  • Vous aimez faire des recherches, analyser et comparer des produits. Vous passez généralement des semaines à faire vos recherches avant d'acheter un produit
  • Vous êtes curieux et aimez apprendre
  • Vous aimez être impliqué concrètement (hands on), mettre en place des processus et analyses des données
  • Vous êtes motivé, orienté vers les résultats et faites preuve d'un excellent sens de l'organisation
  • Vous aimez aider les gens

Qualifications/Expérience

  • 8 ans ou plus d'expérience en marketing B2C, notamment en image de marque, relations publiques et communications, médias sociaux, SEO ou gestion de l'audience organique
  • Expérience démontrée dans l'accompagnement d'une marque grand public déjà établie vers sa prochaine phase de croissance
  • Expérience en gestion d'équipes et en direction d'initiatives transversales impliquant plusieurs équipes
  • Excellente maîtrise des indicateurs et outils d'analyse permettant de mesurer la performance de la marque et de l'audience (suivi de la marque, part de voix, analyses organiques et des médias sociaux)
  • Une expérience dans un domaine de produits numériques, d'applications ou de modèles par abonnement constitue un atout important

Ce poste vous intéresse?  

N’hésitez plus, postulez et venez rejoindre notre équipe formidable!  

Avis de non-responsabilité :
Pour les candidats québécois : Il est important de noter que la maîtrise de l'anglais est requise en raison de la portée internationale de notre entreprise, et de la nécessité d’interagir avec des utilisateurs, des fournisseurs, des clients, etc., en dehors du Québec. Nous vous remercions de votre compréhension.

RTINGS est un employeur offrant l’égalité des chances et s’engage à créer un environnement de travail diversifié et l’inclusion au travail.

Focal Systems is the industry leader in retail AI solutions. We are headquartered in San Francisco, California with operations in Canada and the UK, and a tech-hub in Poland. We are a Deep Learning first company. Our mission is to automate and optimize brick and mortar retail using deep learning computer vision. Focal Systems has been deployed at scale with some of the top retailers in the world.

We seek smart, creative and passionate people who want to help build a great and enduring company and deploy Deep Learning to the world!

About the Role

As Director of Analytics, you will own the full path from raw data to decision: the data warehouse, the transformation layer, and the BI tooling analysts and the business actually touch. You will set the technical direction for the analytics stack, lead a small team of analysts and analytics engineers, and be the person executive stakeholders come to for a straight answer backed by solid numbers.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will manage the team, but you are also expected to review models, dig into the warehouse yourself, and make the tooling calls, not just delegate them.

What We Are Looking For

  • You are a rigorous thinker who treats data as evidence, not decoration, and holds your team to that same standard
  • You have strong technical chops in SQL and the modern data stack (warehouse, transformation layer, BI layer), and you can go deep on any of them
  • You have led or grown a team of analysts or analytics engineers, and you know how to hire, mentor, and set a bar
  • You are comfortable owning ambiguous, open-ended problems, from "what should we even be measuring" through to a shipped dashboard
  • You communicate findings crisply to technical and non-technical audiences, including at the executive level
  • You have opinions on BI tooling grounded in experience, not just familiarity, and can make a real build-vs-buy or migrate-vs-stay case

What You Will Be Doing

  • Own the analytics architecture end to end, from the Snowflake warehouse and dbt transformation layer through to the BI/reporting layer used across the business
  • Set and evolve BI tooling strategy, including evaluating whether our current tool, Sigma, remains the right fit versus alternatives like Looker, Tableau, Power BI, Hex, or Mode as the team and data volume grow
  • Lead, hire, and develop a team ofanalysts and analytics engineers
  • Partner with Product, Customer Success, and Engineering to define key metrics, build self-serve reporting, and translate business questions into well-scoped analytical work

About BFG Tax Academy

BFG Tax Academy is a professional training initiative established by Business Financial Group (BFG), a U.S.-based accounting and tax services firm. The Academy focuses on providing practical, career-oriented training in U.S. taxation, tax preparation, professional communication, and tax software applications.

We are seeking a qualifiedLegal Consultantbased in Kerala for a short-term, project-based engagement to review and finalize the Academy's student agreements and related onboarding legal documents.

Key Responsibilities

  • Review the existing Student Enrollment Agreement and related student onboarding legal documents drafted by BFG Tax Academy.

  • Identify potential legal risks, ambiguities, inconsistencies, and provisions requiring clarification or revision.

  • Evaluate the documents for compliance with applicable Indian laws, including relevant contract law, consumer protection, and data privacy requirements.

  • Review provisions relating to student enrollment, course fees, payment terms, cancellations, refunds, student responsibilities, and dispute resolution.

  • Assess disclaimers concerning employment opportunities, internships, placements, certifications, and career outcomes.

  • Recommend necessary modifications to ensure the documents are legally appropriate, clear, and enforceable.

  • Coordinate with BFG management to discuss recommendations and incorporate agreed changes.

Required Qualifications & Experience

  • LL.B. degree from a recognized university.

  • Enrollment with a State Bar Council in India, preferably the Bar Council of Kerala.

  • Previous experience in legal document review, contract drafting, and agreement finalization.

  • Strong understanding of Indian contract law and relevant consumer protection regulations.

  • Experience reviewing student agreements, educational institution contracts, or professional training service agreements will be an added advantage.

  • Excellent legal drafting, analytical, and communication skills.

  • Ability to work independently and complete assignments within agreed timelines.

  • Must be based in Kerala.

Project Scope & Deliverables

The engagement will focus specifically on the legal review and finalization of BFG Tax Academy's student onboarding documentation.

Expected deliverables include:

  1. A comprehensive review of the existing student agreement and related legal documents.

  2. Identification of legal risks and provisions requiring modification.

  3. A marked-up document containing recommended revisions.

  4. Written suggestions to improve legal clarity and compliance.

  5. A revised version incorporating agreed modifications.

  6. Final legally reviewed documents ready for management approval and implementation.

Work Arrangement & Availability

  • This is a remote, short-term, project-based engagement.

  • The selected candidate must be available for discussions, meetings, and coordination with BFG management during the company's regular working hours (1:30 PM to 10:30 PM IST), as required throughout the project.

How to Apply

Interested candidates are invited to share their updated CV along with details of their relevant legal experience, current location in Kerala, availability, and expected professional fee.

Join BFG Tax Academy in ensuring our student enrollment documentation meets appropriate legal and professional standards.

Aufgaben

  • Erstellung von Finanzbuchhaltungen für Unternehmen unterschiedlicher Größenklassen (optional Lohnbuchhaltung)
  • Vorbereitung und Erstellung von Jahresabschlüssen
  • Erstellung von betrieblichen und privaten Steuererklärungen
  • Korrespondenz mit Mandanten, Behörden und Ämtern

Am Ende sollte es für beide Seiten passen. Deshalb wäre es gut, wenn du dich in den nachfolgenden Punkten wiederfindest.

  • Sorgfältige, effiziente und gewissenhafte Arbeitsweise
  • Offen für eine digitale Arbeitsweise

  • Attraktive Kanzleien – die Kanzleien in unserem breit gefächerten Kanzleinetzwerk sind selektiv ausgewählt und heben sich klar von “normalen” Kanzleien ab (z.B. hinsichtlich der Vergütung, Benefits, Hierarchien, Digitalisierungsgrad, Ausstattung etc.)

About Converge

Converge fuses cyber insurance and technology to provide businesses with clear, confident cyber protection. Deploying a proprietary data ecosystem underpinned by expert underwriting, it provides risk solutions that deliver high value strategies with improved outcomes. Our team is composed of top-tier professionals across underwriting, technology, and claims who share a passion for driving the future of cyber risk management.

Position Overview

The Customer Success / Carrier Relationship Manager will own strategic carrier-partner relationships to ensure successful onboarding, engagement, platform adoption, and operational execution. This role will serve as the primary point of contact between Converge and carrier stakeholders including underwriting, actuarial, claims, engineering, and distribution teams, ensuring seamless communication, coordination, and issue resolution.

This individual will play a critical role in supporting partner integration, training, and expansion initiatives, and will help drive platform growth across current and future carrier relationships as Converge scales globally.

Key Responsibilities

Carrier & Partner Relationship Ownership

  • Serve as the primary relationship manager for our current and future carrier-partners, acting as a trusted advisor and strategic liaison.
  • Understand carrier-partner needs, challenges, and integration requirements, ensuring alignment across product, underwriting, engineering, and operations.
  • Ensure carrier-partner satisfaction and promote long-term engagement and expansion opportunities.

Onboarding & Platform Adoption

  • Coordinate onboarding of carrier-partner teams across underwriting, actuarial, distribution, and operational functions.
  • Lead training on Converge platform capabilities and workflow processes.
  • Create and maintain enablement materials, training documentation, and carrier-partner resources.

Cross-Functional Coordination

  • Partner with underwriting, engineering, actuarial, distribution, support, and compliance to address needs, prioritize issues, and support feature development.
  • Coordinate platform releases, enhancements, and support escalations.
  • Facilitate communication and integration activity with external broker and technology partners.

Project & Execution Support

  • Manage meeting schedules, workstream alignment, and milestone tracking for carrier-partner onboarding and expansion, and keep requests aligned with agreed commitments.
  • Support data, reporting, and analytics needs for carrier performance, program metrics, and capacity planning.
  • Assist in discussions and readiness for new product launches and international expansion.

Strategic Impact & Growth

  • Provide feedback to product and engineering teams on platform improvements and market needs.
  • Support long-term capacity relationship strategy and operational readiness.

Global & Australian Market Knowledge

This role supports carrier-partner relationships outside the U.S., market knowledge is a core requirement.

Required

  • Australian insurance market experience, preferably in commercial and specialty lines.
  • Working knowledge of Australian broker distribution, licensing, and the regulatory environment.

Preferred

  • Australian cyber insurance experience (underwriting, product, broking, claims, or program management).
  • Digital distribution experience

Working Hours & Location

  • Remote role. U.S. West Coast (Pacific Time) working hours preferred.
  • Occasional Australian business-hours availability is required for client meetings.

Qualifications & Experience

Required

  • 5+ years experience in insurance (preferably cyber, specialty, or commercial P&C).
  • Experience working with underwriting, distribution, broker relations, or carrier program operations.
  • Demonstrated success in relationship-driven, customer-facing roles.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, problem-solving, and organizational skills.
  • Ability to operate in a highly dynamic, fast-moving environment with competing priorities.
  • Strong business judgment, professionalism, and executive-level presence.

Preferred

  • Experience in customer success, program management, or carrier relationship management.
  • Exposure to InsurTech, digital underwriting, technology platforms, or automation workflows.
  • Background in cyber underwriting or digital production underwriting.
  • Ability to interface across technical and non-technical audiences.

About the Role

Daybreak Health delivers teletherapy to young people and families through schools, funded by health plans. As our Senior Director of Revenue Cycle Management, you will own the revenue cycle end to end, from enrollment through cash, for a payer mix that is narrow but operationally demanding: Medicaid and managed care organizations (MCOs), outpatient behavioral health, telehealth, and clinicians licensed across multiple states.

This is a build role, not a maintain role. You will inherit real gaps and be expected to close them with process and automation rather than headcount. You will report to our President and Co-Founder and lead the RCM team, which today includes an RCM Manager, a Lead Billing Specialist, and Billing Specialists. You will also partner closely with Finance, Clinical Operations, Product and Engineering, and Credentialing. You will present directly to executives and have clear line of sight into the cash you move.

We will not scale RCM by adding billing headcount in step with claim volume. We are looking for a leader who treats that as a design constraint and gets energized by it.

What You'll Own

  • AR and denials. Read an aging report, know where the money is stuck, and fix the root cause, not just the claim. You will build the habit of tracing denials and slow-pay patterns back to the workflow, payer rule, or system gap that created them.
  • Metrics and reporting. Run the function off numbers: net collection rate, days in AR, clean claim rate, denial rate, and cost to collect. Give leadership a view of collections they can trust, with definitions that hold up and reporting that does not depend on heroics.
  • Systems. Own the EHR, clearinghouse, and billing platform relationships and configuration. Find process gaps and build solutions, including working with Engineering when the fix lives in the product.
  • Front-end revenue integrity. Own real-time eligibility and benefits verification at intake, patient responsibility, and estimates. Most denials are created before the session happens. You will influence workflows you don't directly manage, particularly with Clinical Operations, and drive upstream behavior change.
  • Automation and AI leverage. Default to eliminating repetitive work. You will identify where automation and AI can take over manual billing, posting, follow-up, and reconciliation work, and put them into production with the right controls.
  • Cash forecasting. Be a credible partner to Finance at close, accruals, reserves, and AR allowance. Finance should never have to chase RCM for a number or wonder how it was built.
  • Compliance. Adolescent behavioral health billing carries real confidentiality risk in EOBs, statements, and minor-consent handling, on top of HIPAA and payer audit exposure. You will build the operating discipline that keeps us compliant as we scale.

What Success Looks Like

  • Leadership, Finance, and the executive team trust the NCR numbers, know what is driving them, and see them improve!
  • AR is understood by payer, age bucket, and root cause, and aged balances are moving in the right direction.
  • Denial and clean claim rates improve because upstream workflows (eligibility, authorization, intake, documentation) are fixed at the source.
  • Manual billing work keeps getting simpler or automated, and RCM capacity scales more slowly than claim volume.
  • Finance gets forecasts, accruals, and reserve inputs on time, with clear assumptions and honest variance explanations.
  • Clinical Operations and RCM work from shared definitions and a shared view of how clinical workflows affect revenue.
  • Confidentiality, minor-consent, and audit-readiness practices are documented, trained, and followed.

What We're Looking For

  • 10+ years in RCM, including 5+ years leading RCM teams.
  • Experience in one or two startups. You have built from square one and stayed flexible as the business changed.
  • Deep outpatient behavioral health and Medicaid/MCO billing expertise.
  • Practical, hands-on use of AI and automation to improve how work gets done, and good judgment about where human review still matters.
  • A track record of standing up reporting, automating manual work, and leading system migrations.
  • Comfort owning numbers publicly and being wrong out loud when the forecast misses.
  • Strong executive communication. You can turn a complicated billing finding into a clear recommendation, with the tradeoffs spelled out.
  • Ability to influence stakeholders and drive change without direct authority, especially across Clinical Operations, Product, and Engineering.

Nice to have:

  • Experience with school-based, pediatric, or youth behavioral health programs.
  • Experience billing across multiple states with a multi-state licensed clinician workforce.
  • Familiarity with BI tools.
  • Exposure to value-based or outcomes-linked payer contracts.

Compensation and Benefits

The target base salary range for this role is $175,000, plus equity and benefits. Actual compensation will depend on experience, location, and internal equity considerations. Placement within the range reflects depth of behavioral health and Medicaid experience, startup build experience, and team size owned.

  • Generous equity package
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage, with Daybreak covering a significant share of premiums for employees and dependents
  • Flexible unlimited time off, company holidays, and quarterly mental health days
  • Fully remote work from anywhere in the United States

You'll own the customer-facing side of product development: understanding what healthcare providers actually need, shaping how Clara behaves for each customer, and shipping the changes that make Clara work in the real world.

This is not a support role and not a pure engineering role. You'll talk to customers daily, write code when needed, and have direct influence over what we build next.

What You'll Do

  • Support customer relationships post-sale. Act as a technical point of contact for live accounts alongside our sales lead and CS team. Help troubleshoot issues and make sure Clara is delivering value.

  • Translate stakeholder needs into product. Work with sales, clinical operations, and engineering to understand what customers and internal teams need. Identify which requests are one-off configuration vs. real product gaps. Bring that signal back to engineering.

  • Ship customer-specific changes. Clara's architecture is designed for per-customer customization through strategy files. You'll write and modify these strategies, tune prompts, adjust call flows, and ship small features end-to-end.

  • Drive product improvement. You'll have broad exposure across customers and internal teams. We expect you to form strong opinions about what to build next and advocate for them.

  • Support implementation. Help onboard new customers, EHR integration discovery, use case scoping, call flow design, go-live coordination.

  • Improve how we operate. Build internal tooling, write runbooks, identify recurring issues, and make the team more effective over time.

What We're Looking For

Required:

  • 5+ years in a role that combined engineering with cross-functional or customer-facing work (FDE, solutions engineer, implementation engineer, technical CSM, product engineer, or similar)

  • Comfortable writing and reading TypeScript/Node.js. You don't need to be a senior IC, but you should be able to ship a feature, debug a bug, and review a PR

  • Strong written and verbal communication. You'll work with clinical operations leaders, compliance teams, sales, and engineers, sometimes in the same week

  • Track record of identifying product gaps from stakeholder conversations and driving them to resolution

  • Self-directed. You'll often work across teams with minimal oversight

Preferred:

  • Healthcare experience - you've worked with clinical, operational, or compliance teams at a healthcare company. Comfortable with HIPAA, EHR workflows, and conversations with clinical operations leaders.

  • Experience integrating with different EHRs

  • Familiarity with AWS, GraphQL, React etc

  • Experience at an early-stage startup (Series A or earlier)

Compensation & Logistics

  • Competitive base salary + meaningful equity

  • Fully remote within the US

  • Health, dental, vision

Why Work at SMA America

Power the future. Build your career at SMA America.

As the U.S. subsidiary of SMA Solar Technology AG, we have been at the forefront of solar inverter technology since 1981, developing solutions that make photovoltaic power plants simpler, more reliable, safer, and more cost effective. Headquartered in Rocklin, California, SMA America has spent more than two decades helping homes, businesses, and utilities across the country generate clean, reliable power. We are the only inverter manufacturer in the world offering solutions for every system size, from residential rooftops to large scale utility plants, backed by more than 1,500 patents and a presence in over 190 countries.

Innovation is only part of the story. We invest in our people, create room to grow, challenge conventional thinking, and protect a culture where teammates genuinely care about each other and the work. We hire capable people and give them the space to do the job, with clear expectations, open door leadership, and real autonomy.

If you are passionate about driving positive change and want a career where you can take ownership of your work, we would love to meet you. Together, we are not just part of the energy transition, we are helping drive it forward.

Territory Sales Manager, Solar and Storage, Southwest (Remote)

LOCATION AND WORK MODEL

This position is remote and field based, covering Southern California, Arizona, New Mexico, and Hawaii. Candidates must currently reside in the Phoenix, Arizona; Los Angeles, California; or San Diego, California metropolitan area. The role requires frequent travel across the territory, including periodic travel to Hawaii, and occasional travel elsewhere in the United States and internationally.

PURPOSE OF THE POSITION

The Territory Sales Manager grows SMA’s market share across an assigned territory by building strong partnerships with our Authorized Distributors and the solar and storage installers they serve. The role covers residential and commercial PV and energy storage products, and owns the strategy, relationships, and results for the territory.

PRIMARY DUTIES / RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Build and maintain relationships with all Authorized Distributors within the assigned territory.
  • Identify market opportunities across the territory and develop strategies to grow SMA’s share in those markets.
  • Prospect for and target solar and energy storage installers alongside our distributor partners.
  • Increase SMA sales by building relationships with key installers, highlighting the value of SMA products, and growing SMA’s share of their portfolio through our distributor partners.
  • Execute brand and messaging strategies that position SMA as a leader in the renewable energy industry.
  • Develop strategic alliances with key partners through our authorized channel partners.
  • Make outreach calls to current and potential customers and set appointments to discuss PV and energy storage technologies.
  • Represent SMA at residential and commercial PV and storage conferences, distributor trade shows, and NEC code events to encourage adoption of SMA products and technologies.
  • Meet with distributor partners and installers to promote the benefits of SMA technology and convert customers from competing products.
  • Serve as an SMA advocate and provide outstanding customer support.
  • Other duties as may be required or assigned.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • At least 2 years of experience in a sales or account manager role.
  • Current residence in the Phoenix, Los Angeles, or San Diego metropolitan area.
  • Strong organizational and communication skills.
  • Excellent presentation skills.
  • Proficiency in English, both written and verbal.
  • Attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
  • Ability to influence people directly and indirectly.
  • Ability to analyze and solve problems effectively.
  • Ability to work well independently.
  • A valid driver’s license and an acceptable driving record.
  • Ability to travel frequently across the territory, including periodic travel to Hawaii.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • A bachelor’s degree in a technical field, with an emphasis in electrical or mechanical engineering.
  • Two (2) to three (3) years of experience in renewable energy technologies or a related industry.
  • Experience working within a distribution channel.
  • Project management experience.
  • Knowledge of strategic selling principles and key account management.
  • Knowledge of strategic and quantitative analysis.
  • Excellent negotiation skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Word, PowerPoint, and Excel.
  • Experience working in a matrix organization.
  • German or Spanish language skills.

WE OFFER

  • Base salary: $90,000 to $110,000 per year, dependent on experience and qualifications.
  • Target bonus of approximately one third of base salary, with additional earning potential for overachievement, for target total cash of $120,000 to $146,667 per year.
  • Car allowance: $7,200 per year.
  • Comprehensive benefits including health, dental, and vision coverage, including $0 premium options.
  • 401(k) plan with company match.
  • Work Model: Remote and field based within the Southwest territory.

WORK AUTHORIZATION

Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States on a full time basis. SMA America does not offer employment visa sponsorship of any kind.

AI-GENERATED APPLICATION MATERIALS

We review all resumes and application materials for AI generated content. Submissions that show evidence of AI manipulation, including AI written resumes, cover letters, or responses, will be disqualified from consideration without further review. We want to hear your authentic voice and see your genuine experience.

RECRUITMENT FRAUD NOTICE

All SMA America openings are posted on our official careers page and all recruiter communication comes from an @sma-america.com address. We never request payment, banking information, or a Social Security number during the recruitment process. If you are contacted about an SMA America role from a personal email account, or asked for any of the above, please forward the message to .

Any qualified applicant with a disability who believes he or she requires an accommodation in order to perform the essential functions of the job for which he or she is applying should identify the accommodation(s) needed in the application.

Our Privacy Policy
