raw.description:
Acxiom is seeking a Senior Vice President of Cloud Transformation & Architecture to lead a multi-year modernization of its on-premises technology estate. This executive will own both the multi-cloud target-state architecture and the execution of the transformation, working with Acxiom’s engineering and architecture leadership and its technology and service partners.

This is an enterprise transformation role for an executive who sets direction with the senior leadership team while staying close enough to the architecture and delivery work to resolve difficult decisions. The successful candidate will have led large, multi-year data center and cloud transformations in complex global enterprises, protecting service continuity while building a secure, financially disciplined cloud operation.

Reporting and scope

The SVP reports to the Chief Cloud & Data Modernization Officer and leads a dedicated team spanning architecture, engineering, operations, migration delivery, and program management. Scope includes Acxiom’s data centers, infrastructure, enterprise and client-facing applications, data and analytics workloads, vendor relationships, and the teams and processes required to run a multi-cloud estate.

Key responsibilities:

Set the transformation strategy

  • Establish the target state and a sequenced, multi-year plan for data center modernization, workload migration, application modernization, and facility exit.
  • Build the business case with senior leadership and drive fast, evidence-based workload disposition decisions (retire, rehost, replatform, refactor, replace).
  • Define workload placement principles across AWS, Azure, and GCP that align with Acxiom’s product, data, AI, client, and privacy requirements.

Lead execution

  • Own the integrated roadmap, funding, governance, and executive reporting, holding internal teams and partners accountable for business outcomes.
  • Sequence migration waves by dependencies, data gravity, business criticality, readiness, and risk, with measurable targets.
  • Protect service quality and client commitments, ensuring every wave includes tested rollback, disaster recovery, observability, and operational readiness.

Build the multi-cloud foundation

  • Build a secure foundation across AWS, Azure, and GCP spanning identity, networking, policy, encryption, observability, resilience, and automated provisioning.
  • Partner with Acxiom’s Product Automation team to drive infrastructure as code, policy as code, CI/CD, container platforms, and platform engineering practices.
  • Set standards for cloud-native architecture that modernize without forcing unnecessary rewrites, accounting for performance, data residency, portability, provider concentration, and total cost of ownership.

Modernize data and AI platforms

  • Partner with data, product, analytics, and AI leaders to move data analytics platforms and machine learning workloads to appropriate cloud architectures.
  • Establish governance for data movement, lineage, quality, access, privacy, and model operations, creating a foundation for production AI without weakening security, reliability, or cost controls.

Protect Acxiom and its clients

  • Build security, privacy, resilience, and regulatory compliance into architecture and delivery from the start, working with security, legal, privacy, and risk leaders to translate obligations into enforceable controls.
  • Protect sensitive consumer and client data throughout migration and give clients and auditors clear evidence of control effectiveness.

Measures of success

  • Delivery against migration waves, financial commitments, and data center exit or consolidation milestones.
  • Reduction in legacy infrastructure, technical debt, and stranded contracts, with legacy assets verifiably decommissioned.
  • Cloud cost and unit-cost performance against the approved business case.
  • Improved availability, security, and audit readiness, with stable client service throughout migration.
  • Stronger internal cloud, platform, data, and reliability engineering capability.

Required qualifications

  • Significant executive leadership experience in enterprise infrastructure, cloud, data platforms, or technology transformation.
  • Direct accountability for at least one large, multi-year data center modernization or exit, leading across business units, vendors, and geographies.
  • Executive-level knowledge of AWS, Azure, and GCP and modern platform engineering (containers, infrastructure as code, CI/CD, observability).
  • Experience modernizing enterprise data architecture, including batch and real-time processing, analytics platforms, and AI/ML infrastructure.
  • Strong command of cloud economics, transformation business cases, vendor negotiations, budgets, and FinOps.
  • Experience with cloud security, privacy, resilience, compliance, and audit in an environment that manages sensitive data.
  • Record of building senior teams, leading through organizational resistance, and communicating clearly with the board, executives, clients, and engineers.

Preferred qualifications

  • Transformation leadership at large global consumer, retail, marketing, data services, or similarly complex enterprises with high-volume data processing and material privacy obligations.
  • Experience structuring partnerships with all three major cloud providers and managing systems integrators without transferring accountability to them.
  • Prior experience in the marketing agency business or an understanding of its products, clients, operating environment, and culture.

Location

Remote; candidates residing in the US Central or Eastern time zones preferred.

About Xanadu:Xanadu’s mission is to build quantum computers that are useful and available to people everywhere.

At Xanadu, we are learners, innovators, researchers, collaborators, and problem solvers. We are creating something that has never been built before. What we are doing is extremely hard, the classic moon shot. Few people in their life will be able to be a part of something like this, where if we are successful, the technologies we develop will solve some of the world’s most challenging problems, and literally change the world. That is something to be excited about!

Your role and responsibilities:As a quantum scientist, you will join a technical team of scientists dedicated to unlocking the real-world impact of fault-tolerant quantum computers. You will contribute to discovering cutting-edge quantum algorithms, rigorously optimizing their performance, and identifying valuable applications across a variety of industries. Whether your primary strength is pioneering algorithms or uncovering novel applications, this role thrives at the intersection of both. At Xanadu, this research is conducted alongside industry, government, and academic partners, requiring close collaboration with software, hardware, and business development teams across the company.

In more detail, you will focus deeply on:
  • Designing and pioneering innovative quantum algorithms tailored for fault-tolerant quantum computers for applications related to computational chemistry.
  • Radically improving algorithm efficiency by reducing qubit counts, gate complexity, and overall resource requirements
  • Identifying high-value applications targeted at our chemistry-related focus industries.
  • Demonstrating the feasibility and scalability of new algorithms and applications through rigorous resource estimation and comparison to state-of-the-art classical methods.
  • Collaborating with PennyLane software developers to create state-of-the-art tools for quantum algorithms research.
Regardless of your specific focus areas, you will consistently:
  • Author high-quality scientific papers, technical reports, and comprehensive documentation.
  • Generate valuable intellectual property and actively support the filing of related patents.
  • Present your research findings to strategic partners and at premier conferences and events.

Basic qualifications and experience:
  • PhD in Chemistry, Physics, or a related quantitative discipline — or equivalent practical experience.
  • Strong track record of research accomplishments in computational chemistry and quantum computing, evidenced by publications, patents, or technical work.
  • Deep knowledge of quantum chemistry methods for ground and excited states, such as DFT, CASSCF/CASCI, MRCI, DMRG, Coupled Cluster, QMC, etc.
  • Knowledge of fundamental concepts in quantum algorithms, such as Hamiltonian simulation, Trotter product formulas, quantum signal processing, linear combination of unitaries, amplitude amplification, quantum phase estimation, and quantum read-only memories.
  • Expertise in application areas related to quantum chemistry, materials science, pharmaceuticals, etc.
  • Capacity to thrive in an interdisciplinary team environment and drive independent research when required.
  • Excellent communication skills, with a proven ability to convey complex technical ideas to specialist and non-specialist audiences.
  • Strong self-management skills to balance individual project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables in a fast-paced environment.

Preferred qualifications and experience:
  • Experience performing constant-factor resource estimation for fault-tolerant quantum algorithms.
  • Experience in using and/or developing quantum chemistry software including but not limited to PySCF, Gaussian, Q-Chem, ORCA, Psi4, NWChem, MOLCAS, GAMESS, etc.
  • Experience collaborating with industry or government partners.
  • Strong software development and scientific programming skills in Python and HPC expertise.

raw.description:
About Us

Zoo is building the next generation of hardware design tools redefining how hardware products are designed, developed, and built. Our platform combines a modern, cloud-native CAD environment with AI-powered engineering workflows, helping teams design, iterate, and manufacture products faster than ever before. We are headquartered in Los Angeles, CA with both a local and remote team. We were founded and incubated by Embedded Ventures in 2021.

About You

We’re looking for curious, innovative, and ambitious self-starters to join our growing team to help us bring our mission to life. We think you’ll thrive on our team if you’re:

  • Curious at your core, with an eagerness to learn and do things differently
  • Customer-focused, always thinking about ways to improve the user experience
  • Able to operate autonomously and work asynchronously, while also being an effective team player

About The Role

As a Senior Frontend Engineer at Zoo, you'll play a crucial role in the development and enhancement of our novel open-source CAD modeling app, Zoo Design Studio. This unique, DSL-driven application leverages traditional CAD UI for code generation/editing while streaming a 3D scene from our remote graphics engine. This is a "back of the front-end" role, where your efforts will be instrumental in creating and gluing features together from our UI that drives DSL code-mods, triggering executions with our Rust/Wasm DSL, or interfacing with our backend's WebSocket API and doing so in an extensible way. We're looking for a seasoned Engineer with substantial experience building highly performant, scalable web applications with a deep understanding of performance optimization techniques. This is an awesome opportunity to significantly impact one of our core products during this critical phase of growth for our team.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop and optimize the frontend of our modeling app, focusing on performance and user experience
  • Collaborate with backend teams to design and implement robust APIs that support the app's code-driven design functionality
  • Enhance the app's UI/UX by leveraging Typescript, React, and XState, ensuring that the interface is both powerful and easy to use
  • Develop delightful CodeMirror extensions that bridge the gap between the user's code and the 3d-model
  • Implement advanced AST/code-mods, CodeMirror enhancements, and deep integration with WebAssembly (Wasm) for performance improvements
  • Utilize Xstate for state management to maintain app consistency and reliability across various user interactions
  • Apply a deep understanding of JavaScript and browser internals to improve app functionality and performance

What You’ll Need

  • B.S. in Computer Science or a related field, or equivalent professional experience
  • Substantial experience in frontend software development building complex, highly performant and scalable applications
  • Strong proficiency in Typescript and React, with a portfolio or examples of complex applications built using these technologies
  • Deep knowledge of JavaScript and its internal workings and performance optimization techniques
  • Familiarity with WebAssembly (Wasm) and its use in web applications for performance enhancements
  • Understanding of browser internals across major browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Chromium, Brave, etc.) and their impact on application performance and compatibility
  • Knowledge of Xstate or similar state management libraries

Nice to Have

  • Proficiency with Rust
  • Experience with CodeMirror6
  • Experience with ASTs even if custom ESLint rules
  • Experience with WebGL or web graphics
  • A background in geometry and/or experience with design-based software

The salary range for this role is provided below. The final offer will depend on multiple factors including candidate experience, skills, expertise, and market data. Compensation may vary by geography.

In addition to salary, we offer competitive equity as well as a full benefits package which may vary by geography as well.

Salary Range
$145,000—$195,000 USD

Zoo is an equal-opportunity employer committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. The Zoo team is made up of incredibly talented and unique individuals from across the globe. All qualified applicants will receive equal consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, Veteran status, age, or any other trait that unfairly targets a group of people. We encourage everyone interested in our mission to apply!

raw.description:
Director, Content Accessibility

College Board – Learning & Assessment

Location: This is a remote role. Candidates who live near CB offices have the option of being fully remote or hybrid (Tuesday and Wednesday in office). All CB employees are required to occasionally travel to meet in person for business purposes.

Role Type: This is a full-time position

About the Team

The Content Accessibility team at College Board has the privilege and responsibility of ensuring that College Board assessments are accessible for individuals with disabilities. Our work is both specialized and broad: we work with Subject Matter Experts (SMEs) to write and review image descriptions, consult with technology teams to improve accessibility supports in authoring tools, and collaborate with accessibility and accommodations specialists across the organization to ensure test content meets policy and the needs of test-takers. We not only advocate for universal design, we live it.

About the Opportunity

As a Director, Content Accessibility, you coach a team of writers and reviewers who bridge the gap between students who use assistive technology to take College Board assessments and the makers of College Board assessments. By bridging that gap, your team ensures every test question meets accessibility guidelines.

Your attitude is can-do: you write and review image descriptions and evaluate caption tracks, you construct reader scripts and braille maps, you apply headings when the content requires them. Moreover, you take on the team’s most complex and high-stakes work yourself. You do the work because leading by example helps the team excel. Ultimately, in Content Accessibility, everything you do is focused on one goal: ensuring College Board assessments are accessible so that all students, no matter their ability, can show what they know and can do. You can say with confidence that the work of your team is a primary reason College Board is an industry leader in accessible testing.

In this role, you will:

Lead and develop a team (30%)

  • Lead a team of four specialists responsible for the accessibility of assessment content across all College Board assessments.
  • Own day-to-day direction for the team. Assign and balance workloads, set priorities across competing program deadlines, and adjust plans as schedules shift, in partnership with the Senior Director and program leads.
  • Track and manage progress to goals, and provide coaching and support to ensure team members meet and exceed goals, remain engaged, and contribute meaningfully to our mission.
  • Cultivate an inclusive and high achieving culture that enables all team members to live out College Board’s Operating Principles.
  • Embody College Board’s Manager Expectations in your work.
  • Participate in hiring, onboarding, and training, and help shape team roles and structure as needs evolve.
  • Conduct regular check-ins and reviews and coach team members through feedback, professional development plans, and stretch assignments.

Be an expert practitioner (40%)

  • Write accessible test content (including image descriptions, reader scripts, and braille transcription notes), maintaining the highest standards of quality and care, for College Board assessments. Personally adopt the hardest cases for yourself.
  • Review and remediate test content to conform to Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG), ensuring all tests meet Section 504 and Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) requirements. Adapt strategically when content and standards don’t easily align.
  • Act as the team's authority on accessible-content standards, making final calls on edge cases when guidance is unclear or absent.
  • Review and remediate test-adjacent content (e.g., research studies, scoring guidelines) to conform to WCAG, ensuring all publications meet Section 504 and ADA requirements.
  • Set priorities for and maintain image description guidelines, authoring standards and practices (e.g., for mode transformations), documentation, presentations, and tools (e.g., user personas).
  • Lead quality-control, accessibility, and usability reviews of tests and applications, identifying patterns and root causes rather than one-off errors.
  • Maintain advanced proficiency in authoring tools and assistive technology, and advise the team on best practices.

Shape strategy, standards, and cross-functional practice (30%)

  • Contribute to Content Accessibility strategy and long-term planning as part of the team's leadership group, and lead execution of initiatives within your team's scope.
  • Synthesize accessibility research, web standards, and user-experience findings into clear evidence-based recommendations to improve tooling, processes, and authoring standards. Present and advocate for those recommendations to program and organization leadership.
  • Represent Content Accessibility, including the team’s aims, standards, constraints, and risk considerations, in planning conversations with program, product, and technology teams. Ensure accessibility is built into all processes, tools, and assessments.
  • Educate and mentor others about universal design, accessibility, and accommodations, such as through presentations and trainings.
  • Drive pilots of new tools, workflows, and technologies (including AI) that improve the quality, efficiency, or accessibility of test content.
  • Lead cross-team projects or serve on them as the accessibility subject matter expert.

About You

To qualify for this role, you must have:

  • 6+ years of experience in accessibility or accommodations-focused roles, technical writing, or assessment content writing, with at least 4 years specifically in accessibility or accommodations-related work (e.g., accessibility specialist, inclusive designer, Section 508 compliance analyst)
  • Experience leading people or work, such as supervising, mentoring, training, or leading projects.
  • Excellent written communication skills, with demonstrated experience writing or editing (e.g., technical writer or editor).
  • A strategic and inclusive leadership style: you set clear priorities, build effective team structures, plan for future needs, and foster a culture of belonging.
  • A proven ability to drive performance and growth: you set high expectations, deliver real-time, evidence-based feedback, and coach team members to take smart risks, stretch their skills, and achieve meaningful impact.
  • Excellent verbal communication skills, including facilitating meetings and presenting remotely and in-person to leaders and cross-functional audiences.
  • Demonstrated success handling complex, ambiguous, or high-stakes work with sound judgment and autonomy.
  • Adept problem-solving skills, including using data to inform decisions and actions.
  • Proven ability to build relationships and influence others to action.
  • Experience creating or maintaining accessibility standards or guidelines.
  • Fluency in web-content accessibility (WCAG, ARIA) and/or universal design.
  • Strong organization and prioritization skills and the proven ability to move forward multiple projects in concert, both independently and as a member of the team
  • Outstanding curiosity about emerging trends and best practices in web standards and accessibility
  • Certified Professional in Accessibility Core Competencies (CPACC) certification or Web Accessibility Specialist (WAS) certification preferred
  • Bachelor’s degree required
  • The ability to travel 1–3 times a year to College Board offices or on behalf of College Board business

All roles at College Board require:

  • A passion for expanding educational and career opportunities and mission-driven work
  • Curiosity and enthusiasm for emerging technologies, with a willingness to experiment with and adopt new AI-driven solutions and comfort with learning and applying new digital tools independently and proactively.
  • Clear and concise communication skills, written and verbal
  • A learner's mindset and a commitment to growth: welcoming diverse perspectives, giving and receiving timely, respectful feedback, and continuously improving through iterative learning and user input.
  • A drive for impact and excellence: solving complex problems, making data-informed decisions, prioritizing what matters most, and continuously improving through learning, user input, and external benchmarking.
  • A collaborative and empathetic approach: working across differences, fostering trust, and contributing to a culture of shared success
  • Authorization to work in the United States

About Our Process

  • Application review will begin immediately and will continue until the position is filled. This role is expected to accept applications for a minimum of 5 business days.
  • While the hiring process may vary, it generally includes: resume and application submission, recruiter phone/video screen, hiring manager interview, performance exercise, a panel interview, a conversation with leadership and reference checks.

What We Offer

At College Board, we offer more than a paycheck: we provide a meaningful career, a supportive team, and a comprehensive package designed to help you thrive. We’re a self-sustaining nonprofit that believes in fair and competitive compensation grounded in your qualifications, experience, impact, and the market.

A Thoughtful Approach to Compensation

  • The hiring range for this role is $80,000 –$135,000.
  • Your exact salary will depend on your location, experience, and how your background compares to others in similar roles at the College Board.
  • We aim to make our best offer upfront, rooted in fairness, transparency, and market data.
  • We adjust salaries by location to ensure fairness, no matter where you live.

You’ll have open, transparent conversations about compensation, benefits, and what it’s like to work at College Board throughout your hiring process. Check out our careers page for more.

Why Work at SMA America

Power the future. Build your career at SMA America.

As the U.S. subsidiary of SMA Solar Technology AG, we have been at the forefront of solar inverter technology since 1981, developing solutions that make photovoltaic power plants simpler, more reliable, safer, and more cost effective. Headquartered in Rocklin, California, SMA America has spent more than two decades helping homes, businesses, and utilities across the country generate clean, reliable power. We are the only inverter manufacturer in the world offering solutions for every system size, from residential rooftops to large scale utility plants, backed by more than 1,500 patents and a presence in over 190 countries.

Innovation is only part of the story. We invest in our people, create room to grow, challenge conventional thinking, and protect a culture where teammates genuinely care about each other and the work. We hire capable people and give them the space to do the job, with clear expectations, open door leadership, and real autonomy.

If you are passionate about driving positive change and want a career where you can take ownership of your work, we would love to meet you. Together, we are not just part of the energy transition, we are helping drive it forward.

Territory Sales Manager, Solar and Storage, Midwest (Remote)

LOCATION AND WORK MODEL

This position is remote and field based, covering the Region 2 Midwest territory and Canada. Candidates must currently reside within the Region 2 territory, with the Chicago, Illinois metropolitan area preferred. The role requires frequent travel across the territory, including Canada, and periodic travel elsewhere in the United States and internationally.

PURPOSE OF THE POSITION

The Territory Sales Manager grows SMA’s market share across an assigned territory by building strong partnerships with our Authorized Distributors and the solar and storage installers they serve. The role covers residential and commercial PV and energy storage products, and owns the strategy, relationships, and results for the territory.

PRIMARY DUTIES / RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Build and maintain relationships with all Authorized Distributors within the assigned territory.
  • Identify market opportunities across the territory and develop strategies to grow SMA’s share in those markets.
  • Prospect for and target solar and energy storage installers alongside our distributor partners.
  • Increase SMA sales by building relationships with key installers, highlighting the value of SMA products, and growing SMA’s share of their portfolio through our distributor partners.
  • Execute brand and messaging strategies that position SMA as a leader in the renewable energy industry.
  • Develop strategic alliances with key partners through our authorized channel partners.
  • Make outreach calls to current and potential customers and set appointments to discuss PV and energy storage technologies.
  • Represent SMA at residential and commercial PV and storage conferences, distributor trade shows, and NEC code events to encourage adoption of SMA products and technologies.
  • Meet with distributor partners and installers to promote the benefits of SMA technology and convert customers from competing products.
  • Serve as an SMA advocate and provide outstanding customer support.
  • Other duties as may be required or assigned.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • At least 2 years of experience in a sales or account manager role.
  • Current residence within the Region 2 territory.
  • Strong organizational and communication skills.
  • Excellent presentation skills.
  • Proficiency in English, both written and verbal.
  • Attention to detail and a high level of accuracy.
  • Ability to influence people directly and indirectly.
  • Ability to analyze and solve problems effectively.
  • Ability to work well independently.
  • A valid driver’s license and an acceptable driving record.
  • Ability to travel frequently across the territory, including to Canada, with periodic international travel.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • A bachelor’s degree in a technical field, with an emphasis in electrical or mechanical engineering.
  • Two (2) to three (3) years of experience in renewable energy technologies or a related industry.
  • Experience working within a distribution channel.
  • Project management experience.
  • Knowledge of strategic selling principles and key account management.
  • Knowledge of strategic and quantitative analysis.
  • Excellent negotiation skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office, including Word, PowerPoint, and Excel.
  • Experience working in a matrix organization.
  • German or Spanish language skills.

WE OFFER

  • Base salary: $90,000 to $110,000 per year, dependent on experience and qualifications.
  • Target bonus of approximately one third of base salary, with additional earning potential for overachievement, for target total cash of $120,000 to $146,667 per year.
  • Car allowance: $7,200 per year.
  • Comprehensive benefits including health, dental, and vision coverage, including $0 premium options.
  • 401(k) plan with company match.
  • Work Model: Remote and field based within the Region 2 territory.

WORK AUTHORIZATION

Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States on a full time basis. SMA America does not offer employment visa sponsorship of any kind.

AI-GENERATED APPLICATION MATERIALS

We review all resumes and application materials for AI generated content. Submissions that show evidence of AI manipulation, including AI written resumes, cover letters, or responses, will be disqualified from consideration without further review. We want to hear your authentic voice and see your genuine experience.

RECRUITMENT FRAUD NOTICE

All SMA America openings are posted on our official careers page and all recruiter communication comes from an @sma-america.com address. We never request payment, banking information, or a Social Security number during the recruitment process. If you are contacted about an SMA America role from a personal email account, or asked for any of the above, please forward the message to .

Our EEO Policy

We are an equal opportunity employer and we make our employment decisions on the basis of merit and without regard to one's race, color, creed, sex (includes gender, pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions), gender identity, religion, marital status, age (over 40), national origin or ancestry, physical or mental disability (includes HIV/Aids), medical condition (cancer, genetic characteristics), veteran's status, sexual orientation, or any other consideration made unlawful by law.

In accordance with applicable law protecting qualified individuals with known disabilities, SMA will attempt to reasonably accommodate qualified applicants with known disabilities, unless doing so would create an undue hardship on SMA. Any qualified applicant with a disability who believes he or she requires an accommodation in order to perform the essential functions of the job for which he or she is applying should identify the accommodation(s) needed in the application.

Our Privacy Policy

During your job application or recruitment process with us: (a) SMA may collect your personal information directly from you, such as when you submit your application and resume on our online portal or when you have job interviews with us. We may also obtain your personal information from third parties, including but not limited to your former employers, background or employment check service providers or third-party recruiters; and, (b) SMA may use or process applicants' personal information for relevant purposes including but not limited to general communications with you, identity verification, background or employment checks, determination of eligibility, and making hiring decisions. For successful job applicants who become SMA's staff, we may retain and integrate your personal information collected during the recruitment process into your records at SMA.

If you are a California resident, you have specific rights regarding your personal information under the California Consumer Privacy Act of 2018, as amended including by the California Privacy Rights Act of 2020, and its implementing regulations (the "CCPA"). This Company Personnel and Covered Individuals Privacy Notice for California Residents issued by SMA is applicable to you and explains your CCPA rights and our collection, use or disclosure of your personal information.

About the Company:

Aerobotics7 (A7) is a mission-driven deep-tech startup focused on developing an autonomous next-gen sensing and advanced AI platform to detect, identify, and mitigate hidden threats like landmines, UXOs, and IEDs in real-time. We are entering a rapid development phase, creating innovative solutions leveraging cutting-edge technologies. Our dynamic team is committed to building impactful products through continuous learning and close cross-collaboration.

Role Description:

This is a full-time remote role for a talented and detail-oriented UI/UX Designer who thrives in fast-paced environments. As a critical member of the product team, you will lead design on mission-critical interfaces that fuse complex sensor data, real-time AI insights, and geospatial intelligence into a seamless operator experience.

As a UI/UX Designer, you’ll work closely with engineering, and field teams to design interfaces that power real-world decision-making. You will take ownership of both interface aesthetics and user experience architecture—translating complex, multi-modal data (such as 3D visualization, geospatial intelligence, and real-time analytics) into usable, elegant flows.

We are looking for someone who can move fast—from wireframes to polished, developer-ready assets—but who also knows how to ask the right questions, perform user research, and independently investigate industry standards and design inspiration. You should be as comfortable prototyping a sleek UI as you are architecting an end-to-end user journey map for a high-stakes workflow.

Responsibilities & Required Skills

description: About TJM LabsTJM Labs is building the digital workforce for pharmacy.

raw.title: Bot Support Specialist - Global, Remote
raw.excerpt: About TJM LabsTJM Labs is building the digital workforce for pharmacy.
raw.description:
About TJM Labs

TJM Labs is building the digital workforce for pharmacy.

Pharmacies are being asked to do more with fewer resources. Prescription volumes are growing, margins are tightening, and talented pharmacy teams spend too much of their day on repetitive operational work.

We're changing that.

TJM Labs builds AI-powered automation designed specifically for pharmacy. Our technology works within the systems pharmacies already use to automate repetitive workflows and create more capacity for pharmacists and pharmacy technicians to focus on the work that actually requires them.

As our customer base grows, we need people who can help pharmacies get answers quickly, understand when something isn't working as expected, and connect what the customer is experiencing with the technical teams who can solve it.

About the Role

We're looking for a Pharmacy Bot Support Specialist to provide responsive, thoughtful day-to-day support to pharmacies using TJM automation.

You'll work as part of a customer pod alongside Customer Success Managers, Implementation Leads, and technical teams.

This is not an account ownership role. You won't own the customer relationship, customer strategy, or implementation project.

Instead, you'll be one of the first people our pharmacy customers turn to when they have a question, need help, or tell us, 'The bot isn't doing what we expected.' Your job is to figure out what that actually means.

Sometimes the answer will be straightforward. Other times, you'll need to ask questions, understand the pharmacy workflow, gather examples, look at system information, reproduce the behavior, and document what you've learned so our technical teams can investigate efficiently.

You don't need to be an engineer. You do need to be technically curious, comfortable troubleshooting, an excellent communicator, and willing to keep asking questions until you understand what's actually happening.

What You'll Do

1. Be a Responsive First Point of Support

You'll help manage incoming day-to-day communication from pharmacy customers across our support channels.

  • Respond promptly and professionally to customer questions and reported issues.
  • Ask thoughtful follow-up questions to understand exactly what the customer is experiencing.
  • Gather the information needed to determine whether something is a question, training issue, workflow issue, configuration issue, product issue, or potential defect.
  • Help customers resolve issues that can be addressed without engineering involvement.
  • Set clear expectations about what happens next when additional investigation is required.
  • Keep customers updated rather than leaving them wondering whether anyone is working on their issue.
  • Close the loop once an issue has been resolved.

You won't be expected to have every answer. You will be expected to take responsibility for getting the information to the right person and making sure the question doesn't disappear.

2. Investigate Before You Escalate

One of the most important parts of this role is turning a customer-reported problem into something our technical teams can efficiently investigate.

  • Ask targeted questions about what happened before, during, and after the reported issue.
  • Gather specific examples, timestamps, prescription or workflow context, screenshots, and other appropriate information.
  • Understand what the customer expected to happen versus what actually happened.
  • Review available system activity, configurations, logs, and other troubleshooting information.
  • Attempt to reproduce reported behavior when appropriate.
  • Determine whether the issue affects one scenario or a broader workflow.
  • Check known issues and available documentation before escalating.
  • Document what you've already investigated so another team doesn't have to start from zero.

Your goal is to make sure engineering spends its time solving technical problems rather than trying to figure out what the problem is.

3. Create Excellent Technical Support Tickets

When an issue needs to move to engineering or another technical team, you'll make sure they receive a clear, actionable ticket.

  • What is happening — and what should be happening instead?
  • Which pharmacy and workflow are affected?
  • When did it happen, and is it reproducible?
  • What specific examples demonstrate the problem?
  • What troubleshooting has already been completed?
  • Is there a workaround, and how is this affecting the pharmacy's operation?

A great escalation means the technical team can begin investigating without immediately coming back for basic information.

4. Understand the Pharmacy Behind the Problem

Software support at TJM requires more than understanding software. You need to understand pharmacy.

  • Use your knowledge of pharmacy operations and pharmacy management systems to put customer questions into context.
  • Learn how each customer's TJM automation fits into its pharmacy operation and use that understanding to troubleshoot more effectively.

5. Communicate Clearly Through Resolution

Great support isn't only about solving the problem. It's also about what the customer experiences while we're solving it.

  • Explain technical information in clear, plain language.
  • Provide updates while issues are being investigated.
  • Avoid making promises before you have the information to make them.
  • Let customers know what we need from them and why.
  • Communicate internally when an issue may have broader customer impact.
  • Bring in the Implementation Lead or CSM when an issue crosses into their area of ownership.
  • Help diffuse frustration through responsiveness, empathy, and clear communication.
  • Confirm that the customer is actually seeing the expected behavior before considering an issue resolved.

6. Know When to Pull in the Pod

You'll work closely with Customer Success Managers and Implementation Leads, but each role has a different job.

  • Customer Success Managers own the strategic customer relationship, overall customer health, and escalations.
  • Implementation Leads own the day-to-day execution of implementations, including workflow documentation, implementation requirements, stakeholder coordination, QA, and go-live.
  • Pharmacy Bot Support Specialists provide day-to-day product support, investigate reported problems, gather the information needed to troubleshoot them, resolve what they can, and create high-quality escalations when technical assistance is required.

7. Help Us Spot Patterns

Individual support conversations can tell us a lot about our product.

  • Issues that appear repeatedly across customers.
  • Areas where customers consistently need additional training.
  • Workflows that generate frequent questions.
  • Product behavior that creates confusion.
  • Documentation or support resources we should improve.
  • Potential product enhancements.
  • Opportunities to prevent future support issues.

Requirements

What We're Looking For

  • 2+ years of experience working in a pharmacy environment, such as retail, specialty, mail-order, hospital, long-term care, or compounding.
  • Hands-on familiarity with pharmacy workflows and pharmacy management systems.
  • Technical curiosity and a genuine interest in figuring out how things work.
  • A methodical approach to problems and excellent follow-up questions.
  • Clear writing and the ability to document details someone else needs to act.
  • Patience and professionalism when someone is frustrated.
  • Strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple customer questions and support issues.
  • Comfort working independently in a remote environment, screen sharing, video meetings, and learning new software.
  • Understanding of the importance of appropriately handling PHI and other sensitive healthcare information.

Pharmacy Technician Experience Is Highly Desired

Current or previous pharmacy technician experience is highly desired. Registered or certified pharmacy technicians are strongly encouraged to apply.

If you've worked in a pharmacy, you understand that 'the prescription didn't process correctly' could mean a dozen different things, and you know the questions to ask before deciding something is actually wrong with the pharmacy management system.

Pharmacy Management System Experience

Hands-on familiarity with pharmacy management systems is required for this role.

Experience with systems such as PioneerRx, PrimeRx, Rx30, Computer-Rx, FrameworkLTC, QS/1, or similar pharmacy management platforms is particularly valuable.

Nice to Have

  • Previous software or technical support experience.
  • Experience training pharmacy staff on technology or workflows.
  • Experience supporting software implementations.
  • Familiarity with Jira, Zendesk, ServiceNow, or similar tools.
  • Experience reviewing logs, configurations, or system activity.
  • Basic familiarity with Windows, networking, integrations, or software troubleshooting.
  • Experience with healthcare technology, workflow automation, or AI-powered technology.
  • Experience in specialty, compounding, long-term care, mail-order, or high-volume retail pharmacy.

What You Don't Need

You don't need to know how to code.

You don't need to be an engineer.

You don't need to be a project manager.

You don't need to own a book of business.

You don't need previous experience working with AI.

You don't need to arrive knowing TJM's technology.

You do need to understand pharmacy, enjoy technology, communicate exceptionally well, and be curious enough to keep digging when the first answer doesn't make sense. We'll teach you the rest.

You'll Probably Love This Role If...

Someone saying 'it's broken' immediately makes you want to know exactly what they were doing when it broke.

You're the person in the pharmacy people call over when something weird happens with the computer.

You ask, 'Can you show me?' a lot.

You enjoy figuring out why something happened almost as much as fixing it.

You know that 'it happens all the time' is not quite enough information to troubleshoot a problem.

You can talk comfortably with a pharmacy technician one minute and clearly document the same issue for an engineer the next.

You don't throw an issue over the fence to engineering and consider your job done.

There's something deeply satisfying to you about finally figuring out why the weird thing was happening.

Why TJM Labs

You'll join a fast-growing company working on a very real problem in healthcare. You'll see our automation working inside real pharmacies and taking repetitive work off the shoulders of pharmacists and pharmacy technicians.

For the right person, this can be a path from using pharmacy technology every day to becoming someone who helps shape how that technology works for pharmacies.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Remote-first work environment
  • The opportunity to work at the intersection of pharmacy, healthcare, and AI
  • Meaningful opportunity to learn and grow as TJM Labs continues to scale

About the Client

Our client is an AI-native product company built to replace how billions of people manage their digital lives — starting with email, notes, and task tools that were never designed to be AI-native. It's backed by multi-million-dollar investment and built remote-first from day one, with a clear target: cut the time it takes users to get everyday things done by roughly 90%. That means solving the problems most AI products avoid — long-running workflows, persistent context, and reliable behavior under real-world, non-deterministic conditions. The team is small and high-talent-density by design, not by necessity, and moves at a pace that matches the scale of what it's building.

About the Role

As a Member of Technical Staff, Machine Learning, you'll build core ML components and work on real production systems from day one — learning how large-scale ML behaves outside of research settings. This role is for engineers who want to develop strong systems judgment by shipping, debugging, and iterating on real-world ML.

What You'll Work On

  • Build and improve ML components across data, training, evaluation, and inference

  • Fine-tune and adapt models as part of larger production systems

  • Implement evaluation and testing to understand model behavior

  • Help build and maintain data pipelines for real-world and synthetic data

  • Debug model issues, performance problems, and production incidents

  • Ship improvements iteratively and learn from real user feedback

  • Work closely with senior ML engineers and product teams

  • Work under real production constraints: latency, cost, reliability, and safety

Requirements

  • Strong foundations in machine learning and modern neural architectures

  • Some hands-on experience training, fine-tuning, or deploying ML models

  • Comfortable writing production-quality code and learning new tools quickly

  • Curious, coachable, and eager to learn from real production systems

  • Able to work through ambiguity with guidance, growing ownership over time

  • A bias toward shipping, iteration, and continuous improvement

Tech Stack

Python · PyTorch / JAX · production ML systems running on GPUs

What Success Looks Like

  • ML models in production meet accuracy, latency, and reliability targets

  • Production issues are found quickly, debugged effectively, and root-caused

  • Data pipelines, training loops, and inference systems stay robust, reproducible, maintainable

  • Effective collaboration with engineers, product, and research to ship reliable ML-powered features

  • Iteration is driven by real-world signals and measurable improvement

What to Expect

The best products in the world are built by small, world-class teams. Decisions are made collectively, at rapid speed — balancing high-quality shipping with fast learning. You'll be expected to bring structure, exercise judgment, and execute independently.

Compensation and benefits are competitive and vary by location; the package includes base salary and equity, discussed openly with you as part of the process.

About Checkmate

Checkmate is a restaurant technology solution provider that has continually evolved over time. We started in 2017 by integrating 3rd party platforms to the POS systems of restaurants. At that time, there were multiple 3rd party platforms like GrubHub, UberEats, DoorDash, Postmates, Caviar, and even Amazon!

This was the photograph that started it all!

We have since then continually evolved to add multiple products to our portfolio, the primary ones being first party ordering solutions like web and app ordering, kiosks and catering. We have now recently moved into three new exciting products: Digital Menu Boards, Phone Ordering AI and Drive thru AI. We form a very core part of the restaurant technology ecosystem, and are continually adding more and more digital solutions for the restaurant brands to increase their sales.

Our revolutionary enterprise menu management system, Everyware, truly unlocks the potential of menus and how it can be customized for each individual digital channel. As you can see, this is a company that continually evolves and adapts and today we are powering digital ordering solutions for some of the largest brands in the world.

We have been called the "north star of vendors" as we truly believe that technology is just a method by which we service the customers, it does not form the entirety of it. Service is a big component of what we provide to our customers, which is inherently believed by every single team member here. We are doing a lot of exciting things, including application of AI in our products and systems, using experimentation at scale to determine what works for our clients and ML to analyze and productize the massive amount of data we have. Each individual here makes a difference and has a valuable contribution. Key traits here are ownership and drive. Join us if you think you have them.

About the Role

As a Vice President of Engineering, you will operate as a player/coach and join a collaborative team of VPs of Engineering reporting directly to the Chief Technology Officer (CTO). In this role, you will lead globally distributed software engineering teams driving the execution, architectural integrity, and delivery of core product initiatives built on cloud-native architectures in AWS.

Drawing on your experience in high-growth SaaS and web-based startup environments, you will serve as a key technical leader across the organization, partnering closely with Product leadership, Data Analytics, and cross-functional teams to build high-performance, scalable software that drives business growth. You will also be at the forefront of modern engineering management, actively driving teams to adopt AI-driven development practices to increase velocity, code quality, and developer productivity.

Essential Job Functions

Global Engineering Leadership & Talent

  • Lead, mentor, and grow distributed software engineering teams located across global regions, with direct leadership experience overseeing development teams based in India.
  • Foster a high-performance, inclusive culture that excels across time zones, ensuring clear communication, alignment, and operational execution.
  • Champion and integrate modern AI-driven development tools and workflows (e.g., AI coding assistants, automated test generation, AI-assisted code reviews) to accelerate execution and upskill engineering talent.
  • Recruit, develop, and retain top talent, establishing clear career progression pathways and coaching engineering managers and technical leads.

Technical Strategy & Architectural Excellence

  • Drive architectural vision and technical design for your product domain, ensuring scalable, secure, and cost-efficient deployments natively on AWS.
  • Champion modern engineering best practices, including design standards, code reusability, automated testing, system performance, and technical debt remediation.
  • Partner with platform and infrastructure leaders to ensure software designs integrate smoothly into company-wide CI/CD pipelines and cloud infrastructure.

Process Development, Continuous Improvement & Team Metrics

  • Design, document, and own the engineering operating model for a team of engineers, including sprint and release cadence, planning and estimation, code review standards, branching and deployment practices, and definition-of-done criteria.
  • Establish lightweight, scalable processes that fit a remote, globally distributed team
  • Define, instrument, and report on team performance metrics. These cover delivery (deployment frequency, lead time for changes, change failure rate, time to restore service), quality (escaped defects, test coverage, incident volume), predictability (commitment accuracy, cycle time), and team health (engagement, on-call load, attrition).
  • Run a regular continuous improvement cycle, including retrospectives, post-incident reviews, and quarterly process assessments. Turn findings into prioritized, owned improvement initiatives with measurable outcomes.
  • Measure the impact of AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, AI code review, automated test generation) on velocity, quality, and developer experience. Use the results to refine adoption practices and guidance.
  • Maintain a sustainable balance between feature delivery, technical debt remediation, and operational work through explicit capacity allocation and regular roadmap trade-off discussions with Product.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Process

  • Work closely with Product Management, Data Analytics, and Customer Success teams to align technical roadmaps with business objectives, user experience goals, and feature releases.
  • Collaborate with peer VPs of Engineering under the CTO to establish consistent engineering standards, shared technical frameworks, and cross-team processes.
  • Manage strategic software vendor and third-party partner relationships (e.g., outsourced talent, specialized tools) to scale capability in a fast-moving SaaS environment.
  • Implement and continuously refine Agile processes to reduce friction, increase delivery velocity, and elevate product quality.

Requirements

  • 12+ years of progressive software engineering experience, with 5+ years in senior engineering leadership roles managing engineering managers and cross-functional teams.
  • 7+ years hands-on experience with Ruby on Rails ecosystem patterns, performance tuning, or legacy/modern Rails application scaling is a strong plus.
  • 7+ years hands-on experience with asynchronous processing and architectures
  • 5+ years working in and managing a 100% remote based team
  • Proven SaaS / web-based startup experience, with a track record of thriving in fast-paced, high-growth environments where speed and adaptability are critical.
  • Demonstrated experience leading engineering team members globally having deep familiarity with cross-cultural team management.
  • Strong track record of collaborating with peer engineering leaders and senior stakeholders under executive direction.
  • Strong, proven expertise in building and scaling applications hosted on AWS (Amazon Web Services).
  • Experience actively implementing and driving engineering teams to adopt AI-driven development practices (e.g., Claude Code) to improve workflow and output.
  • Deep foundation in modern full-stack web architectures, databases, API design, microservices, and core web protocols (REST, JSON, OAuth, SSL).
  • Highly adaptable and skilled at managing multiple time-constrained priorities simultaneously with minimal guidance.

The Head of Global Events & Travel leads the strategy, governance, and execution of our global events and corporate travel function. This role oversees three interconnected areas:

  1. Flagship, VIP, High-Complexity & Client/client’s customers-Facing Events (client and client’s customers events, executive dinners, and high-touch VIP gatherings);

  2. Internal Meetings & Corporate Travel (global gatherings, executive offsites, collaborators travel program); and

  3. Dedicated Financial Control & Commercial Management.

The Head is accountable for the full events and corporate travel portfolio, consolidated budgets, strategic supplier agreements, service standards, and duty-of-care governance. Serving both internal teams and external stakeholders (clients, prospects, and partners), the Head sets priorities, builds team capability, and manages major commercial decisions and C-level/client escalations. Financial oversight is supported by the Event & Travel Finance Lead in alignment with central Corporate FP&A.

A key initial priority is leading the implementation and transition to our enhanced travel operating model. Once established, the Head provides oversight through periodic performance reviews and exception management, delegating routine operations to the team and Travel Management Companies (TMCs).

Responsibilities

  • Function Leadership: Lead and develop the Team. Recruit open roles, establish team cadence, and build capabilities across the function. Strategic resource planning across agencies, production vendors, and internal talent to execute both internal and client-facing events seamlessly.

  • Flagship, VIP & Client/client’s customers-Facing Events: Execute on objectives, budgets, and brand standards set by C-Level leadership for 5,000-attendee conference, VIP executive receptions, and regional customer summits. Manage delivery through the internal Team, supported by event specialists and external agencies. Lead venue selection, production, security, contract negotiations, and attendee experience for both internal and external audiences.

  • Internal Meetings & Offsites: Oversee the internal gathering strategy and delivery. Standardize playbooks for routine company meetings and regional leadership offsites.

  • Travel Operating Model Transition: Lead the implementation of our approved global travel operating model, including RFPs and contracts for multi-region TMCs, unified policy and expense frameworks, approvals, reconciliation, and dual quoting. Coordinate phased migration corridor-by-corridor, validate vendor acceptance, protect service continuity, and establish an operational handover once stable.

  • Corporate Travel Oversight: Own global travel strategy, master agreements, and major operational escalations. Oversee daily fulfillment, group flights, hotel blocks, rebooking, and high-touch support for executives, clients, and guest speakers managed by TMCs and the Travel & Logistics Coordinator.

  • Budget Accountability & Resource Stewardship: Own the consolidated events and travel budget, as well as revenue/cost-recovery models for sponsored or client-facing events. Act as a steward of company resources, prioritizing expenditure against strategic business objectives, maximizing ROI on client events, identifying cost-saving opportunities, and escalating forecast overruns early with mitigation plans.

  • Financial Governance & Client Billing: Work through the Team to manage annual budgets, rolling forecasts, vendor deposits, event ledgers, cross-charging/client billing, invoice reconciliation, and post-event financial reviews. Maintain strict approval thresholds, separation of duties, purchase orders, payment terms, and international VAT/GST recovery.

  • Strategic Suppliers & Commercial Partnerships: Lead major RFPs and negotiations with TMCs, airlines, hotel chains, event venues, registration platforms, and production partners. Maintain competitive discipline, set service expectations, and delegate routine vendor management while remaining the key point of contact for material escalations.

  • Policy, Duty of Care & Risk Management: Own the global events and travel policy. Establish traveler assistance, emergency response, data privacy, and incident escalation frameworks in coordination with People Ops, Legal, IT, and Security, ensuring comprehensive coverage for collaborators, clients, and external VIP guests.

  • Cross-Functional & Client Partnership: Partner with Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success on client event revenue targets, sponsorships, client experience, and commercial outcomes. Collaborate with C-Level executives on internal event agendas, keynotes, and executive participation. Partner with Finance, Legal, and People Ops to streamline global delivery.

Requirements

  • Events & Travel Leadership: 8+ years leading corporate events and managed travel programs, including 3+ years leading a global function in a fast-growing, international environment.

  • Client & Internal Event Expertise: Proven track record running both internal company meetings/offsites and high-impact, client- or customer-facing events (e.g., user conferences, client advisory boards, sponsored summits, roadshows).

  • Large-Scale Event Execution: Proven experience directing large conferences (5,000+ attendees) end-to-end, covering budgets, venue sourcing, registration tech, production, speaker/VIP management, and vendor teams.

  • Travel Program Transformation: Hands-on experience implementing or re-platforming corporate travel frameworks (TMC selections, booking/expense integrations, phased migrations, and duty-of-care rollouts). Multi-TMC or hybrid experience preferred.

  • Travel Industry & Commercial Fluency: Strong understanding of airline/hotel distribution economics (GDS, NDC, dynamic pricing, corporate direct programs) and commercial contracting for high-value event venues and suppliers.

  • Financial & Commercial Acumen: Demonstrated budget ownership, financial forecasting, ROI tracking, vendor negotiations, and client event billing/cost recovery. Experience with virtual-card systems or modern payment settlements is a plus.

  • Executive & External Presence: Exceptional communication and presentation skills; comfortable engaging directly with C-Suite executives, enterprise clients, sponsors, and key industry partners.

  • Data Privacy & Duty of Care: Solid understanding of global travel safety protocols, crisis management, GDPR compliance, vendor DPAs, and attendee data privacy standards.

  • Language & Mobility: Professional fluency in English (Spanish and/or Italian are strong pluses). Willingness to travel internationally up to 40% and operate across European, Middle Eastern, and Americas time zones.

Important information for candidates
Recruitment scams have become increasingly common. To protect yourself, please keep the following in mind when applying for roles:

  • Apply only through our official channels. We do not use third-party platforms or agencies for recruitment unless clearly stated. All open roles are listed on our official careers page:

  • Verify the recruiter’s identity. All our recruiters have verified LinkedIn profiles. If you’re unsure, you can confirm their identity by checking their profile or contacting us through our website.

  • Be cautious of unusual communication methods. We do not conduct interviews over WhatsApp, Telegram, or SMS. All communication is done through official company emails and platforms.

  • Double-check email addresses. All communication from us will come from emails ending in @ or @

  • We will never request payment or financial details. If someone asks for personal financial information or payment at any point during the hiring process, it is a scam. Please report it immediately.

When in doubt, feel free to reach out through our official website.

raw.excerpt: About AlphaSense: AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance.
raw.description:
About AlphaSense:

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit . Come join us.

Location: Remote US

Reports to: Senior Director, Corporate Strategic Sales

The Consulting Sales team partners with the world’s leading consulting, advisory, and professional services firms, from global strategy houses to specialized research and advisory practices. These firms rely on AlphaSense to accelerate research, sharpen client recommendations, and deliver faster, better-informed answers across industries. Within Corporate Sales, our Professional Services & Consulting organization is responsible for both net new and expansion business, driving new logo acquisition while deepening AlphaSense’s footprint within existing customers. The Enterprise pods focus on the largest and most complex consulting logos, building executive-level relationships and driving firm-wide adoption of AlphaSense across practices and regions.

About the Role:

We are looking for an experienced, entrepreneurial, and accomplished enterprise sales leader to join our growing Consulting Sales team as a Pod Leader. You will lead a pod of two Account Executives while owning a portfolio of AlphaSense’s most strategic consulting and professional services accounts. Reporting to the Senior Director, Corporate Sales - Consulting, you will set the strategy, coach and develop your AEs, and lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles that result in six- and seven-figure SaaS partnerships.

As a player-coach, this role combines owning and driving large enterprise deals with leading the strategy and execution of your pod and its cross-functional partners. You will build executive-level relationships with partners and practice leaders, craft compelling business cases, and guide firms through practice-by-practice and enterprise-wide deployments of our platform. This is a high-activity, high-accountability role that includes a meaningful volume of personal outbound prospecting into your accounts.

This role offers the opportunity to:

  • Partner with partners, practice leaders, and senior decision-makers to shape how consulting firms use market intelligence to serve their clients
  • Lead global expansion efforts across multi-office, multi-practice organizations in collaboration with teams across regions and functions
  • Build and grow a team while being part of a high-growth, AI-driven SaaS company that is rapidly becoming the standard for market intelligence

Who You Are:

  • An Accomplished Sales Leader: You have experience owning a large book of new business and expansion within enterprise or global accounts, ideally in consulting, professional services, or research and advisory firms, with a strong track record of overachievement in SaaS using value-based enterprise selling to close six- and seven-figure deals.
  • A Player-Coach: You have led, mentored, or formally managed sellers, and you enjoy raising the performance of others through hands-on coaching, deal inspection, and leading by example.
  • Strategic Mindset: You co-create a vision with your customers and work backwards from what success looks like to drive growth and customer value.
  • Strong Executive Communicator: You influence senior leaders and build champions in partnership-driven organizations, and you can explain complex concepts to audiences from Analysts to Managing Partners.
  • Comfortable with Volume: You operate in environments where consistent outbound activity, including cold calling, is part of your daily rhythm, and you see proactive outreach as core to how you work.
  • Account Leader: You inspire and lead cross-functional partners to execute on a greater vision, and you enjoy getting into the details of a deal to find a path to win.
  • Hunter: You drive pipeline through your own efforts, in addition to the support of our SDR, Marketing, and Account Management teams.
  • Intellectually Curious: You know the right questions to ask and how to uncover business challenges at all levels of an organization.
  • Collaborative and Coachable: You are open to feedback, committed to constant improvement, and motivated to build a high-performing, inclusive team culture.

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead and develop a pod of two Global Enterprise Account Executives, setting clear expectations, coaching on deal strategy, account planning, and executive engagement, and building a bench of future leaders.
  • Own strategy and end-to-end sales for a portfolio of global consulting and professional services accounts, leading practice-by-practice and firm-wide deployments of AlphaSense across regions.
  • Create and execute a vision and strategy to align your team and cross-functional partners and grow your pod’s book of business through new logo acquisition, upsell, cross-sell, and new product adoption.
  • Build executive-level relationships with partners, practice leaders, and senior decision-makers, and support your AEs on the most complex, high-value deals.
  • Become an industry expert on consulting and professional services buying dynamics, use cases, competitive landscape, and product differentiation.
  • Drive pipeline through personal prospecting plus ABM campaigns and prospecting plans built with SDRs and Marketing.
  • Forecast accurately using CRM and analytics tools, and help your team build the pipeline needed to meet or exceed quota.
  • Partner with Account Management to ensure customer health throughout the contract term and to identify opportunities for expansion and executive relationship building.
  • Partner with Talent Acquisition to hire and onboard top-tier Account Executives, and champion a culture of continuous improvement.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience selling into the Big Three, Big Four, or boutique consulting and advisory firms.
  • Experience selling to research professionals in a fast-scaling SaaS environment.

For base compensation, we set standard ranges for all roles based on function and level benchmarked against similar stage growth companies and internal comparables. In order to be compliant with local legislation, as well as to provide greater transparency to candidates, we share salary ranges on all job postings regardless of desired hiring location. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience/expertise and may vary from the amounts listed below.

We offer a competitive benefits program, a generous commission plan with uncapped earning potential as well as equity.

Base Compensation Range
$150,000—$215,000 USD

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.

In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.

Recruiting Scams and Fraud

We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:

  • AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.
  • All official communications will come from an @ email address.
  • If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page.

If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

Acxiom is seeking a talented Product Manager who will be exceptional at delivering data and identity products to data-centric businesses globally. The ideal candidate will have previous success in managing data products, experience engaging with data engineering and analytics/data science teams to produce commercial offerings, comfortable working collaboratively across teams and help us define our data culture. You will understand technology capabilities and how they apply to our strategic roadmap from both a product and customer perspective.

Directs product strategy and execution for Acxiom’s B2B Suite from conception through end of life. Functions as a central resource across product, design, engineering, architecture, quality, marketing, and delivery as the product(s) move through their lifecycle. Responsible for gathering and defining requirements from an array of stakeholders, ranging from Small Office/Home Office to Enterprise and prioritizing into a roadmap. Partners closely with engineering and cross-functional teams to execute product development plans and ensure product performance meets defined goals.

Operates as an independent product owner within a defined scope, contributing to broader product strategy while owning day-to-day product decisions, delivery, and performance.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Fully functional and self-directed within defined product scope
  • Provides guidance and informal mentorship to less experienced associates
  • Directly Responsible Individual (DRI) for a single product, sub-product, or defined capability
  • Defines and executes product roadmap aligned to broader product or domain strategy
  • Builds and maintains product business plans to support revenue, adoption, and cost efficiency goals
  • Owns and manages product backlog, including user stories, requirements, and prioritization
  • Establishes and manages quarterly OKRs and product KPIs (e.g., revenue, adoption, availability, quality, cost efficiency)
  • Executes product development plans in partnership with engineering and cross-functional teams
  • Collaborates with Sales, Marketing, and other stakeholders to support product launches, positioning, and adoption
  • Monitors product performance and drives continuous improvement based on financial, operational, and client satisfaction metrics
  • Works closely with privacy, legal, and compliance teams to ensure requirements are addressed throughout the product lifecycle
  • Supports research and analysis to inform product enhancements, positioning, and competitive differentiation
  • Escalates complex cross-product dependencies, strategic tradeoffs, and investment-related considerations to senior product leadership

SUPERVISORY RESPONSIBILITIES

This position does not have direct reports but may mentor less experienced associates.

QUALIFICATIONS

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree and 3+ years of product management or related experience,
  • Strong verbal, written, and presentation skills
  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills
  • Background in product development, data products, or related technical environments
  • Practical knowledge of product management methodologies and best practices
  • Domain familiarity in marketing data, data products, or other information-intensive product environments

Preferred

  • Practical experience in AdTech/MarTech or data-driven product ecosystems
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum environments
  • Go-to-Market (GTM) Product Launch Experience
  • Advanced, proven knowledge of Acxiom products
